2173 +import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
2174 +import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
2175 +import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
2176 +import { dirname, join, resolve } from "node:path";
2177 +import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
2178 +import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
2179 +
2180 +class DaemonCompatibilityCopyInventory {
2181 +  static readonly expectedDigest =
2182 +    "d0ff136f3be132ea004d3b13985192e055d1dfbad1abb773b607e89c54a1f41e";
2183 +
2184 +  static files(repositoryRoot: string): readonly string[] {
2185 +    const daemonDirectory = join(repositoryRoot, "apps/cli/src/daemon");
2186 +    const cliOwnedSources = new Set([
2187 +      "daemon-command-dispatcher.ts",
2188 +      "invocation-route.ts",
2189 +      "invocation-workspace-selector.ts",
2190 +    ]);
2191 +    return readdirSync(daemonDirectory)
2192 +      .filter(
2193 +        (name) => name.endsWith(".ts") && !name.endsWith(".test.ts") && !cliOwnedSources.has(name),
2194 +      )
2195 +      .map((name) => `apps/cli/src/daemon/${name}`)
2196 +      .sort();
2197 +  }
2198 +
2199 +  static digest(repositoryRoot: string, files: readonly string[]): string {
2200 +    const hash = createHash("sha256");
2201 +    for (const file of files) {
2202 +      hash.update(file);
2203 +      hash.update("\0");
2204 +      hash.update(readFileSync(join(repositoryRoot, file), "utf8").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n"));
2205 +      hash.update("\0");
2206 +    }
2207 +    return hash.digest("hex");
2208 +  }
2209 +}
2210 +
2211 +describe("CLI daemon compatibility copies", () => {
2212 +  it("remain frozen while package-local mechanisms are staged", () => {
2213 +    const repositoryRoot = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "../..");
2214 +    const files = DaemonCompatibilityCopyInventory.files(repositoryRoot);
2215 +
2216 +    expect(files).toHaveLength(38);
2217 +    expect(DaemonCompatibilityCopyInventory.digest(repositoryRoot, files)).toBe(
2218 +      DaemonCompatibilityCopyInventory.expectedDigest,
2219 +    );
2220 +  });
2221 +
2222 +  it("hashes semantic source content independently of checkout line endings", () => {
2223 +    const repositoryRoot = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "../..");
2224 +    const files = DaemonCompatibilityCopyInventory.files(repositoryRoot);
2225 +    const crlfCheckoutRoot = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "symnav-daemon-compatibility-"));
2226 +
2227 +    try {
2228 +      for (const file of files) {
2229 +        const source = readFileSync(join(repositoryRoot, file), "utf8").replace(/\r?\n/g, "\r\n");
2230 +        const crlfFile = join(crlfCheckoutRoot, file);
2231 +        mkdirSync(dirname(crlfFile), { recursive: true });
2232 +        writeFileSync(crlfFile, source);
2233 +      }
2234 +
2235 +      expect(DaemonCompatibilityCopyInventory.digest(crlfCheckoutRoot, files)).toBe(
2236 +        DaemonCompatibilityCopyInventory.expectedDigest,
2237 +      );
2238 +
2239 +      const changedFile = join(crlfCheckoutRoot, files[0]!);
2240 +      writeFileSync(changedFile, `${readFileSync(changedFile, "utf8")}export {};\r\n`);
2241 +
2242 +      expect(DaemonCompatibilityCopyInventory.digest(crlfCheckoutRoot, files)).not.toBe(
2243 +        DaemonCompatibilityCopyInventory.expectedDigest,
2244 +      );
2245 +    } finally {
2246 +      rmSync(crlfCheckoutRoot, { recursive: true, force: true });
2247 +    }
2248 +  });
2249 +});

2398 +describe("DaemonClient control", () => {
2399 +  afterEach(() => vi.restoreAllMocks());
2400 +
2401 +  it("owns one start/status/stop composition with distinct response timeouts", async () => {
2402 +    const policy = DaemonPolicy.currentSystem();
2403 +    const client = createClient(policy);
2404 +    const composition = ClientControlInspection.read(client);
2405 +    const start = vi.spyOn(DaemonController.prototype, "start").mockResolvedValue({
2406 +      status: "ready",
2407 +      workspaceRoot: "/workspace",
2408 +      fileCount: 4,
2409 +      loadDurationMs: 2,
2410 +    });
2411 +    const status = vi.spyOn(DaemonController.prototype, "status").mockResolvedValue([]);
2412 +    const stop = vi
2413 +      .spyOn(DaemonController.prototype, "stop")
2414 +      .mockResolvedValue({ status: "not-running", workspaceRoot: "/workspace" });
2415 +
2416 +    await client.control({ action: "start", workspaceRoot: "/workspace" });
2417 +    await client.control({ action: "status" });
2418 +    await client.control({ action: "stop", workspaceRoot: "/workspace" });
2419 +    await client.control({ action: "status" });
2420 +
2421 +    expect(start).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
2422 +    expect(status).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
2423 +    expect(stop).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
2424 +    expect(ClientControlInspection.read(client)).toEqual(composition);
2425 +    expect(ClientControlInspection.responseTimeout(composition.routingTransport)).toBe(
2426 +      policy.values.transport.singleResponseTimeoutMs,
2427 +    );
2428 +    expect(ClientControlInspection.responseTimeout(composition.statusTransport)).toBe(
2429 +      policy.values.transport.statusResponseTimeoutMs,
2430 +    );
2431 +  });
2432 +
2433 +  it("returns disabled start without invoking lifecycle mechanisms", async () => {
2434 +    const start = vi.spyOn(DaemonController.prototype, "start");
2435 +    const client = createClient(DaemonPolicy.currentSystem(), false);
2436 +
2437 +    await expect(client.control({ action: "start", workspaceRoot: "/workspace" })).resolves.toEqual(
2438 +      { status: "disabled" },
2439 +    );
2440 +
2441 +    expect(start).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
2442 +  });
2443 +
2444 +  it.each(["start", "status", "stop"] as const)(
2445 +    "rejects %s mechanism errors for the host wrapper",
2446 +    async (action) => {
2447 +      vi.spyOn(DaemonController.prototype, action).mockRejectedValue(new Error(`${action} failed`));
2448 +      const client = createClient(DaemonPolicy.currentSystem());
2449 +
2450 +      if (action === "status") {
2451 +        await expect(client.control({ action })).rejects.toThrow(`${action} failed`);
2452 +      } else if (action === "start") {
2453 +        await expect(client.control({ action, workspaceRoot: "/workspace" })).rejects.toThrow(
2454 +          `${action} failed`,
2455 +        );
2456 +      } else {
2457 +        await expect(client.control({ action, workspaceRoot: "/workspace" })).rejects.toThrow(
2458 +          `${action} failed`,
2459 +        );
2460 +      }
2461 +    },
2462 +  );
2463 +});
2464 +
2465 +class ClientControlInspection {
2466 +  static read(client: DaemonClient): {
2467 +    readonly routingTransport: LocalDaemonTransport;
2468 +    readonly statusTransport: LocalDaemonTransport;
2469 +    readonly controlController: DaemonController;
2470 +    readonly statusController: DaemonController;
2471 +  } {
2472 +    return client as unknown as ReturnType<typeof ClientControlInspection.read>;
2473 +  }
2474 +
2475 +  static responseTimeout(transport: LocalDaemonTransport): number {
2476 +    const composition = transport as unknown as {
2477 +      readonly lifecycle: { readonly options: { readonly responseTimeoutMs: number } };
2478 +    };
2479 +    return composition.lifecycle.options.responseTimeoutMs;
2480 +  }
2481 +}
2482 +
2483 +function createClient(policy: DaemonPolicy, daemonEnabled = true): DaemonClient {
2484 +  return new DaemonClient({
2485 +    stateDirectory: "/state",
2486 +    productVersion: "0.1.0",
2487 +    daemonEnabled,
2488 +    executorFactory: () => localExecutor(),
2489 +    executorModuleUrl: "file:///executor.js",
2490 +    readinessProbe: { commandName: "version", argv: ["--version"] },
2491 +    policy,
2492 +  });
2493 +}
2494 +
2495 +function localExecutor(): DaemonExecutor {
2496 +  return {
2497 +    initialize: async () => ({ fileCount: 0 }),
2498 +    execute: async () => {
2499 +      throw new Error("Local execution was not expected");
2500 +    },
2501 +    releaseTransientResources: async () => undefined,
2502 +  };
2503 +}

2598 +class DaemonControlledOutput implements DaemonExecutorOutput {
2599 +  private readonly bytes: Uint8Array;
2600 +
2601 +  constructor(message: string) {
2602 +    this.bytes = Buffer.from(message);
2603 +  }
2604 +
2605 +  async *records(): AsyncIterable<DaemonOutputRecord> {
2606 +    yield { stream: "stderr", bytes: this.bytes };
2607 +  }
2608 +
2609 +  dispose(): Promise<void> {
2610 +    return Promise.resolve();
2611 +  }
2612 +}

2614 +class DaemonControlledResult {
2615 +  static acceptedRequestDidNotComplete(): DaemonExecutorExecutionResult {
2616 +    return this.failure("Cannot answer: accepted daemon request did not complete.\n");
2617 +  }
2618 +
2619 +  static workspaceCapacityExceeded(): DaemonExecutorExecutionResult {
2620 +    return this.failure("Cannot answer: daemon workspace capacity exceeded.\n");
2621 +  }
2622 +
2623 +  static responseCapacityExceeded(): DaemonExecutorExecutionResult {
2624 +    return this.failure("Cannot answer: daemon response capacity exceeded.\n");
2625 +  }
2626 +
2627 +  private static failure(message: string): DaemonExecutorExecutionResult {
2628 +    return { exitCode: 1, output: new DaemonControlledOutput(message) };
2629 +  }
2630 +}

2632 +export class DaemonClientRuntime {
2633 +  private readonly policy: DaemonPolicy;
2634 +  private readonly registry: DaemonRegistry;
2635 +  private readonly routingTransport: LocalDaemonTransport;
2636 +  private readonly statusTransport: LocalDaemonTransport;
2637 +  private readonly observer: DaemonRecordObserver;
2638 +  private readonly coordinator: DaemonStartupCoordinator;
2639 +  private readonly controlController: DaemonController;
2640 +  private readonly statusController: DaemonController;
2641 +  private readonly routing = new DaemonRoutingPolicy();
2642 +
2643 +  constructor(private readonly options: DaemonClientOptions) {
2644 +    this.policy = options.policy ?? DaemonPolicy.currentSystem();
2645 +    this.registry = new DaemonRegistry(
2646 +      DaemonWorkspaceIdentity.registryDirectory(options.stateDirectory),
2647 +      this.policy.values.startup,
2648 +    );
2649 +    this.routingTransport = new LocalDaemonTransport({
2650 +      policy: this.policy,
2651 +      createOutput: () => new DaemonClientResultCapture({ policy: this.policy.values.output }),
2652 +    });
2653 +    this.statusTransport = new LocalDaemonTransport({
2654 +      policy: this.policy,
2655 +      lifecycleResponseTimeoutMs: this.policy.values.transport.statusResponseTimeoutMs,
2656 +    });
2657 +    const processTerminator = new NodeDaemonProcessTerminator(this.policy.values.shutdown);
2658 +    const launcher = new NodeDaemonProcessLauncher(
2659 +      options.productVersion,
2660 +      options.executorModuleUrl,
2661 +      this.policy,
2662 +      processTerminator,
2663 +    );
2664 +    this.observer = new DaemonRecordObserver(this.routingTransport, processTerminator);
2665 +    this.coordinator = new DaemonStartupCoordinator(
2666 +      this.registry,
2667 +      launcher,
2668 +      this.routingTransport,
2669 +      {
2670 +        policy: this.policy.values,
2671 +        processTerminator,
2672 +        readinessProbe: options.readinessProbe,
2673 +      },
2674 +    );
2675 +    this.controlController = new DaemonController(
2676 +      this.registry,
2677 +      this.routingTransport,
2678 +      options.stateDirectory,
2679 +      {
2680 +        policy: this.policy.values,
2681 +        processTerminator,
2682 +        launcher,
2683 +        startupCoordinator: this.coordinator,
2684 +      },
2685 +    );
2686 +    this.statusController = new DaemonController(
2687 +      this.registry,
2688 +      this.statusTransport,
2689 +      options.stateDirectory,
2690 +      {
2691 +        policy: this.policy.values,
2692 +        processTerminator,
2693 +      },
2694 +    );
2695 +  }
2696 +
2697 +  async execute(request: DaemonClientExecuteRequest): Promise<DaemonClientExecuteResult> {
2698 +    if (!this.options.daemonEnabled) return this.executeLocally(request, "cold");
2699 +    const identity = DaemonWorkspaceIdentity.from(
2700 +      request.workspaceRoot,
2701 +      this.options.stateDirectory,
2702 +    );
2703 +    const route = await this.routing.decide(
2704 +      new DaemonRoutingContextState(
2705 +        identity,
2706 +        this.options.productVersion,
2707 +        () => this.registry.read(identity),
2708 +        (record) => this.observer.observe(record),
2709 +        (record) => this.registry.removeIfProcess(identity, record.instanceId, record.processToken),
2710 +      ),
2711 +    );
2712 +    if (route.kind === "warm") return this.executeWarm(route.record, request);
2713 +    if ((route.kind === "cold" && route.reason === "absent") || route.kind === "fallback") {
2714 +      DaemonClientRuntime.triggerIndependently(this.coordinator, identity);
2715 +    }
2716 +    return this.executeLocally(request, route.kind === "fallback" ? "fallback" : "cold");
2717 +  }
2718 +
2719 +  control(
2720 +    request: Extract<DaemonControlRequest, { readonly action: "start" }>,
2721 +  ): Promise<DaemonStartResult>;
2722 +  control(
2723 +    request: Extract<DaemonControlRequest, { readonly action: "status" }>,
2724 +  ): Promise<readonly RunningDaemonStatus[]>;
2725 +  control(
2726 +    request: Extract<DaemonControlRequest, { readonly action: "stop" }>,
2727 +  ): Promise<DaemonStopResult>;
2728 +  control(
2729 +    request: DaemonControlRequest,
2730 +  ): Promise<DaemonStartResult | readonly RunningDaemonStatus[] | DaemonStopResult> {
2731 +    if (request.action === "start") {
2732 +      if (!this.options.daemonEnabled) return Promise.resolve({ status: "disabled" });
2733 +      return this.controlController.start(request.workspaceRoot);
2734 +    }
2735 +    if (request.action === "status") return this.statusController.status();
2736 +    return this.controlController.stop(request.workspaceRoot);
2737 +  }
2738 +
2739 +  private async executeWarm(
2740 +    record: DaemonRecord,
2741 +    request: DaemonClientExecuteRequest,
2742 +  ): Promise<DaemonClientExecuteResult> {
2743 +    let receipt: Awaited<ReturnType<LocalDaemonTransport["execute"]>>;
2744 +    try {
2745 +      receipt = await this.routingTransport.execute(record.endpoint, {
2746 +        kind: "execute",
2747 +        protocolVersion: DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
2748 +        instanceId: record.instanceId,
2749 +        processToken: record.processToken,
2750 +        requestId: randomUUID(),
2751 +        commandName: request.commandName,
2752 +        request: DaemonClientRuntime.executorRequest(request, "warm"),
2753 +      });
2754 +    } catch (error) {
2755 +      if (error instanceof DaemonTransportError && error.retrySafe) {
2756 +        return this.executeLocally(request, "fallback");
2757 +      }
2758 +      return { mode: "warm", result: DaemonControlledResult.acceptedRequestDidNotComplete() };
2759 +    }
2760 +    try {
2761 +      const completion = await receipt.completion;
2762 +      if (completion.status === "failed") {
2763 +        return { mode: "warm", result: DaemonClientRuntime.controlledFailure(completion.code) };
2764 +      }
2765 +      if (!DaemonClientRuntime.isCompleteResult(completion.result)) {
2766 +        await DaemonClientRuntime.disposeMalformedOutput(completion.result);
2767 +        return { mode: "warm", result: DaemonControlledResult.acceptedRequestDidNotComplete() };
2768 +      }
2769 +      return { mode: "warm", result: completion.result };
2770 +    } catch {
2771 +      return { mode: "warm", result: DaemonControlledResult.acceptedRequestDidNotComplete() };
2772 +    }
2773 +  }
2774 +
2775 +  private async executeLocally(
2776 +    request: DaemonClientExecuteRequest,
2777 +    mode: "cold" | "fallback",
2778 +  ): Promise<DaemonClientExecuteResult> {
2779 +    const executor = await this.options.executorFactory({
2780 +      stateDirectory: this.options.stateDirectory,
2781 +      productVersion: this.options.productVersion,
2782 +      sampleResources: () => undefined,
2783 +    });
2784 +    const result = await executor.execute(DaemonClientRuntime.executorRequest(request, mode));
2785 +    return { mode, result };
2786 +  }
2787 +
2788 +  private static executorRequest(
2789 +    request: DaemonClientExecuteRequest,
2790 +    executionMode: DaemonExecutorRequest["executionMode"],
2791 +  ): DaemonExecutorRequest {
2792 +    return {
2793 +      argv: request.argv,
2794 +      cwd: request.cwd,
2795 +      telemetryEnabled: request.telemetryEnabled,
2796 +      executionMode,
2797 +    };
2798 +  }
2799 +
2800 +  private static triggerIndependently(
2801 +    coordinator: DaemonStartupCoordinator,
2802 +    identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity,
2803 +  ): void {
2804 +    try {
2805 +      void coordinator.trigger(identity).catch(() => undefined);
2806 +    } catch {}
2807 +  }
2808 +
2809 +  private static isCompleteResult(result: DaemonExecutorExecutionResult): boolean {
2810 +    return Number.isInteger(result.exitCode) && result.output !== undefined;
2811 +  }
2812 +
2813 +  private static async disposeMalformedOutput(
2814 +    result: DaemonExecutorExecutionResult,
2815 +  ): Promise<void> {
2816 +    try {
2817 +      await result.output?.dispose();
2818 +    } catch {}
2819 +  }
2820 +
2821 +  private static controlledFailure(
2822 +    code: DaemonExecutionFailureCode,
2823 +  ): DaemonExecutorExecutionResult {
2824 +    if (code === "controlled-resource") return DaemonControlledResult.workspaceCapacityExceeded();
2825 +    if (code === "response-capacity") return DaemonControlledResult.responseCapacityExceeded();
2826 +    return DaemonControlledResult.acceptedRequestDidNotComplete();
2827 +  }
2828 +}

3583 +import type { DaemonObservation } from "../registry/record-observer.js";
3584 +import type { DaemonWorkspaceIdentity } from "../registry/workspace-identity.js";
3585 +import type { DaemonRecord } from "../transport/protocol.js";
3586 +
3587 +export type DaemonRouteSnapshot =
3588 +  | { readonly kind: "disabled" }
3589 +  | { readonly kind: "cold"; readonly reason: "absent" | "starting" | "recovering" }
3590 +  | { readonly kind: "warm"; readonly record: DaemonRecord }
3591 +  | { readonly kind: "fallback"; readonly reason: "dead" | "incompatible" };
3592 +
3593 +export interface DaemonRoutingContext {
3594 +  readonly identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity;
3595 +  readonly productVersion: string;
3596 +  readRecord(): DaemonRecord | undefined;
3597 +  observe(record: DaemonRecord): Promise<DaemonObservation>;
3598 +  removeIfProcess(record: DaemonRecord): boolean;
3599 +}
3600 +
3601 +export interface DaemonRoutingGuard {
3602 +  evaluate(context: DaemonRoutingContext): Promise<DaemonRouteSnapshot | undefined>;
3603 +}
3604 +
3605 +interface DaemonRoutingOperations {
3606 +  readonly readRecord: () => DaemonRecord | undefined;
3607 +  readonly observe: (record: DaemonRecord) => Promise<DaemonObservation>;
3608 +  readonly removeIfProcess: (record: DaemonRecord) => boolean;
3609 +}
3610 +
3611 +export class DaemonRoutingContextState implements DaemonRoutingContext {
3612 +  private recordRead = false;
3613 +  private record: DaemonRecord | undefined;
3614 +  private recordFailure: unknown;
3615 +  private observation: Promise<DaemonObservation> | undefined;
3616 +
3617 +  constructor(
3618 +    readonly identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity,
3619 +    readonly productVersion: string,
3620 +    private readonly readRecordOperation: DaemonRoutingOperations["readRecord"],
3621 +    private readonly observeOperation: DaemonRoutingOperations["observe"],
3622 +    private readonly removeIfProcessOperation: DaemonRoutingOperations["removeIfProcess"],
3623 +  ) {}
3624 +
3625 +  readRecord(): DaemonRecord | undefined {
3626 +    if (!this.recordRead) {
3627 +      this.recordRead = true;
3628 +      try {
3629 +        this.record = this.readRecordOperation();
3630 +      } catch (error) {
3631 +        this.recordFailure = error;
3632 +      }
3633 +    }
3634 +    if (this.recordFailure !== undefined) throw this.recordFailure;
3635 +    return this.record;
3636 +  }
3637 +
3638 +  observe(record: DaemonRecord): Promise<DaemonObservation> {
3639 +    this.observation ??= this.observeOperation(record);
3640 +    return this.observation;
3641 +  }
3642 +
3643 +  removeIfProcess(record: DaemonRecord): boolean {
3644 +    return this.removeIfProcessOperation(record);
3645 +  }
3646 +}
3647 +
3648 +class RecordPresentRoutingGuard implements DaemonRoutingGuard {
3649 +  async evaluate(context: DaemonRoutingContext): Promise<DaemonRouteSnapshot | undefined> {
3650 +    try {
3651 +      return context.readRecord() === undefined ? { kind: "cold", reason: "absent" } : undefined;
3652 +    } catch {
3653 +      return { kind: "cold", reason: "recovering" };
3654 +    }
3655 +  }
3656 +}
3657 +
3658 +class NotStartingRoutingGuard implements DaemonRoutingGuard {
3659 +  async evaluate(context: DaemonRoutingContext): Promise<DaemonRouteSnapshot | undefined> {
3660 +    return context.readRecord()?.state === "starting"
3661 +      ? { kind: "cold", reason: "starting" }
3662 +      : undefined;
3663 +  }
3664 +}
3665 +
3666 +class RecordVersionRoutingGuard implements DaemonRoutingGuard {
3667 +  async evaluate(context: DaemonRoutingContext): Promise<DaemonRouteSnapshot | undefined> {
3668 +    return context.readRecord()?.symnavVersion !== context.productVersion
3669 +      ? { kind: "fallback", reason: "incompatible" }
3670 +      : undefined;
3671 +  }
3672 +}
3673 +
3674 +class ResponsiveRoutingGuard implements DaemonRoutingGuard {
3675 +  async evaluate(context: DaemonRoutingContext): Promise<DaemonRouteSnapshot> {
3676 +    const record = context.readRecord()!;
3677 +    let observation: DaemonObservation;
3678 +    try {
3679 +      observation = await context.observe(record);
3680 +    } catch {
3681 +      return { kind: "cold", reason: "recovering" };
3682 +    }
3683 +    if (observation.kind === "responsive") {
3684 +      if (observation.pong.symnavVersion !== context.productVersion) {
3685 +        return { kind: "fallback", reason: "incompatible" };
3686 +      }
3687 +      if (observation.pong.state === "starting") {
3688 +        return { kind: "cold", reason: "recovering" };
3689 +      }
3690 +      return { kind: "warm", record };
3691 +    }
3692 +    if (observation.kind === "starting") return { kind: "cold", reason: "starting" };
3693 +    if (observation.kind === "unresponsive") return { kind: "cold", reason: "recovering" };
3694 +    if (observation.kind === "exited") {
3695 +      try {
3696 +        context.removeIfProcess(record);
3697 +      } catch {}
3698 +      return { kind: "fallback", reason: "dead" };
3699 +    }
3700 +    return { kind: "fallback", reason: "incompatible" };
3701 +  }
3702 +}
3703 +
3704 +export class DaemonRoutingPolicy {
3705 +  private readonly guards: readonly DaemonRoutingGuard[] = [
3706 +    new RecordPresentRoutingGuard(),
3707 +    new NotStartingRoutingGuard(),
3708 +    new RecordVersionRoutingGuard(),
3709 +    new ResponsiveRoutingGuard(),
3710 +  ];
3711 +
3712 +  async decide(context: DaemonRoutingContext): Promise<DaemonRouteSnapshot> {
3713 +    for (const guard of this.guards) {
3714 +      const decision = await guard.evaluate(context);
3715 +      if (decision !== undefined) return decision;
3716 +    }
3717 +    throw new Error("Daemon routing guards did not produce a decision");
3718 +  }
3719 +}

3769 +const RECORD_HEADER_BYTES = 9;
3770 +
3771 +class CompletionSpoolRecordCodec {
3772 +  static encode(record: CommandOutputRecord): Buffer {
3773 +    const header = Buffer.alloc(RECORD_HEADER_BYTES);
3774 +    header.writeUInt32BE(record.sequence, 0);
3775 +    header.writeUInt8(record.stream === "stdout" ? 0 : 1, 4);
3776 +    header.writeUInt32BE(record.bytes.byteLength, 5);
3777 +    return Buffer.concat([header, Buffer.from(record.bytes)]);
3778 +  }
3779 +
3780 +  static async *decodeFile(
3781 +    filePath: string,
3782 +    maximumRecordBytes: number,
3783 +  ): AsyncIterable<CommandOutputRecord> {
3784 +    const noFollow = "O_NOFOLLOW" in constants ? constants.O_NOFOLLOW : 0;
3785 +    const handle = await open(filePath, constants.O_RDONLY | noFollow);
3786 +    try {
3787 +      const metadata = await handle.stat();
3788 +      if (!metadata.isFile()) throw new Error("Command output spool is not a regular file");
3789 +      let position = 0;
3790 +      let expectedSequence = 0;
3791 +      while (position < metadata.size) {
3792 +        const header = Buffer.alloc(RECORD_HEADER_BYTES);
3793 +        await CompletionSpoolRecordCodec.readExact(handle, header, position);
3794 +        position += RECORD_HEADER_BYTES;
3795 +        const sequence = header.readUInt32BE(0);
3796 +        const streamByte = header.readUInt8(4);
3797 +        const length = header.readUInt32BE(5);
3798 +        if (sequence !== expectedSequence || streamByte > 1 || length > maximumRecordBytes) {
3799 +          throw new Error("Corrupt command output");
3800 +        }
3801 +        const bytes = Buffer.alloc(length);
3802 +        await CompletionSpoolRecordCodec.readExact(handle, bytes, position);
3803 +        position += length;
3804 +        expectedSequence += 1;
3805 +        yield { sequence, stream: streamByte === 0 ? "stdout" : "stderr", bytes };
3806 +      }
3807 +    } finally {
3808 +      await handle.close();
3809 +    }
3810 +  }
3811 +
3812 +  private static async readExact(
3813 +    handle: FileHandle,
3814 +    buffer: Buffer,
3815 +    position: number,
3816 +  ): Promise<void> {
3817 +    let offset = 0;
3818 +    while (offset < buffer.byteLength) {
3819 +      const { bytesRead } = await handle.read(
3820 +        buffer,
3821 +        offset,
3822 +        buffer.byteLength - offset,
3823 +        position + offset,
3824 +      );
3825 +      if (bytesRead === 0) throw new Error("Truncated command output");
3826 +      offset += bytesRead;
3827 +    }
3828 +  }
3829 +}

3871 +export class NodeCompletionSpoolStorage implements CompletionSpoolStorage {
3872 +  async ensureDirectory(path: string): Promise<void> {
3873 +    await mkdir(path, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
3874 +    const metadata = await lstat(path);
3875 +    if (metadata.isSymbolicLink() || !metadata.isDirectory()) {
3876 +      throw new Error("Completion spool directory is unsafe");
3877 +    }
3878 +    await chmod(path, 0o700);
3879 +  }
3880 +
3881 +  createFile(path: string): Promise<CompletionSpoolFile> {
3882 +    return open(path, "wx", 0o600);
3883 +  }
3884 +
3885 +  records(path: string, maximumChunkBytes: number): AsyncIterable<CommandOutputRecord> {
3886 +    return CompletionSpoolRecordCodec.decodeFile(path, maximumChunkBytes);
3887 +  }
3888 +
3889 +  async unlink(path: string): Promise<void> {
3890 +    await unlink(path);
3891 +  }
3892 +
3893 +  async removeInstance(path: string): Promise<void> {
3894 +    await rm(path, { recursive: true, force: true });
3895 +  }
3896 +}

3928 +export class CompletionSpool {
3929 +  private readonly hash = createHash("sha256");
3930 +  private readonly inlineRecords: CommandOutputRecord[] = [];
3931 +  private file: CompletionSpoolFile | undefined;
3932 +  private filePath: string | undefined;
3933 +  private rawBytes = 0;
3934 +  private recordCount = 0;
3935 +  private terminal = false;
3936 +  private ownershipReleased = false;
3937 +  private cleanupFinished = false;
3938 +  private disposal: Promise<void> | undefined;
3939 +  private manifest: CompletionSpoolManifest | undefined;
3940 +
3941 +  constructor(private readonly options: CompletionSpoolOptions) {}
3942 +
3943 +  get completedManifest(): CompletionSpoolManifest | undefined {
3944 +    return this.manifest;
3945 +  }
3946 +
3947 +  async append(record: CommandOutputRecord): Promise<void> {
3948 +    if (this.terminal) throw new Error("Completion spool is already terminal");
3949 +    if (record.sequence !== this.recordCount) throw new Error("Unexpected command output sequence");
3950 +    if (record.bytes.byteLength > this.options.maximumChunkBytes) {
3951 +      throw new Error("Command output record exceeds chunk capacity");
3952 +    }
3953 +    if (this.rawBytes + record.bytes.byteLength > this.options.maximumResultBytes) {
3954 +      await this.failCapacity();
3955 +    }
3956 +    let currentRecordReserved = false;
3957 +    try {
3958 +      this.options.reserve(record.bytes.byteLength);
3959 +      currentRecordReserved = true;
3960 +      const stored: CommandOutputRecord = { ...record, bytes: Buffer.from(record.bytes) };
3961 +      if (
3962 +        this.file === undefined &&
3963 +        this.rawBytes + stored.bytes.byteLength > this.options.inlineBytes
3964 +      ) {
3965 +        await this.spillInlineRecords();
3966 +      }
3967 +      const encoded = CompletionSpoolRecordCodec.encode(stored);
3968 +      if (this.file === undefined) this.inlineRecords.push(stored);
3969 +      else await this.file.write(encoded);
3970 +      this.hash.update(encoded.subarray(4));
3971 +      this.rawBytes += stored.bytes.byteLength;
3972 +      this.recordCount += 1;
3973 +    } catch (error) {
3974 +      if (currentRecordReserved) this.options.release(record.bytes.byteLength);
3975 +      await this.dispose();
3976 +      throw error;
3977 +    }
3978 +  }
3979 +
3980 +  async finish(exitCode: number): Promise<CompletionSpoolManifest> {
3981 +    if (this.terminal) throw new Error("Completion spool is already terminal");
3982 +    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(exitCode) || exitCode < 0)
3983 +      throw new Error("Invalid command exit code");
3984 +    try {
3985 +      await this.file?.sync();
3986 +      await this.closeFile();
3987 +      this.terminal = true;
3988 +      this.manifest = {
3989 +        transferId: this.options.identity.transferId,
3990 +        requestId: this.options.requestId,
3991 +        instanceId: this.options.identity.instanceId,
3992 +        exitCode,
3993 +        rawBytes: this.rawBytes,
3994 +        recordCount: this.recordCount,
3995 +        sha256: this.hash.digest("hex"),
3996 +      };
3997 +      this.options.complete();
3998 +      return this.manifest;
3999 +    } catch (error) {
4000 +      this.terminal = true;
4001 +      return this.disposeAfterFailure(error);
4002 +    }
4003 +  }
4004 +
4005 +  async *read(offset: number): AsyncIterable<CommandOutputRecord> {
4006 +    if (!this.terminal || this.manifest === undefined) {
4007 +      throw new Error("Completion spool is not complete");
4008 +    }
4009 +    if (!Number.isSafeInteger(offset) || offset < 0 || offset > this.recordCount) {
4010 +      throw new Error("Invalid completion spool offset");
4011 +    }
4012 +    try {
4013 +      const records =
4014 +        this.filePath === undefined
4015 +          ? this.inlineRecords
4016 +          : this.options.storage.records(this.filePath, this.options.maximumChunkBytes);
4017 +      for await (const record of records) {
4018 +        if (record.sequence >= offset) yield record;
4019 +      }
4020 +    } catch (error) {
4021 +      throw new CompletionSpoolReadError(error);
4022 +    }
4023 +  }
4024 +
4025 +  async acknowledge(): Promise<void> {
4026 +    if (!this.terminal) throw new Error("Completion spool is not complete");
4027 +    await this.dispose();
4028 +  }
4029 +
4030 +  async dispose(): Promise<void> {
4031 +    if (this.cleanupFinished) return;
4032 +    if (this.disposal !== undefined) return this.disposal;
4033 +    this.disposal = this.performDispose();
4034 +    try {
4035 +      await this.disposal;
4036 +    } finally {
4037 +      this.disposal = undefined;
4038 +    }
4039 +  }
4040 +
4041 +  private async failCapacity(): Promise<never> {
4042 +    await this.dispose();
4043 +    throw new CompletionSpoolCapacityError();
4044 +  }
4045 +
4046 +  private async spillInlineRecords(): Promise<void> {
4047 +    const instanceDirectory = join(this.options.directory, this.options.identity.instanceId);
4048 +    await this.options.storage.ensureDirectory(this.options.directory);
4049 +    await this.options.storage.ensureDirectory(instanceDirectory);
4050 +    this.filePath = join(instanceDirectory, `${this.options.identity.transferId}.spool`);
4051 +    this.file = await this.options.storage.createFile(this.filePath);
4052 +    for (const record of this.inlineRecords) {
4053 +      await this.file.write(CompletionSpoolRecordCodec.encode(record));
4054 +    }
4055 +    this.inlineRecords.length = 0;
4056 +  }
4057 +
4058 +  private async closeFile(): Promise<void> {
4059 +    if (this.file === undefined) return;
4060 +    await this.file.close();
4061 +    this.file = undefined;
4062 +  }
4063 +
4064 +  private async performDispose(): Promise<void> {
4065 +    this.terminal = true;
4066 +    let cleanupError: unknown;
4067 +    try {
4068 +      await this.closeFile();
4069 +    } catch (error) {
4070 +      cleanupError = error;
4071 +    }
4072 +    if (this.filePath !== undefined) {
4073 +      try {
4074 +        await this.options.storage.unlink(this.filePath);
4075 +        this.filePath = undefined;
4076 +      } catch (error) {
4077 +        if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code === "ENOENT") this.filePath = undefined;
4078 +        else cleanupError ??= error;
4079 +      }
4080 +    }
4081 +    this.releaseOwnership();
4082 +    if (this.file === undefined && this.filePath === undefined) {
4083 +      this.cleanupFinished = true;
4084 +      this.options.cleanupComplete();
4085 +    }
4086 +    if (cleanupError !== undefined) throw cleanupError;
4087 +  }
4088 +
4089 +  private releaseOwnership(): void {
4090 +    if (this.ownershipReleased) return;
4091 +    this.ownershipReleased = true;
4092 +    this.inlineRecords.length = 0;
4093 +    this.options.release(this.rawBytes);
4094 +    this.options.releaseCompletion();
4095 +    this.options.remove();
4096 +  }
4097 +
4098 +  private async disposeAfterFailure(error: unknown): Promise<never> {
4099 +    try {
4100 +      await this.dispose();
4101 +    } catch (cleanupError) {
4102 +      throw new AggregateError(
4103 +        [error, cleanupError],
4104 +        "Completion spool operation and cleanup failed",
4105 +      );
4106 +    }
4107 +    throw error;
4108 +  }
4109 +}

4111 +export class DaemonCompletionSpoolStore {
4112 +  private readonly spools = new Map<string, CompletionSpool>();
4113 +  private readonly inlineBytes: number;
4114 +  private readonly maximumResultBytes: number;
4115 +  private readonly maximumAggregateBytes: number;
4116 +  private readonly maximumChunkBytes: number;
4117 +  private readonly storage: CompletionSpoolStorage;
4118 +  private rawBytes = 0;
4119 +  private completionCount = 0;
4120 +  private readonly pendingCleanup = new Set<CompletionSpool>();
4121 +
4122 +  constructor(private readonly options: DaemonCompletionSpoolStoreOptions) {
4123 +    DaemonCompletionSpoolStore.validateIdentity(options.instanceId);
4124 +    const policy = options.policy;
4125 +    this.maximumChunkBytes = policy.maximumChunkRawBytes;
4126 +    this.inlineBytes = policy.inlineRawBytes;
4127 +    this.maximumResultBytes = policy.maximumResultRawBytes;
4128 +    this.maximumAggregateBytes = policy.maximumAggregateSpoolRawBytes;
4129 +    this.storage = options.storage ?? new NodeCompletionSpoolStorage();
4130 +  }
4131 +
4132 +  async create(requestId: string): Promise<CompletionSpool> {
4133 +    if (this.spools.has(requestId))
4134 +      throw new Error(`Completion spool already exists: ${requestId}`);
4135 +    let completionCounted = false;
4136 +    const spool = new CompletionSpool({
4137 +      directory: this.options.directory,
4138 +      identity: {
4139 +        workspaceKey: this.options.workspaceKey,
4140 +        instanceId: this.options.instanceId,
4141 +        transferId: randomUUID(),
4142 +      },
4143 +      requestId,
4144 +      inlineBytes: this.inlineBytes,
4145 +      maximumResultBytes: this.maximumResultBytes,
4146 +      maximumChunkBytes: this.maximumChunkBytes,
4147 +      reserve: (bytes) => this.reserve(bytes),
4148 +      release: (bytes) => {
4149 +        this.rawBytes -= bytes;
4150 +      },
4151 +      complete: () => {
4152 +        completionCounted = true;
4153 +        this.completionCount += 1;
4154 +      },
4155 +      remove: () => {
4156 +        if (this.spools.get(requestId) !== spool) return;
4157 +        this.spools.delete(requestId);
4158 +      },
4159 +      releaseCompletion: () => {
4160 +        if (completionCounted) this.completionCount -= 1;
4161 +        completionCounted = false;
4162 +      },
4163 +      cleanupComplete: () => {
4164 +        this.pendingCleanup.delete(spool);
4165 +      },
4166 +      storage: this.storage,
4167 +    });
4168 +    this.spools.set(requestId, spool);
4169 +    this.pendingCleanup.add(spool);
4170 +    return spool;
4171 +  }
4172 +
4173 +  async open(requestId: string): Promise<CompletionSpool | undefined> {
4174 +    return this.spools.get(requestId);
4175 +  }
4176 +
4177 +  usage(): CompletionSpoolUsage {
4178 +    return { rawBytes: this.rawBytes, completionCount: this.completionCount };
4179 +  }
4180 +
4181 +  async cleanupInstance(instanceId: string): Promise<void> {
4182 +    if (instanceId !== this.options.instanceId) return;
4183 +    const failures: unknown[] = [];
4184 +    for (const spool of [...this.pendingCleanup]) {
4185 +      await spool.dispose().catch((error) => failures.push(error));
4186 +    }
4187 +    await this.storage
4188 +      .removeInstance(join(this.options.directory, instanceId))
4189 +      .catch((error) => failures.push(error));
4190 +    if (failures.length > 0) throw new AggregateError(failures, "Completion spool cleanup failed");
4191 +  }
4192 +
4193 +  async cleanupConfirmedDeadInstance(instanceId: string): Promise<void> {
4194 +    await this.cleanupInstance(instanceId);
4195 +  }
4196 +
4197 +  private reserve(bytes: number): void {
4198 +    if (this.rawBytes + bytes > this.maximumAggregateBytes) {
4199 +      throw new CompletionSpoolCapacityError();
4200 +    }
4201 +    this.rawBytes += bytes;
4202 +  }
4203 +
4204 +  private static validateIdentity(instanceId: string): void {
4205 +    if (!/^[A-Za-z\d_-]+$/.test(instanceId)) throw new Error("Invalid completion spool instance");
4206 +  }
4207 +}

4344 +export class DaemonDeliverySession {

4358 +
4359 +  beginAcceptedTrace(
4360 +    requestId: string,

4383 +  async attach(attachment: DaemonDeliveryAttachment, send: DaemonServerSend): Promise<void> {

4426 +
4427 +  trackedCompletion(requestId: string): Promise<void> | undefined {

4430 +
4431 +  async fetch(

4505 +  private retainedOperationTrace(

4516 +  private async deliverStoredCompletion(

4541 +  private trackCompletionDelivery(

4557 +  private async deliverCompletion(
4558 +    requestId: string,
4559 +    spool: CompletionSpool,

4561 +    send: DaemonServerSend,

4573 +        transferId: completedManifest.transferId,
4574 +        requestId,
4575 +        offset: record.sequence,
4576 +        sequence: record.sequence,
4577 +        stream: record.stream,
4578 +        bytes: record.bytes,
4579 +      });
4580 +    }
4581 +    await this.deliver(send, {
4582 +      kind: "result-end",
4583 +      ...this.options.coordinates,
4584 +      requestId,
4585 +      transferId: completedManifest.transferId,

4592 +
4593 +  private failedFrame(

4601 +      code,

4604 +
4605 +  private recordDeliveryFailure(

4625 +
4626 +  private completeOperationTrace(requestId: string, outcome: DaemonDeliveryOutcome): void {

4634 +
4635 +  private terminateOperationDelivery(requestId: string, outcome: DaemonDeliveryOutcome): void {

4642 +  private disconnectOperationTrace(requestId: string): void {
4643 +    if (this.operationTraceExpirations.has(requestId)) return;
4644 +    const trace = this.operationTraces.get(requestId);
4645 +    if (trace === undefined) return;
4646 +    trace.clientDisconnected();

4655 +
4656 +  private attachOperationTraceConnection(requestId: string, send: DaemonServerSend): () => void {
4657 +    const connectionCount = this.operationTraceConnections.get(requestId) ?? 0;
4658 +    if (connectionCount === 0) {
4659 +      const expiration = this.operationTraceExpirations.get(requestId);
4660 +      if (expiration !== undefined) clearTimeout(expiration);
4661 +      this.operationTraceExpirations.delete(requestId);
4662 +    }
4663 +    this.operationTraceConnections.set(requestId, connectionCount + 1);
4664 +    let connectionClosed = false;
4665 +    const disconnect = (): void => {
4666 +      if (connectionClosed) return;
4667 +      connectionClosed = true;
4668 +      const remainingConnections = (this.operationTraceConnections.get(requestId) ?? 1) - 1;
4669 +      if (remainingConnections > 0) {
4670 +        this.operationTraceConnections.set(requestId, remainingConnections);
4671 +        return;
4672 +      }
4673 +      this.operationTraceConnections.delete(requestId);
4674 +      this.disconnectOperationTrace(requestId);
4675 +    };

4694 +  private expireOperationTrace(requestId: string): void {

4701 +  private enforceOperationTraceCapacity(): void {

4706 +        | undefined;
4707 +      if (oldestRequestId === undefined) return;
4708 +      const expiration = this.operationTraceExpirations.get(oldestRequestId);
4709 +      if (expiration !== undefined) clearTimeout(expiration);
4710 +      this.expireOperationTrace(oldestRequestId);
4711 +    }
4712 +  }

4715 +class RetainedDaemonOperationTrace implements DaemonOperationTrace {
4716 +  constructor(
4717 +    private readonly trace: DaemonOperationTrace,
4718 +    private readonly retained: () => boolean,
4719 +  ) {}
4720 +
4721 +  accepted(queueDepth: number, generation: number): void {
4722 +    if (this.retained()) this.trace.accepted(queueDepth, generation);
4723 +  }
4724 +
4725 +  turnStarted(generation: number): void {
4726 +    if (this.retained()) this.trace.turnStarted(generation);
4727 +  }
4728 +
4729 +  workerCompleted(durations: DaemonWorkerPhaseDurations, refresh: DaemonRefreshSummary): void {
4730 +    if (this.retained()) this.trace.workerCompleted(durations, refresh);
4731 +  }
4732 +
4733 +  spooled(manifest: CompletionSpoolManifest, durationMs: number): void {
4734 +    if (this.retained()) this.trace.spooled(manifest, durationMs);
4735 +  }
4736 +
4737 +  executionTerminated(outcome: DaemonExecutionOutcome): void {
4738 +    if (this.retained()) this.trace.executionTerminated(outcome);
4739 +  }
4740 +
4741 +  clientDisconnected(): void {
4742 +    if (this.retained()) this.trace.clientDisconnected();
4743 +  }
4744 +
4745 +  reattached(): void {
4746 +    if (this.retained()) this.trace.reattached();
4747 +  }
4748 +
4749 +  deliveryTerminated(outcome: DaemonDeliveryOutcome): void {
4750 +    if (this.retained()) this.trace.deliveryTerminated(outcome);
4751 +  }
4752 +}

4754 +class ObservedDaemonCompletionWriter implements DaemonCompletionWriter {
4755 +  constructor(
4756 +    private readonly spool: CompletionSpool,
4757 +    private readonly trace: DaemonOperationTrace | undefined,
4758 +    private readonly clock: Pick<DaemonClock, "monotonicNowMs">,
4759 +  ) {}
4760 +
4761 +  append(record: DaemonSequencedOutputRecord): Promise<void> {
4762 +    return this.spool.append(record);
4763 +  }
4764 +
4765 +  async finish(exitCode: number): Promise<CompletionSpoolManifest> {
4766 +    const startedAt = this.clock.monotonicNowMs();
4767 +    const manifest = await this.spool.finish(exitCode);
4768 +    const durationMs = Math.max(0, this.clock.monotonicNowMs() - startedAt);
4769 +    this.trace?.spooled(manifest, durationMs);
4770 +    return manifest;
4771 +  }
4772 +
4773 +  dispose(): Promise<void> {
4774 +    return this.spool.dispose();
4775 +  }
4776 +}

4927 +  ["terminationReason", new Set(["uncaught-exception", "unhandled-rejection", "signal"])],
4928 +  ["signal", new Set(["SIGTERM", "SIGINT", "SIGHUP"])],
4929 +]);

4965 +export interface DaemonLogStorage {
4966 +  prepare(directory: string, logPath: string): Promise<void>;
4967 +  size(path: string): Promise<number>;
4968 +  append(path: string, line: string): Promise<void>;
4969 +  move(source: string, destination: string): Promise<void>;
4970 +  remove(path: string): Promise<void>;
4971 +  sync(path: string): Promise<void>;
4972 +}
4973 +
4974 +interface DaemonLoggerOptions {
4975 +  readonly policy: DaemonPolicyValues["diagnostics"];
4976 +  readonly storage?: DaemonLogStorage;
4977 +}
4978 +
4979 +class NodeDaemonLogStorage implements DaemonLogStorage {
4980 +  async prepare(directory: string, logPath: string): Promise<void> {
4981 +    await mkdir(directory, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
4982 +    await chmod(directory, 0o700);
4983 +    await appendFile(logPath, "", { encoding: "utf8", flag: "a", mode: 0o600 });
4984 +    await chmod(logPath, 0o600);
4985 +  }
4986 +
4987 +  async size(path: string): Promise<number> {
4988 +    try {
4989 +      return (await stat(path)).size;
4990 +    } catch (error) {
4991 +      if (NodeDaemonLogStorage.errorCode(error) === "ENOENT") return 0;
4992 +      throw error;
4993 +    }
4994 +  }
4995 +
4996 +  append(path: string, line: string): Promise<void> {
4997 +    return appendFile(path, line, { encoding: "utf8", flag: "a", mode: 0o600 });
4998 +  }
4999 +
5000 +  async move(source: string, destination: string): Promise<void> {
5001 +    try {
5002 +      await rename(source, destination);
5003 +    } catch (error) {
5004 +      if (NodeDaemonLogStorage.errorCode(error) !== "ENOENT") throw error;
5005 +    }
5006 +  }
5007 +
5008 +  remove(path: string): Promise<void> {
5009 +    return rm(path, { force: true });
5010 +  }
5011 +
5012 +  async sync(path: string): Promise<void> {
5013 +    let file;
5014 +    try {
5015 +      file = await open(path, "r");
5016 +      await file.sync();
5017 +    } catch (error) {
5018 +      if (NodeDaemonLogStorage.errorCode(error) !== "ENOENT") throw error;
5019 +    } finally {
5020 +      await file?.close();
5021 +    }
5022 +  }
5023 +
5024 +  private static errorCode(error: unknown): string | undefined {
5025 +    return typeof error === "object" && error !== null && "code" in error
5026 +      ? String(error.code)
5027 +      : undefined;
5028 +  }
5029 +}

5031 +export class DaemonLogger {
5032 +  private readonly rotateBytes: number;
5033 +  private readonly maximumQueuedEvents: number;
5034 +  private readonly backupCount: number;
5035 +  private readonly storage: DaemonLogStorage;
5036 +  private readonly pendingLines: string[] = [];
5037 +  private droppedCount = 0;
5038 +  private drainOperation: Promise<void> | undefined;
5039 +  private closed = false;
5040 +
5041 +  constructor(
5042 +    private readonly identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity,
5043 +    private readonly instanceId: string,
5044 +    private readonly clock: DaemonClock,
5045 +    options: DaemonLoggerOptions,
5046 +  ) {
5047 +    const policy = options.policy;
5048 +    this.rotateBytes = policy.logRotateBytes;
5049 +    this.maximumQueuedEvents = policy.maximumQueuedEvents;
5050 +    this.backupCount = policy.logBackupCount;
5051 +    this.storage = options.storage ?? new NodeDaemonLogStorage();
5052 +  }
5053 +
5054 +  record(event: DaemonDiagnosticEvent): void {
5055 +    try {
5056 +      if (this.closed) return;
5057 +      const line = this.serialize(event);
5058 +      if (line === undefined) return;
5059 +      if (this.pendingLines.length >= this.maximumQueuedEvents) {
5060 +        this.droppedCount += 1;
5061 +        return;
5062 +      }
5063 +      this.pendingLines.push(line);
5064 +      this.startDrain();
5065 +    } catch {
5066 +      return;
5067 +    }
5068 +  }
5069 +
5070 +  async flush(): Promise<void> {
5071 +    while (
5072 +      this.drainOperation !== undefined ||
5073 +      this.pendingLines.length > 0 ||
5074 +      this.droppedCount > 0
5075 +    ) {
5076 +      this.startDrain();
5077 +      await this.drainOperation;
5078 +    }
5079 +    await this.storage.sync(this.identity.logPath).catch(() => undefined);
5080 +  }
5081 +
5082 +  async close(): Promise<void> {
5083 +    this.closed = true;
5084 +    await this.flush();
5085 +  }
5086 +
5087 +  static errorName(error: unknown): DaemonDiagnosticErrorName {
5088 +    const name =
5089 +      error instanceof Error
5090 +        ? error.name
5091 +        : typeof error === "object" && error !== null && "name" in error
5092 +          ? error.name
5093 +          : undefined;
5094 +    return ERROR_NAMES.has(name as DaemonDiagnosticErrorName)
5095 +      ? (name as DaemonDiagnosticErrorName)
5096 +      : "UnknownError";
5097 +  }
5098 +
5099 +  private static closedEvent(event: DaemonDiagnosticEvent): Record<string, unknown> | undefined {
5100 +    const diagnostic = event as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
5101 +    if (!DIAGNOSTIC_KINDS.has(String(diagnostic.kind))) return undefined;
5102 +    const closed: Record<string, unknown> = { ...diagnostic };
5103 +    if ("command" in closed && !DaemonRuntimeValues.isCommandName(closed.command)) {
5104 +      closed.command = "unknown";
5105 +    }
5106 +    if ("errorName" in closed && !ERROR_NAMES.has(closed.errorName as DaemonDiagnosticErrorName)) {
5107 +      closed.errorName = "UnknownError";
5108 +    }
5109 +    if (
5110 +      "failureCode" in closed &&
5111 +      closed.failureCode !== "operation-failed" &&
5112 +      !DaemonExecutionFailures.isCode(closed.failureCode)
5113 +    ) {
5114 +      return undefined;
5115 +    }
5116 +    for (const [field, values] of CLOSED_DIAGNOSTIC_VALUES) {
5117 +      if (field in closed && !values.has(String(closed[field]))) return undefined;
5118 +    }
5119 +    for (const field of NUMERIC_DIAGNOSTIC_FIELDS) {
5120 +      if (!(field in closed)) continue;
5121 +      const value = closed[field];
5122 +      if (typeof value !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) return undefined;
5123 +    }
5124 +    if ("force" in closed && typeof closed.force !== "boolean") return undefined;
5125 +    if (closed.kind === "process-termination") {
5126 +      const isSignal = closed.terminationReason === "signal";
5127 +      if (isSignal !== (closed.signal !== undefined)) return undefined;
5128 +      if (isSignal === (closed.errorName !== undefined)) return undefined;
5129 +    }
5130 +    return closed;
5131 +  }
5132 +
5133 +  private serialize(event: DaemonDiagnosticEvent): string | undefined {
5134 +    const diagnostic = DaemonLogger.closedEvent(event);
5135 +    if (diagnostic === undefined) return undefined;
5136 +    if ("requestId" in diagnostic) {
5137 +      if (typeof diagnostic.requestId !== "string") return undefined;
5138 +      diagnostic.requestId = this.requestCorrelation(diagnostic.requestId);
5139 +    }
5140 +    return `${JSON.stringify(
5141 +      {
5142 +        ...diagnostic,
5143 +        schemaVersion: DAEMON_DIAGNOSTIC_SCHEMA_VERSION,
5144 +        timestamp: this.clock.wallNowMs(),
5145 +        instanceId: this.instanceId,
5146 +        workspaceKey: this.identity.workspaceKey,
5147 +      },
5148 +      [...DIAGNOSTIC_FIELDS],
5149 +    )}\n`;
5150 +  }
5151 +
5152 +  private requestCorrelation(requestId: string): string {
5153 +    return createHash("sha256")
5154 +      .update(this.identity.workspaceKey)
5155 +      .update("\0")
5156 +      .update(requestId)
5157 +      .digest("hex");
5158 +  }
5159 +
5160 +  private startDrain(): void {
5161 +    if (this.drainOperation !== undefined) return;
5162 +    const operation = this.drain();
5163 +    this.drainOperation = operation.finally(() => {
5164 +      this.drainOperation = undefined;
5165 +      if (this.pendingLines.length > 0 || this.droppedCount > 0) this.startDrain();
5166 +    });
5167 +  }
5168 +
5169 +  private async drain(): Promise<void> {
5170 +    const logDirectory = dirname(this.identity.logPath);
5171 +    let currentBytes: number;
5172 +    try {
5173 +      await this.storage.prepare(logDirectory, this.identity.logPath);
5174 +      currentBytes = await this.storage.size(this.identity.logPath);
5175 +    } catch {
5176 +      this.pendingLines.length = 0;
5177 +      this.droppedCount = 0;
5178 +      return;
5179 +    }
5180 +    while (this.pendingLines.length > 0 || this.droppedCount > 0) {
5181 +      if (this.pendingLines.length === 0) {
5182 +        const droppedCount = this.droppedCount;
5183 +        this.droppedCount = 0;
5184 +        const dropped = this.serialize({ kind: "diagnostics-dropped", droppedCount });
5185 +        if (dropped !== undefined) this.pendingLines.push(dropped);
5186 +      }
5187 +      const line = this.pendingLines.shift();
5188 +      if (line === undefined) continue;
5189 +      const lineBytes = Buffer.byteLength(line);
5190 +      try {
5191 +        if (currentBytes + lineBytes > this.rotateBytes) {
5192 +          await this.rotate();
5193 +          await this.storage.prepare(logDirectory, this.identity.logPath);
5194 +          currentBytes = 0;
5195 +        }
5196 +        await this.storage.append(this.identity.logPath, line);
5197 +        currentBytes += lineBytes;
5198 +      } catch {
5199 +        continue;
5200 +      }
5201 +    }
5202 +  }
5203 +
5204 +  private async rotate(): Promise<void> {
5205 +    await this.storage.remove(`${this.identity.logPath}.${this.backupCount}`);
5206 +    for (let index = this.backupCount - 1; index >= 1; index -= 1) {
5207 +      await this.storage.move(
5208 +        `${this.identity.logPath}.${index}`,
5209 +        `${this.identity.logPath}.${index + 1}`,
5210 +      );
5211 +    }
5212 +    await this.storage.move(this.identity.logPath, `${this.identity.logPath}.1`);
5213 +  }
5214 +}

5240 +import type { CompletionSpoolManifest } from "../delivery/completion-spool.js";
5241 +import type { DaemonClock } from "../lifecycle/daemon-clock.js";

5255 +export type {

5266 +export interface DaemonOperationTrace {
5267 +  accepted(queueDepth: number, generation: number): void;
5268 +  turnStarted(generation: number): void;
5269 +  workerCompleted(durations: DaemonWorkerPhaseDurations, refresh: DaemonRefreshSummary): void;
5270 +  spooled(manifest: CompletionSpoolManifest, durationMs: number): void;
5271 +  executionTerminated(outcome: DaemonExecutionOutcome): void;
5272 +  clientDisconnected(): void;

5277 +interface DaemonDiagnosticRecorder {

5280 +
5281 +interface DaemonOperationResources {
5282 +  readonly snapshot: {
5283 +    readonly processRssBytes: number;
5284 +    readonly peakProcessRssBytes: number;

5291 +export class DaemonOperationObserver {
5292 +  constructor(
5293 +    private readonly logger: DaemonDiagnosticRecorder,
5294 +    private readonly clock: DaemonClock,
5295 +    private readonly resources?: DaemonOperationResources,
5296 +  ) {}
5297 +
5298 +  startup(event: DaemonStartupDiagnostic): void {
5299 +    this.logger.record(event);
5300 +  }
5301 +
5302 +  worker(event: DaemonWorkerDiagnostic): void {
5303 +    this.logger.record(event);
5304 +  }
5305 +
5306 +  shutdown(event: DaemonShutdownDiagnostic): void {
5307 +    this.logger.record(event);
5308 +  }
5309 +
5310 +  reattached(requestId: string): void {
5311 +    this.logger.record({ kind: "client-reattached", requestId });
5312 +  }
5313 +
5314 +  traceExpired(requestId: string): void {
5315 +    this.logger.record({ kind: "operation-trace-expired", requestId });
5316 +  }
5317 +
5318 +  deliveryTerminated(requestId: string, outcome: DaemonDeliveryOutcome, deliveryMs: number): void {
5319 +    this.logger.record({ kind: "delivery-terminal", requestId, outcome, deliveryMs });
5320 +  }
5321 +
5322 +  start(requestId: string, command: DaemonCommandName): DaemonOperationTrace {
5323 +    const acceptedAt = this.clock.monotonicNowMs();
5324 +    let turnStartedAt: number | undefined;
5325 +    let deliveryStartedAt: number | undefined;
5326 +    let executionTerminal = false;
5327 +    let deliveryTerminal = false;
5328 +    return {
5329 +      accepted: (queueDepth, generation) => {
5330 +        this.logger.record({
5331 +          kind: "request-accepted",
5332 +          requestId,
5333 +          command,
5334 +          queueDepth,
5335 +          workerGeneration: generation,
5336 +        });
5337 +      },
5338 +      turnStarted: (generation) => {
5339 +        turnStartedAt = this.clock.monotonicNowMs();
5340 +        this.logger.record({
5341 +          kind: "turn-started",
5342 +          requestId,
5343 +          queueWaitMs: DaemonOperationObserver.elapsed(acceptedAt, turnStartedAt),
5344 +          workerGeneration: generation,
5345 +        });
5346 +      },
5347 +      workerCompleted: (durations, refresh) => {
5348 +        this.logger.record({ kind: "worker-completed", requestId, ...durations, ...refresh });
5349 +      },
5350 +      spooled: (manifest, durationMs) => {
5351 +        this.logger.record({
5352 +          kind: "response-spooled",
5353 +          requestId,
5354 +          rawBytes: manifest.rawBytes,
5355 +          recordCount: manifest.recordCount,
5356 +          spoolMs: Math.max(0, durationMs),
5357 +        });
5358 +      },
5359 +      executionTerminated: (outcome) => {
5360 +        if (executionTerminal) return;
5361 +        executionTerminal = true;
5362 +        deliveryStartedAt = this.clock.monotonicNowMs();
5363 +        const resources = this.resources?.snapshot;
5364 +        this.logger.record({
5365 +          kind: "execution-terminal",
5366 +          requestId,
5367 +          outcome,
5368 +          serviceMs: DaemonOperationObserver.elapsed(
5369 +            turnStartedAt ?? deliveryStartedAt,
5370 +            deliveryStartedAt,
5371 +          ),
5372 +          ...(resources === undefined
5373 +            ? {}
5374 +            : {
5375 +                processRssBytes: resources.processRssBytes,
5376 +                peakProcessRssBytes: resources.peakProcessRssBytes,
5377 +                ...(resources.peakWorkerHeapUsedBytes === undefined
5378 +                  ? {}
5379 +                  : { peakWorkerHeapUsedBytes: resources.peakWorkerHeapUsedBytes }),
5380 +                ...(resources.workerHeapUsedBytes === undefined
5381 +                  ? {}
5382 +                  : { workerHeapUsedBytes: resources.workerHeapUsedBytes }),
5383 +                spoolBytes: resources.spoolBytes,
5384 +              }),
5385 +        });
5386 +      },
5387 +      clientDisconnected: () => {
5388 +        this.logger.record({ kind: "client-disconnected", requestId });
5389 +      },
5390 +      reattached: () => {
5391 +        this.reattached(requestId);
5392 +      },
5393 +      deliveryTerminated: (outcome) => {
5394 +        if (deliveryTerminal) return;
5395 +        deliveryTerminal = true;
5396 +        const completedAt = this.clock.monotonicNowMs();
5397 +        this.deliveryTerminated(
5398 +          requestId,
5399 +          outcome,
5400 +          DaemonOperationObserver.elapsed(deliveryStartedAt ?? completedAt, completedAt),
5401 +        );
5402 +      },
5403 +    };
5404 +  }
5405 +
5406 +  private static elapsed(startedAt: number, completedAt: number): number {
5407 +    return Math.max(0, completedAt - startedAt);
5408 +  }
5409 +}

5422 +class EntryExportInventory {
5423 +  static namedExports(path: string): readonly string[] {
5424 +    const source = readFileSync(path, "utf8");
5425 +    const sourceFile = ts.createSourceFile(path, source, ts.ScriptTarget.Latest, true);
5426 +    return sourceFile.statements.flatMap((statement) =>
5427 +      EntryExportInventory.exportsName(statement) ? [statement.getText(sourceFile)] : [],
5428 +    );
5429 +  }
5430 +
5431 +  private static exportsName(statement: ts.Statement): boolean {
5432 +    if (ts.isExportAssignment(statement) || ts.isNamespaceExportDeclaration(statement)) return true;
5433 +    if (ts.isExportDeclaration(statement)) {
5434 +      if (statement.exportClause === undefined || ts.isNamespaceExport(statement.exportClause)) {
5435 +        return true;
5436 +      }
5437 +      return statement.exportClause.elements.length > 0;
5438 +    }
5439 +    return (
5440 +      ts.canHaveModifiers(statement) &&
5441 +      (ts
5442 +        .getModifiers(statement)
5443 +        ?.some(
5444 +          (modifier) =>
5445 +            modifier.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ExportKeyword ||
5446 +            modifier.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.DefaultKeyword,
5447 +        ) ??
5448 +        false)
5449 +    );
5450 +  }
5451 +}

5459 +      expect(
5460 +        EntryExportInventory.namedExports(join(packageDirectory, "src", `${entry}.ts`)),
5461 +      ).toEqual([]);
5462 +      expect(
5463 +        EntryExportInventory.namedExports(join(packageDirectory, "dist", `${entry}.d.ts`)),
5464 +      ).toEqual([]);
5465 +    },
5466 +  );
5467 +});

5603 +export class AcceptedExecutionSession {
5604 +  private lastNavigationAt: number | undefined;
5605 +  private lastCompletedMonotonicAt: number | undefined;
5606 +  private readonly resourceInterruptedRequests = new Set<string>();
5607 +
5608 +  constructor(private readonly options: AcceptedExecutionSessionOptions) {}
5609 +
5610 +  get snapshot(): AcceptedExecutionSnapshot {
5611 +    return Object.freeze({
5612 +      queue: this.options.queue.snapshot,
5613 +      ...(this.lastNavigationAt === undefined ? {} : { lastNavigationAt: this.lastNavigationAt }),
5614 +      ...(this.lastCompletedMonotonicAt === undefined
5615 +        ? {}
5616 +        : { lastCompletedMonotonicAt: this.lastCompletedMonotonicAt }),
5617 +    });
5618 +  }
5619 +
5620 +  compatibilityFor(request: DaemonExecuteRequest): AcceptedRequestCompatibility {
5621 +    return this.options.ledger.compatibilityFor(
5622 +      request.requestId,
5623 +      request.commandName,
5624 +      request.request,
5625 +    );
5626 +  }
5627 +
5628 +  accept(request: AuthenticatedDaemonExecuteRequest): AcceptedExecutionAdmission {
5629 +    const existing = this.options.ledger.entryFor(request.requestId);
5630 +    const entry = this.options.ledger.accept(
5631 +      request.requestId,
5632 +      request.commandName,
5633 +      request.request,
5634 +    );
5635 +    const acceptance = Object.freeze({
5636 +      requestId: request.requestId,
5637 +      acceptedAt: entry.acceptedAt,
5638 +      queuePosition: entry.queuePosition,
5639 +    });
5640 +    if (existing !== undefined) {
5641 +      return Object.freeze({ newlyAccepted: false, entry, acceptance });
5642 +    }
5643 +    this.lastNavigationAt = this.options.clock.wallNowMs();
5644 +    this.options.lifetime.navigationAccepted();
5645 +    const trace = this.options.delivery.beginAcceptedTrace(
5646 +      request.requestId,
5647 +      request.commandName,
5648 +      entry.queuePosition,
5649 +      this.options.resourceSupervisor.snapshot.generation,
5650 +    );
5651 +    void this.executeAccepted(request, trace);
5652 +    return Object.freeze({ newlyAccepted: true, entry, acceptance });
5653 +  }
5654 +
5655 +  status(requestId: string): DaemonExecutionStatus {
5656 +    return this.options.ledger.status(requestId);
5657 +  }
5658 +
5659 +  markActiveResourceInterrupted(cause: DaemonWorkerReplacementCause): void {
5660 +    if (cause === "worker-exit") return;
5661 +    const activeRequest = this.options.queue.snapshot.active;
5662 +    if (activeRequest !== undefined) this.resourceInterruptedRequests.add(activeRequest.requestId);
5663 +  }
5664 +
5665 +  scheduleAtTurnBoundary(operation: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
5666 +    return this.options.queue.scheduleAtTurnBoundary(operation);
5667 +  }
5668 +
5669 +  drain(): Promise<void> {
5670 +    return this.options.queue.drain();
5671 +  }
5672 +
5673 +  close(): void {
5674 +    this.options.queue.close();
5675 +  }
5676 +
5677 +  private async executeAccepted(
5678 +    request: AuthenticatedDaemonExecuteRequest,
5679 +    trace: DaemonOperationTrace,
5680 +  ): Promise<void> {
5681 +    let completion: DaemonCompletionWriter | undefined;
5682 +    try {
5683 +      await this.options.queue.enqueue(
5684 +        {
5685 +          requestId: request.requestId,
5686 +          command: request.commandName,
5687 +          acceptedAt: this.options.clock.monotonicNowMs(),
5688 +        },
5689 +        async () => {
5690 +          trace.turnStarted(this.options.resourceSupervisor.snapshot.generation);
5691 +          try {
5692 +            completion = await this.options.delivery.createCompletion(request.requestId);
5693 +            this.options.ledger.markRunning(request.requestId, this.options.clock.wallNowMs());
5694 +            const response = await this.options.worker.execute(
5695 +              request.requestId,
5696 +              { commandName: request.commandName, request: request.request },
5697 +              completion,
5698 +            );
5699 +            this.options.resourceSupervisor.workerHeapReported(
5700 +              response.generation,
5701 +              response.resources.workerHeapUsedBytes,
5702 +              response.resources.workerHeapLimitBytes,
5703 +              response.resources.peakWorkerHeapUsedBytes,
5704 +            );
5705 +            trace.workerCompleted(
5706 +              {
5707 +                freshnessMs: response.durations.freshnessMs,
5708 +                navigationMs: response.durations.navigationMs,
5709 +                renderMs: response.durations.renderMs,
5710 +                workerOutputMs: response.durations.outputMs,
5711 +              },
5712 +              response.refresh,
5713 +            );
5714 +            await completion.finish(response.result.exitCode);
5715 +            this.lastCompletedMonotonicAt = this.options.clock.monotonicNowMs();
5716 +            const workspaceExists = await this.options.processLifecycle.workspaceExists();
5717 +            trace.executionTerminated("completed");
5718 +            this.options.ledger.complete(
5719 +              request.requestId,
5720 +              request.requestId,
5721 +              this.options.clock.wallNowMs(),
5722 +            );
5723 +            await this.options.delivery.trackedCompletion(request.requestId);
5724 +            if (!workspaceExists) {
5725 +              await this.options.processLifecycle.workspaceDeletedAfterDelivery();
5726 +            }
5727 +          } finally {
5728 +            this.scheduleTurnCompleteResourceSample();
5729 +          }
5730 +        },
5731 +      );
5732 +    } catch (error) {
5733 +      trace.executionTerminated("failed");
5734 +      this.recordFailure("request", "internal", error);
5735 +      const shutdown = this.options.processLifecycle.shutdownSnapshot();
5736 +      const code = DaemonExecutionFailures.classify({
5737 +        resourceInterrupted: this.resourceInterruptedRequests.delete(request.requestId),
5738 +        responseCapacityExceeded: error instanceof CompletionSpoolCapacityError,
5739 +        workerExited: error instanceof DaemonNavigationWorkerExitedError,
5740 +        ...(shutdown.failureCode === undefined
5741 +          ? {}
5742 +          : { shutdownFailureCode: shutdown.failureCode }),
5743 +        shutdownStarted: shutdown.started,
5744 +      });
5745 +      await completion?.dispose().catch((cleanupError) => {
5746 +        this.recordFailure("completion-cleanup", "internal", cleanupError);
5747 +      });
5748 +      this.options.ledger.fail(request.requestId, code, this.options.clock.wallNowMs());
5749 +    } finally {
5750 +      if (this.options.queue.isIdle) this.options.lifetime.queueBecameIdle();
5751 +    }
5752 +  }
5753 +
5754 +  private scheduleTurnCompleteResourceSample(): void {
5755 +    void this.options.queue
5756 +      .scheduleAtTurnBoundary(() => this.options.resourceSupervisor.sampleAtTurnBoundary())
5757 +      .catch((error) => {
5758 +        this.recordFailure("resource-sample", "operation-failed", error);
5759 +      })
5760 +      .finally(() => {
5761 +        if (this.options.queue.isIdle) this.options.lifetime.queueBecameIdle();
5762 +      });
5763 +  }
5764 +
5765 +  private recordFailure(
5766 +    operation: "request" | "completion-cleanup" | "resource-sample",
5767 +    failureCode: "internal" | "operation-failed",
5768 +    error: unknown,
5769 +  ): void {
5770 +    this.options.diagnostics.record({
5771 +      kind: "failure",
5772 +      operation,
5773 +      failureCode,
5774 +      errorName: DaemonLogger.errorName(error),
5775 +    });
5776 +  }
5777 +}

5881 +import { createHash } from "node:crypto";

5890 +import { NodeDaemonClock, type DaemonClock } from "../lifecycle/daemon-clock.js";
5891 +
5892 +export type AcceptedRequestState =
5893 +  | { readonly state: "queued" }
5894 +  | { readonly state: "running"; readonly startedAt: number }
5895 +  | { readonly state: "completed"; readonly completedAt: number; readonly resultId: string }
5896 +  | {
5897 +      readonly state: "failed";
5898 +      readonly completedAt: number;
5899 +      readonly code: DaemonExecutionFailureCode;
5900 +    };
5901 +
5902 +export interface AcceptedRequestEntry {
5903 +  readonly requestId: string;
5904 +  readonly requestFingerprint: string;
5905 +  readonly commandName: DaemonCommandName;
5906 +  readonly request: DaemonExecutorRequest;
5907 +  readonly acceptedAt: number;
5908 +  readonly queuePosition: number;
5909 +  readonly state: AcceptedRequestState;
5910 +  readonly deliveryTerminated: boolean;
5911 +}
5912 +
5913 +export type AcceptedRequestSubscriber = (entry: AcceptedRequestEntry) => void;
5914 +
5915 +export class AcceptedRequestCorruptionError extends Error {
5916 +  constructor(readonly requestId: string) {
5917 +    super(`Accepted request identifier ${requestId} has a different payload`);
5918 +    this.name = "AcceptedRequestCorruptionError";
5919 +  }
5920 +}
5921 +
5922 +export class AcceptedRequestLedger {
5923 +  private readonly entries = new Map<string, AcceptedRequestEntry>();
5924 +  private readonly subscribers = new Map<string, Set<AcceptedRequestSubscriber>>();
5925 +  private readonly acknowledged = new Set<string>();
5926 +
5927 +  constructor(private readonly clock: Pick<DaemonClock, "wallNowMs"> = new NodeDaemonClock()) {}
5928 +
5929 +  get size(): number {
5930 +    return this.entries.size;
5931 +  }
5932 +
5933 +  get hasUnacknowledgedCompletions(): boolean {
5934 +    for (const entry of this.entries.values()) {
5935 +      if (entry.state.state === "completed" && !this.acknowledged.has(entry.requestId)) return true;
5936 +    }
5937 +    return false;
5938 +  }
5939 +
5940 +  compatibilityFor(
5941 +    requestId: string,
5942 +    commandName: DaemonCommandName,
5943 +    request: DaemonExecutorRequest,
5944 +  ): AcceptedRequestCompatibility {
5945 +    const existing = this.entries.get(requestId);
5946 +    if (existing === undefined) return "unseen";
5947 +    const requestFingerprint = AcceptedRequestLedger.fingerprint(commandName, request);
5948 +    return existing.requestFingerprint === requestFingerprint ? "matching" : "conflicting";
5949 +  }
5950 +
5951 +  accept(
5952 +    requestId: string,
5953 +    commandName: DaemonCommandName,
5954 +    request: DaemonExecutorRequest,
5955 +  ): AcceptedRequestEntry {
5956 +    const requestFingerprint = AcceptedRequestLedger.fingerprint(commandName, request);
5957 +    const existing = this.entries.get(requestId);
5958 +    if (existing !== undefined) {
5959 +      if (existing.requestFingerprint !== requestFingerprint) {
5960 +        throw new AcceptedRequestCorruptionError(requestId);
5961 +      }
5962 +      return existing;
5963 +    }
5964 +    const entry: AcceptedRequestEntry = {
5965 +      requestId,
5966 +      requestFingerprint,
5967 +      commandName,
5968 +      request,
5969 +      acceptedAt: this.clock.wallNowMs(),
5970 +      queuePosition: this.nonterminalCount,
5971 +      deliveryTerminated: false,
5972 +      state: { state: "queued" },
5973 +    };
5974 +    this.entries.set(requestId, entry);
5975 +    return entry;
5976 +  }
5977 +
5978 +  markRunning(requestId: string, startedAt: number): AcceptedRequestEntry {
5979 +    const entry = this.transitionable(requestId);
5980 +    if (entry.state.state !== "queued") {
5981 +      throw new Error(`Accepted request ${requestId} is already ${entry.state.state}`);
5982 +    }
5983 +    return this.publish({
5984 +      ...entry,
5985 +      state: { state: "running", startedAt },
5986 +    });
5987 +  }
5988 +
5989 +  complete(requestId: string, resultId: string, completedAt: number): AcceptedRequestEntry {
5990 +    const entry = this.transitionable(requestId);
5991 +    return this.publish({
5992 +      ...entry,
5993 +      state: { state: "completed", completedAt, resultId },
5994 +    });
5995 +  }
5996 +
5997 +  fail(
5998 +    requestId: string,
5999 +    code: DaemonExecutionFailureCode,
6000 +    completedAt: number,
6001 +  ): AcceptedRequestEntry {
6002 +    AcceptedRequestLedger.assertFailureCode(code);
6003 +    const entry = this.transitionable(requestId);
6004 +    return this.publish({
6005 +      ...entry,
6006 +      state: { state: "failed", completedAt, code },
6007 +    });
6008 +  }
6009 +
6010 +  invalidateCompletion(
6011 +    requestId: string,
6012 +    code: DaemonExecutionFailureCode,
6013 +    completedAt: number,
6014 +  ): AcceptedRequestEntry {
6015 +    AcceptedRequestLedger.assertFailureCode(code);
6016 +    const entry = this.entry(requestId);
6017 +    if (entry.state.state === "failed" && entry.state.code === code) return entry;
6018 +    if (entry.state.state !== "completed") {
6019 +      throw new Error(`Accepted request ${requestId} is not completed`);
6020 +    }
6021 +    return this.publish({
6022 +      ...entry,
6023 +      state: { state: "failed", completedAt, code },
6024 +    });
6025 +  }
6026 +
6027 +  private static assertFailureCode(code: unknown): asserts code is DaemonExecutionFailureCode {
6028 +    if (!DaemonExecutionFailures.isCode(code)) {
6029 +      throw new Error("Invalid daemon execution failure code");
6030 +    }
6031 +  }
6032 +
6033 +  status(requestId: string): DaemonExecutionStatus {
6034 +    const entry = this.entries.get(requestId);
6035 +    if (entry === undefined) return { state: "unknown" };
6036 +    const state = entry.state;
6037 +    if (state.state === "queued") {
6038 +      return { state: "queued", queuePosition: entry.queuePosition };
6039 +    }
6040 +    if (state.state === "running") return { state: "running", startedAt: state.startedAt };
6041 +    if (state.state === "completed") return { state: "completed" };
6042 +    return { state: "failed", code: state.code };
6043 +  }
6044 +
6045 +  acknowledge(requestId: string): void {
6046 +    const entry = this.entry(requestId);
6047 +    if (entry.state.state !== "completed" && entry.state.state !== "failed") {
6048 +      throw new Error(`Accepted request ${requestId} is not terminal`);
6049 +    }
6050 +    this.acknowledged.add(requestId);
6051 +  }
6052 +
6053 +  isAcknowledged(requestId: string): boolean {
6054 +    return this.acknowledged.has(requestId);
6055 +  }
6056 +
6057 +  terminateDelivery(requestId: string): boolean {
6058 +    const entry = this.entry(requestId);
6059 +    if (entry.deliveryTerminated) return false;
6060 +    this.entries.set(requestId, { ...entry, deliveryTerminated: true });
6061 +    return true;
6062 +  }
6063 +
6064 +  isDeliveryTerminated(requestId: string): boolean {
6065 +    return this.entry(requestId).deliveryTerminated;
6066 +  }
6067 +
6068 +  subscribe(requestId: string, subscriber: AcceptedRequestSubscriber): () => void {
6069 +    const entry = this.entry(requestId);
6070 +    let requestSubscribers = this.subscribers.get(requestId);
6071 +    if (requestSubscribers === undefined) {
6072 +      requestSubscribers = new Set();
6073 +      this.subscribers.set(requestId, requestSubscribers);
6074 +    }
6075 +    requestSubscribers.add(subscriber);
6076 +    subscriber(entry);
6077 +    return () => {
6078 +      requestSubscribers?.delete(subscriber);
6079 +      if (requestSubscribers?.size === 0) this.subscribers.delete(requestId);
6080 +    };
6081 +  }
6082 +
6083 +  entryFor(requestId: string): AcceptedRequestEntry | undefined {
6084 +    return this.entries.get(requestId);
6085 +  }
6086 +
6087 +  private get nonterminalCount(): number {
6088 +    let count = 0;
6089 +    for (const entry of this.entries.values()) {
6090 +      if (entry.state.state === "queued" || entry.state.state === "running") count += 1;
6091 +    }
6092 +    return count;
6093 +  }
6094 +
6095 +  private transitionable(requestId: string): AcceptedRequestEntry {
6096 +    const entry = this.entry(requestId);
6097 +    if (entry.state.state === "completed" || entry.state.state === "failed") {
6098 +      throw new Error(`Accepted request ${requestId} is already ${entry.state.state}`);
6099 +    }
6100 +    return entry;
6101 +  }
6102 +
6103 +  private entry(requestId: string): AcceptedRequestEntry {
6104 +    const entry = this.entries.get(requestId);
6105 +    if (entry === undefined) throw new Error(`Accepted request ${requestId} was not accepted`);
6106 +    return entry;
6107 +  }
6108 +
6109 +  private publish(entry: AcceptedRequestEntry): AcceptedRequestEntry {
6110 +    this.entries.set(entry.requestId, entry);
6111 +    for (const subscriber of this.subscribers.get(entry.requestId) ?? []) subscriber(entry);
6112 +    return entry;
6113 +  }
6114 +
6115 +  private static fingerprint(
6116 +    commandName: DaemonCommandName,
6117 +    request: DaemonExecutorRequest,
6118 +  ): string {
6119 +    const canonical = AcceptedRequestLedger.canonicalValue({ commandName, request });
6120 +    return createHash("sha256").update(JSON.stringify(canonical)).digest("hex");
6121 +  }
6122 +
6123 +  private static canonicalValue(value: unknown): unknown {
6124 +    if (Array.isArray(value))
6125 +      return value.map((item) => AcceptedRequestLedger.canonicalValue(item));
6126 +    if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null) return value;
6127 +    return Object.fromEntries(
6128 +      Object.entries(value)
6129 +        .filter(([, item]) => item !== undefined)
6130 +        .sort(([left], [right]) => left.localeCompare(right))
6131 +        .map(([key, item]) => [key, AcceptedRequestLedger.canonicalValue(item)]),
6132 +    );
6133 +  }
6134 +}
