6155 +import type { DaemonCommandName, WorkspaceRequestQueueState } from "@symnav/daemon";
6156 +import { NodeDaemonClock, type DaemonClock } from "../lifecycle/daemon-clock.js";
6157 +
6158 +export interface WorkspaceQueuedRequest {
6159 +  readonly requestId: string;
6160 +  readonly command: DaemonCommandName;
6161 +  readonly acceptedAt: number;
6162 +}
6163 +
6164 +export interface WorkspaceActiveRequest extends WorkspaceQueuedRequest {
6165 +  readonly startedAt: number;
6166 +}
6167 +
6168 +export interface WorkspaceRequestQueueSnapshot {
6169 +  readonly state: WorkspaceRequestQueueState;
6170 +  readonly active?: WorkspaceActiveRequest;
6171 +  readonly queued: number;
6172 +}
6173 +
6174 +interface ScheduledBoundary {
6175 +  readonly operation: () => Promise<void>;
6176 +  readonly completion: Promise<void>;
6177 +  readonly resolve: () => void;
6178 +  readonly reject: (error: unknown) => void;
6179 +}
6180 +
6181 +export class WorkspaceRequestQueue {
6182 +  private readonly admitted: WorkspaceQueuedRequest[] = [];
6183 +  private readonly requestOperations: (() => Promise<void>)[] = [];
6184 +  private readonly idleWaiters: (() => void)[] = [];
6185 +  private activeRequest: WorkspaceActiveRequest | undefined;
6186 +  private scheduledBoundary: ScheduledBoundary | undefined;
6187 +  private running = false;
6188 +  private currentState: WorkspaceRequestQueueState = "accepting";
6189 +
6190 +  constructor(
6191 +    private readonly clock: Pick<DaemonClock, "monotonicNowMs"> = new NodeDaemonClock(),
6192 +  ) {}
6193 +
6194 +  get state(): WorkspaceRequestQueueState {
6195 +    return this.currentState;
6196 +  }
6197 +
6198 +  get snapshot(): WorkspaceRequestQueueSnapshot {
6199 +    const active =
6200 +      this.activeRequest === undefined ? undefined : Object.freeze({ ...this.activeRequest });
6201 +    return Object.freeze({
6202 +      state: this.currentState,
6203 +      ...(active === undefined ? {} : { active }),
6204 +      queued: this.admitted.length,
6205 +    });
6206 +  }
6207 +
6208 +  get isIdle(): boolean {
6209 +    return (
6210 +      this.activeRequest === undefined &&
6211 +      this.admitted.length === 0 &&
6212 +      this.scheduledBoundary === undefined
6213 +    );
6214 +  }
6215 +
6216 +  enqueue<T>(metadata: WorkspaceQueuedRequest, execute: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
6217 +    if (this.currentState !== "accepting") {
6218 +      return Promise.reject(new Error(`Workspace request queue is ${this.currentState}`));
6219 +    }
6220 +    this.admitted.push(Object.freeze({ ...metadata }));
6221 +    const result = new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
6222 +      this.requestOperations.push(async () => {
6223 +        const admitted = this.admitted.shift();
6224 +        if (admitted === undefined || admitted.requestId !== metadata.requestId) {
6225 +          reject(new Error("Workspace request queue admission order changed"));
6226 +          return;
6227 +        }
6228 +        this.activeRequest = Object.freeze({
6229 +          ...admitted,
6230 +          startedAt: this.clock.monotonicNowMs(),
6231 +        });
6232 +        try {
6233 +          resolve(await execute());
6234 +        } catch (error) {
6235 +          reject(error);
6236 +        } finally {
6237 +          this.activeRequest = undefined;
6238 +        }
6239 +      });
6240 +    });
6241 +    void this.run();
6242 +    return result;
6243 +  }
6244 +
6245 +  scheduleAtTurnBoundary(operation: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
6246 +    if (this.scheduledBoundary !== undefined) return this.scheduledBoundary.completion;
6247 +    let resolve!: () => void;
6248 +    let reject!: (error: unknown) => void;
6249 +    const completion = new Promise<void>((complete, fail) => {
6250 +      resolve = complete;
6251 +      reject = fail;
6252 +    });
6253 +    this.scheduledBoundary = { operation, completion, resolve, reject };
6254 +    void this.run();
6255 +    return completion;
6256 +  }
6257 +
6258 +  async drain(): Promise<void> {
6259 +    if (this.currentState !== "closed") this.currentState = "draining";
6260 +    await this.waitForIdle();
6261 +    this.currentState = "closed";
6262 +  }
6263 +
6264 +  close(): void {
6265 +    this.currentState = "closed";
6266 +  }
6267 +
6268 +  private async run(): Promise<void> {
6269 +    if (this.running) return;
6270 +    this.running = true;
6271 +    try {
6272 +      while (this.scheduledBoundary !== undefined || this.requestOperations.length > 0) {
6273 +        if (this.scheduledBoundary !== undefined) {
6274 +          await this.runScheduledBoundary(this.scheduledBoundary);
6275 +          continue;
6276 +        }
6277 +        await this.requestOperations.shift()?.();
6278 +      }
6279 +    } finally {
6280 +      this.running = false;
6281 +      for (const resolve of this.idleWaiters.splice(0)) resolve();
6282 +      if (this.scheduledBoundary !== undefined || this.requestOperations.length > 0) {
6283 +        void this.run();
6284 +      }
6285 +    }
6286 +  }
6287 +
6288 +  private async runScheduledBoundary(boundary: ScheduledBoundary): Promise<void> {
6289 +    try {
6290 +      await boundary.operation();
6291 +      boundary.resolve();
6292 +    } catch (error) {
6293 +      boundary.reject(error);
6294 +    } finally {
6295 +      if (this.scheduledBoundary === boundary) this.scheduledBoundary = undefined;
6296 +    }
6297 +  }
6298 +
6299 +  private waitForIdle(): Promise<void> {
6300 +    if (this.isIdle) return Promise.resolve();
6301 +    return new Promise((resolve) => this.idleWaiters.push(resolve));
6302 +  }
6303 +}

6699 @@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
6700 +import type { DaemonPolicyValues } from "@symnav/daemon";
6701 +import type { DaemonClock } from "./daemon-clock.js";
6702 +
6703 +export class DaemonLifetime {
6704 +  private timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
6705 +  private deadline: number;
6706 +  private navigationActive = false;
6707 +  private stopped = false;
6708 +  private idleTriggered = false;
6709 +
6710 +  constructor(
6711 +    private readonly clock: Pick<DaemonClock, "wallNowMs">,
6712 +    policy: Pick<DaemonPolicyValues["shutdown"], "idleTimeoutMs">,
6713 +    private readonly onIdle: () => Promise<void>,
6714 +  ) {
6715 +    this.idleTimeoutMs = policy.idleTimeoutMs;
6716 +    this.deadline = this.clock.wallNowMs() + this.idleTimeoutMs;
6717 +    this.schedule();
6718 +  }
6719 +
6720 +  private readonly idleTimeoutMs: number;
6721 +
6722 +  navigationAccepted(): void {
6723 +    if (this.stopped) return;
6724 +    this.navigationActive = true;
6725 +    this.deadline = this.clock.wallNowMs() + this.idleTimeoutMs;
6726 +    this.schedule();
6727 +  }
6728 +
6729 +  queueBecameIdle(): void {
6730 +    if (this.stopped) return;
6731 +    this.navigationActive = false;
6732 +    if (this.clock.wallNowMs() >= this.deadline) this.triggerIdle();
6733 +  }
6734 +
6735 +  stop(): void {
6736 +    this.stopped = true;
6737 +    if (this.timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(this.timer);
6738 +    this.timer = undefined;
6739 +  }
6740 +
6741 +  private schedule(): void {
6742 +    if (this.timer !== undefined) clearTimeout(this.timer);
6743 +    const remainingMs = Math.max(0, this.deadline - this.clock.wallNowMs());
6744 +    this.timer = setTimeout(() => this.deadlineReached(), remainingMs);
6745 +    this.timer.unref?.();
6746 +  }
6747 +
6748 +  private deadlineReached(): void {
6749 +    this.timer = undefined;
6750 +    if (this.stopped || this.navigationActive) return;
6751 +    this.triggerIdle();
6752 +  }
6753 +
6754 +  private triggerIdle(): void {
6755 +    if (this.idleTriggered) return;
6756 +    this.idleTriggered = true;
6757 +    void this.onIdle();
6758 +  }
6759 +}

6770 +
6771 +class DaemonProductionBoundary {
6772 +  static files(sourceRoot: string): readonly string[] {
6773 +    return DaemonProductionBoundary.walk(sourceRoot).filter(
6774 +      (path) => path.endsWith(".ts") && !path.endsWith(".test.ts"),
6775 +    );
6776 +  }
6777 +
6778 +  static violations(sourceRoot: string): readonly string[] {
6779 +    return DaemonProductionBoundary.files(sourceRoot).flatMap((path) => {
6780 +      const source = readFileSync(path, "utf8");
6781 +      const forbidden = [
6782 +        /from ["']@symnav\/(?:core|telemetry|renderer|backend-typescript|testing)["']/,
6783 +        /from ["'][^"']*apps\/cli[^"']*["']/,
6784 +      ];
6785 +      return forbidden.some((pattern) => pattern.test(source)) ? [relative(sourceRoot, path)] : [];
6786 +    });
6787 +  }
6788 +
6789 +  private static walk(directory: string): readonly string[] {
6790 +    return readdirSync(directory).flatMap((name) => {
6791 +      const path = join(directory, name);
6792 +      return statSync(path).isDirectory() ? DaemonProductionBoundary.walk(path) : [path];
6793 +    });
6794 +  }
6795 +}
6796 +

6909 +export interface DaemonActivityProjectionInput {

6925 +export interface DaemonActivityProjection {
6926 +  readonly activity: DaemonActivitySnapshot;
6927 +  readonly pong: DaemonPong;
6928 +}
6929 +
6930 +export class DaemonActivityProjector {
6931 +  static project(input: DaemonActivityProjectionInput): DaemonActivityProjection {
6932 +    const lifecycle = DaemonActivityProjector.lifecycle(input);
6933 +    const recoveryDetail = DaemonActivityProjector.recoveryDetail(input);
6934 +    const current = DaemonActivityProjector.current(input, lifecycle);
6935 +    const activity: DaemonActivitySnapshot = Object.freeze({
6936 +      lifecycle,
6937 +      ...(recoveryDetail === undefined ? {} : { recoveryDetail }),
6938 +      pid: input.pid,
6939 +      startedAt: input.startedAt,
6940 +      startupElapsedMs: Math.max(0, input.nowMonotonicMs - input.startedMonotonicAt),
6941 +      ...(input.worker.ready && input.worker.fileCount !== undefined
6942 +        ? { fileCount: input.worker.fileCount }
6943 +        : {}),
6944 +      processRssBytes: input.processRssBytes,
6945 +      hardProcessRssBytes: input.hardProcessRssBytes,
6946 +      ...(input.resources.workerHeapUsedBytes === undefined
6947 +        ? {}
6948 +        : { workerHeapUsedBytes: input.resources.workerHeapUsedBytes }),
6949 +      workerGeneration: input.worker.generation,
6950 +      ...(current === undefined ? {} : { current }),
6951 +      queued: input.queue.queued,
6952 +      ...(input.lastCompletedMonotonicAt === undefined
6953 +        ? {}
6954 +        : {
6955 +            lastCompletedAgoMs: Math.max(0, input.nowMonotonicMs - input.lastCompletedMonotonicAt),
6956 +          }),
6957 +      spoolBytes: input.resources.spoolBytes,
6958 +    });
6959 +    const pong: DaemonPong = Object.freeze({
6960 +      kind: "pong",
6961 +      protocolVersion: DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
6962 +      instanceId: input.instanceId,
6963 +      symnavVersion: input.productVersion,
6964 +      state: DaemonActivityProjector.legacyState(lifecycle),
6965 +      startedAt: input.startedAt,
6966 +      ...(input.worker.fileCount === undefined ? {} : { fileCount: input.worker.fileCount }),
6967 +      memoryBytes: input.processRssBytes,
6968 +      queued: input.queue.queued,
6969 +      activity,
6970 +      ...(current === undefined
6971 +        ? {}
6972 +        : {
6973 +            currentCommand: current.command,
6974 +            currentCommandElapsedMs: current.elapsedMs,
6975 +          }),
6976 +      ...(input.lastNavigationAt === undefined ? {} : { lastNavigationAt: input.lastNavigationAt }),
6977 +    });
6978 +    return Object.freeze({ activity, pong });
6979 +  }
6980 +
6981 +  private static lifecycle(
6982 +    input: DaemonActivityProjectionInput,
6983 +  ): DaemonActivitySnapshot["lifecycle"] {
6984 +    if (
6985 +      input.queue.state !== "accepting" ||
6986 +      input.resources.state === "draining" ||
6987 +      input.resources.state === "stopped"
6988 +    ) {
6989 +      return "draining";
6990 +    }
6991 +    if (input.resources.state === "replacing" || input.resources.state === "shedding") {
6992 +      return "recovering";
6993 +    }
6994 +    if (!input.worker.ready) return "starting";
6995 +    return input.queue.active === undefined ? "ready" : "busy";
6996 +  }
6997 +
6998 +  private static recoveryDetail(
6999 +    input: DaemonActivityProjectionInput,
7000 +  ): DaemonActivitySnapshot["recoveryDetail"] {
7001 +    if (input.resources.state === "replacing") return "worker-replacement";
7002 +    if (input.resources.state === "shedding") return "resource-pressure";
7003 +    return undefined;
7004 +  }
7005 +
7006 +  private static current(
7007 +    input: DaemonActivityProjectionInput,
7008 +    lifecycle: DaemonActivitySnapshot["lifecycle"],
7009 +  ): DaemonActivitySnapshot["current"] {
7010 +    if (lifecycle !== "busy" || input.queue.active === undefined) return undefined;
7011 +    return Object.freeze({
7012 +      requestId: input.queue.active.requestId,
7013 +      command: input.queue.active.command,
7014 +      elapsedMs: Math.max(0, input.nowMonotonicMs - input.queue.active.startedAt),
7015 +    });
7016 +  }
7017 +
7018 +  private static legacyState(
7019 +    lifecycle: DaemonActivitySnapshot["lifecycle"],
7020 +  ): NonNullable<DaemonPong["state"]> {
7021 +    if (lifecycle === "busy") return "busy";
7022 +    if (lifecycle === "starting") return "starting";
7023 +    return "ready";
7024 +  }
7025 +}

7117 +    this.launcher = options.launcher;

7120 +      options.startupCoordinator ??

7122 +        ? undefined
7123 +        : new DaemonStartupCoordinator(this.registry, this.launcher, this.transport, {
7124 +            policy: this.policy,
7125 +          }));
7126 +  }
7127 +
7128 +  async start(workspaceRoot: string): Promise<DaemonStartResult> {
7129 +    if (this.startupCoordinator === undefined) {
7130 +      throw new Error("Daemon controller has no process launcher");
7131 +    }
7132 +    const identity = DaemonWorkspaceIdentity.from(workspaceRoot, this.stateDirectory);
7133 +    return this.startupCoordinator.ensureRunning(identity);
7134 +  }
7135 +
7136 +  async status(): Promise<readonly RunningDaemonStatus[]> {
7137 +    const statuses = await Promise.all(
7138 +      this.registry.list().map((record) => this.statusForRecord(record)),
7139 +    );
7140 +    return statuses
7141 +      .filter((status): status is RunningDaemonStatus => status !== undefined)
7142 +      .sort((left, right) => left.workspaceRoot.localeCompare(right.workspaceRoot));
7143 +  }
7144 +
7145 +  async stop(workspaceRoot: string): Promise<DaemonStopResult> {
7146 +    const stopStartedAt = this.clock.wallNowMs();
7147 +    const deadline = stopStartedAt + this.stopTimeoutMs;
7148 +    const forceWaitMs = Math.min(
7149 +      this.policy.shutdown.forcedTerminationReserveMaximumMs,
7150 +      Math.floor(this.stopTimeoutMs / 2),
7151 +    );
7152 +    const gracefulDeadline = deadline - forceWaitMs;
7153 +    const identity = DaemonWorkspaceIdentity.from(workspaceRoot, this.stateDirectory);
7154 +    const record = this.registry.read(identity);
7155 +    if (record === undefined) {
7156 +      return { status: "not-running", workspaceRoot };
7157 +    }
7158 +    if (record.state === "starting") return this.stopStarting(identity, record, deadline);
7159 +    const observation = await this.observer.observeIdentity(record);
7160 +    if (observation.kind === "exited") {
7161 +      this.registry.removeIfProcess(identity, record.instanceId, record.processToken);
7162 +      return { status: "not-running", workspaceRoot };
7163 +    }
7164 +    if (observation.kind === "unresponsive" || observation.kind === "starting") {
7165 +      throw new Error(`Daemon process ${record.pid} is live but unresponsive`);
7166 +    }
7167 +
7168 +    const stopRequest = this.transport
7169 +      .request(record.endpoint, {
7170 +        kind: "stop",
7171 +        protocolVersion: DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
7172 +        instanceId: record.instanceId,
7173 +      })
7174 +      .then(() => true)
7175 +      .catch(() => false);
7176 +    const acknowledged = await Promise.race([
7177 +      stopRequest,
7178 +      this.pause(Math.max(0, gracefulDeadline - this.clock.wallNowMs())).then(() => false),
7179 +    ]);

7181 +      this.registry.removeIfProcess(identity, record.instanceId, record.processToken);
7182 +      return { status: "stopped", workspaceRoot, pid: record.pid };
7183 +    }

7185 +    const killed = await this.killIdentified(record, deadline);
7186 +    if (!killed || !(await this.waitForIdentifiedExit(record, deadline))) {
7187 +      throw new Error(`Daemon process ${record.pid} did not exit after authenticated kill`);
7188 +    }
7189 +    this.registry.removeIfProcess(identity, record.instanceId, record.processToken);
7190 +    return { status: "killed", workspaceRoot, pid: record.pid };
7191 +  }
7192 +
7193 +  private async statusForRecord(record: DaemonRecord): Promise<RunningDaemonStatus | undefined> {
7194 +    const identity = DaemonWorkspaceIdentity.from(record.workspaceRoot, this.stateDirectory);
7195 +    if (record.state === "starting") {
7196 +      if (record.pid > 0) {
7197 +        const observation = await this.observer.observe(record);
7198 +        if (observation.kind === "exited") {
7199 +          this.removeStartingOwnership(identity, record);
7200 +          return undefined;
7201 +        }
7202 +        if (observation.kind === "starting") return this.startingStatus(record);
7203 +        if (observation.kind === "responsive" && observation.pong.activity === undefined) {
7204 +          return this.startingStatus(record);
7205 +        }
7206 +        return this.statusForObservation(observation);
7207 +      }
7208 +      const ownerForRecord = this.registry.startupOwnerForRecordCredentials(identity, record);
7209 +      const ownerForInstance = this.registry.startupOwnerForInstance(identity, record.instanceId);
7210 +      const armedLaunchIsWithinGrace =
7211 +        ownerForRecord !== undefined && this.registry.startupOwnerIsWithinGrace(ownerForRecord);
7212 +      if (
7213 +        armedLaunchIsWithinGrace ||
7214 +        (ownerForInstance !== undefined &&
7215 +          this.processTerminator.isAlive(ownerForInstance.ownerPid) &&
7216 +          this.registry.startupOwnerIsWithinGrace(ownerForInstance))
7217 +      ) {
7218 +        return this.startingStatus(record);
7219 +      }
7220 +      if (ownerForInstance !== undefined) {
7221 +        if (!this.registry.removeStartupLockIfOwner(identity, ownerForInstance)) {
7222 +          const renewedOwner = this.registry.startupOwnerForInstance(identity, record.instanceId);
7223 +          if (
7224 +            renewedOwner !== undefined &&
7225 +            this.processTerminator.isAlive(renewedOwner.ownerPid) &&
7226 +            this.registry.startupOwnerIsWithinGrace(renewedOwner)
7227 +          ) {
7228 +            return this.startingStatus(record);
7229 +          }
7230 +          return undefined;
7231 +        }
7232 +      }
7233 +      this.registry.removeIfProcess(identity, record.instanceId, record.processToken);
7234 +      return undefined;
7235 +    }
7236 +
7237 +    return this.statusForObservation(await this.observer.observe(record));
7238 +  }
7239 +
7240 +  private async stopStarting(
7241 +    identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity,
7242 +    record: DaemonRecord,
7243 +    deadline: number,
7244 +  ): Promise<DaemonStopResult> {
7245 +    if (record.pid <= 0) {
7246 +      if (this.registry.startupOwnerForRecordCredentials(identity, record) !== undefined) {
7247 +        return this.waitForClaimedProcessAndStop(identity, record, deadline);
7248 +      }
7249 +      this.registry.removeStartupLockIfInstance(identity, record.instanceId);
7250 +      this.registry.removeIfProcess(identity, record.instanceId, record.processToken);
7251 +      return { status: "not-running", workspaceRoot: record.workspaceRoot };
7252 +    }
7253 +
7254 +    if (!this.processTerminator.isAlive(record.pid)) {
7255 +      this.removeStartingOwnership(identity, record);
7256 +      return { status: "not-running", workspaceRoot: record.workspaceRoot };
7257 +    }
7258 +    if (!this.registry.startupOwnerMatchesProcess(identity, record)) {
7259 +      throw new Error(`Daemon process ${record.pid} has no authenticated startup ownership`);
7260 +    }
7261 +    const terminated = await this.terminateStartingProcess(record.pid, deadline);
7262 +    if (!terminated || this.processTerminator.isAlive(record.pid)) {
7263 +      throw new Error(`Daemon process ${record.pid} did not exit after authenticated stop`);
7264 +    }
7265 +    this.registry.removeStartupLockIfProcess(identity, record);
7266 +    this.registry.removeIfProcess(identity, record.instanceId, record.processToken);
7267 +    return { status: "stopped", workspaceRoot: record.workspaceRoot, pid: record.pid };
7268 +  }
7269 +
7270 +  private async waitForClaimedProcessAndStop(
7271 +    identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity,
7272 +    claimedRecord: DaemonRecord,
7273 +    deadline: number,
7274 +  ): Promise<DaemonStopResult> {
7275 +    while (this.clock.wallNowMs() <= deadline) {
7276 +      const record = this.registry.readStoredInstance(identity, claimedRecord.instanceId);
7277 +      if (record === undefined || record.processToken !== claimedRecord.processToken) {
7278 +        return { status: "not-running", workspaceRoot: claimedRecord.workspaceRoot };
7279 +      }
7280 +      if (record.pid > 0) return this.stopStarting(identity, record, deadline);
7281 +      if (this.registry.startupOwnerForRecordCredentials(identity, claimedRecord) === undefined) {
7282 +        return { status: "not-running", workspaceRoot: claimedRecord.workspaceRoot };
7283 +      }
7284 +      await this.pause(this.pollIntervalMs);
7285 +    }
7286 +    throw new Error("Daemon launch did not publish its process before authenticated stop");
7287 +  }
7288 +
7289 +  private async terminateStartingProcess(pid: number, deadline: number): Promise<boolean> {
7290 +    let timeout: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
7291 +    const deadlineReached = new Promise<false>((resolve) => {
7292 +      timeout = setTimeout(() => resolve(false), Math.max(0, deadline - this.clock.wallNowMs()));
7293 +    });
7294 +    try {
7295 +      return await Promise.race([
7296 +        this.processTerminator.terminate(pid).then(() => true),
7297 +        deadlineReached,
7298 +      ]);
7299 +    } finally {
7300 +      if (timeout !== undefined) clearTimeout(timeout);
7301 +    }
7302 +  }
7303 +
7304 +  private removeStartingOwnership(identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity, record: DaemonRecord): void {
7305 +    const storedRecord = this.registry.readStoredInstance(identity, record.instanceId);
7306 +    if (
7307 +      storedRecord?.processToken !== record.processToken ||
7308 +      storedRecord.pid !== record.pid ||
7309 +      storedRecord.startedAt !== record.startedAt
7310 +    ) {
7311 +      return;
7312 +    }
7313 +    if (this.registry.startupOwnerMatchesProcess(identity, record)) {
7314 +      this.registry.removeStartupLockIfProcess(identity, record);
7315 +    }
7316 +    this.registry.removeIfProcess(identity, record.instanceId, record.processToken);
7317 +  }
7318 +
7319 +  private startingStatus(record: DaemonRecord): RunningDaemonStatus {
7320 +    return {
7321 +      workspaceRoot: record.workspaceRoot,
7322 +      state: "starting",
7323 +      pid: record.pid,
7324 +      startupElapsedMs: Math.max(0, this.clock.wallNowMs() - record.startedAt),
7325 +      ...(record.memoryBytes === undefined ? {} : { memoryBytes: record.memoryBytes }),
7326 +    };
7327 +  }
7328 +
7329 +  private statusForObservation(observation: DaemonObservation): RunningDaemonStatus | undefined {
7330 +    const record = observation.record;
7331 +    if (observation.kind === "exited") {
7332 +      const identity = DaemonWorkspaceIdentity.from(record.workspaceRoot, this.stateDirectory);
7333 +      this.registry.removeIfProcess(identity, record.instanceId, record.processToken);
7334 +      return undefined;
7335 +    }
7336 +    if (observation.kind !== "responsive") return this.unresponsiveStatus(record);
7337 +    if (observation.pong.activity !== undefined) {
7338 +      return this.statusFromActivity(record, observation.pong.activity);
7339 +    }
7340 +    const lastNavigationAt = observation.pong.lastNavigationAt ?? record.lastNavigationAt;
7341 +    const fileCount = observation.pong.fileCount ?? record.fileCount;
7342 +    const memoryBytes = observation.pong.memoryBytes ?? record.memoryBytes;
7343 +    if (observation.pong.state === "busy") {
7344 +      if (
7345 +        observation.pong.currentCommand === undefined ||
7346 +        observation.pong.currentCommandElapsedMs === undefined ||
7347 +        observation.pong.queued === undefined ||
7348 +        memoryBytes === undefined
7349 +      ) {
7350 +        return this.unresponsiveStatus(record);
7351 +      }
7352 +      return {
7353 +        workspaceRoot: record.workspaceRoot,
7354 +        state: "busy",
7355 +        pid: record.pid,
7356 +        uptimeMs: Math.max(0, this.clock.wallNowMs() - record.startedAt),
7357 +        command: DaemonRuntimeValues.isCommandName(observation.pong.currentCommand)
7358 +          ? observation.pong.currentCommand
7359 +          : "unknown",
7360 +        elapsedMs: observation.pong.currentCommandElapsedMs,
7361 +        queued: observation.pong.queued,
7362 +        memoryBytes,
7363 +      };
7364 +    }
7365 +    if (fileCount === undefined || memoryBytes === undefined) {
7366 +      return this.unresponsiveStatus(record);
7367 +    }
7368 +    return {
7369 +      workspaceRoot: record.workspaceRoot,
7370 +      state: "ready",
7371 +      pid: record.pid,
7372 +      uptimeMs: Math.max(0, this.clock.wallNowMs() - record.startedAt),
7373 +      fileCount,
7374 +      memoryBytes,
7375 +      ...(lastNavigationAt === undefined
7376 +        ? {}
7377 +        : { lastRequestAgoMs: Math.max(0, this.clock.wallNowMs() - lastNavigationAt) }),
7378 +    };
7379 +  }
7380 +
7381 +  private unresponsiveStatus(record: DaemonRecord): RunningDaemonStatus {
7382 +    return {
7383 +      workspaceRoot: record.workspaceRoot,
7384 +      state: "unresponsive",
7385 +      pid: record.pid,
7386 +      uptimeMs: Math.max(0, this.clock.wallNowMs() - record.startedAt),
7387 +    };
7388 +  }
7389 +
7390 +  private statusFromActivity(
7391 +    record: DaemonRecord,
7392 +    activity: import("../transport/protocol.js").DaemonActivitySnapshot,
7393 +  ): RunningDaemonStatus {
7394 +    if (activity.lifecycle === "starting") {
7395 +      return {
7396 +        state: "starting",
7397 +        workspaceRoot: record.workspaceRoot,
7398 +        pid: record.pid,
7399 +        startupElapsedMs: activity.startupElapsedMs,
7400 +        memoryBytes: activity.processRssBytes,
7401 +      };
7402 +    }
7403 +    const uptimeMs = activity.startupElapsedMs;
7404 +    if (activity.lifecycle === "busy" && activity.current !== undefined) {
7405 +      return {
7406 +        state: "busy",
7407 +        workspaceRoot: record.workspaceRoot,
7408 +        pid: record.pid,
7409 +        uptimeMs,
7410 +        command: activity.current.command,
7411 +        elapsedMs: activity.current.elapsedMs,
7412 +        queued: activity.queued,
7413 +        memoryBytes: activity.processRssBytes,
7414 +      };
7415 +    }
7416 +    if (activity.lifecycle === "recovering" || activity.lifecycle === "draining") {
7417 +      const detail = activity.lifecycle === "draining" ? "draining" : activity.recoveryDetail;
7418 +      if (detail === undefined) return this.unresponsiveStatus(record);
7419 +      return {
7420 +        state: "recovering",
7421 +        workspaceRoot: record.workspaceRoot,
7422 +        pid: record.pid,
7423 +        uptimeMs,
7424 +        detail,
7425 +        queued: activity.queued,
7426 +        memoryBytes: activity.processRssBytes,
7427 +      };
7428 +    }
7429 +    if (activity.fileCount === undefined) return this.unresponsiveStatus(record);
7430 +    return {
7431 +      state: "ready",
7432 +      workspaceRoot: record.workspaceRoot,
7433 +      pid: record.pid,
7434 +      uptimeMs,
7435 +      fileCount: activity.fileCount,
7436 +      memoryBytes: activity.processRssBytes,
7437 +      ...(activity.lastCompletedAgoMs === undefined
7438 +        ? {}
7439 +        : { lastRequestAgoMs: activity.lastCompletedAgoMs }),
7440 +    };
7441 +  }
7442 +
7443 +  private async killIdentified(record: DaemonRecord, deadline: number): Promise<boolean> {
7444 +    try {
7445 +      const response = await Promise.race([
7446 +        this.transport.request(record.endpoint, {
7447 +          kind: "kill",
7448 +          instanceId: record.instanceId,
7449 +          processToken: record.processToken,
7450 +        }),
7451 +        this.pause(Math.max(0, deadline - this.clock.wallNowMs())).then(() => undefined),
7452 +      ]);
7453 +      return response?.kind === "killing";
7454 +    } catch {
7455 +      return false;
7456 +    }
7457 +  }
7458 +
7459 +  private async waitForIdentifiedExit(record: DaemonRecord, deadline: number): Promise<boolean> {
7460 +    while (this.clock.wallNowMs() <= deadline) {
7461 +      if (!(await this.identifies(record)) && !this.processTerminator.isAlive(record.pid)) {
7462 +        return true;
7463 +      }
7464 +      await this.pause(this.pollIntervalMs);
7465 +    }
7466 +    return !(await this.identifies(record)) && !this.processTerminator.isAlive(record.pid);
7467 +  }
7468 +
7469 +  private async identifies(record: DaemonRecord): Promise<boolean> {
7470 +    try {
7471 +      const response = await this.transport.request(record.endpoint, {
7472 +        kind: "identify",
7473 +        instanceId: record.instanceId,
7474 +        processToken: record.processToken,
7475 +      });
7476 +      return (
7477 +        response.kind === "identity" &&
7478 +        response.pid === record.pid &&
7479 +        response.startedAt === record.startedAt
7480 +      );
7481 +    } catch {
7482 +      return false;
7483 +    }
7484 +  }
7485 +
7486 +  private async waitForExit(pid: number, deadline: number): Promise<boolean> {
7487 +    while (this.clock.wallNowMs() <= deadline) {
7488 +      if (!this.processTerminator.isAlive(pid)) return true;
7489 +      await this.pause(this.pollIntervalMs);
7490 +    }
7491 +    return !this.processTerminator.isAlive(pid);
7492 +  }
7493 +
7494 +  private pause(durationMs: number): Promise<void> {
7495 +    return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, durationMs));
7496 +  }
7497 +}

8372 +  async start(): Promise<void> {
8373 +    this.logger.record({ kind: "start" });
8374 +    let startupLease: DaemonStartupLease | undefined;
8375 +    let startupHeartbeat: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
8376 +    try {
8377 +      const authorization = await this.waitForStartupAuthorization();
8378 +      startupLease = authorization.lease;
8379 +      const startingRecord = authorization.record;
8380 +      startupHeartbeat = setInterval(
8381 +        () => startupLease?.heartbeat(),
8382 +        this.policy.values.startup.heartbeatIntervalMs,
8383 +      );
8384 +      startupHeartbeat.unref();
8385 +      this.startedAt = startingRecord.startedAt;
8386 +      this.server = await this.options.server.listen(
8387 +        this.options.coordinates.endpoint,
8388 +        (request, send) => this.handle(request, send),
8389 +      );
8390 +      const response = await this.workerManager.start();
8391 +      this.operationObserver.startup({
8392 +        kind: "startup-completed",
8393 +        workerGeneration: response.generation,
8394 +        fileCount: response.fileCount,
8395 +        ...response.startupDurations,
8396 +      });
8397 +      this.logger.record({ kind: "freshness", ...response.refresh });
8398 +      await this.resourceSupervisor.sample("warmup");
8399 +      this.workerManager.activateReadiness();
8400 +      const readyRecord: DaemonRecord = {
8401 +        schemaVersion: DAEMON_RECORD_SCHEMA_VERSION,
8402 +        protocolVersion: DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
8403 +        symnavVersion: this.options.productVersion,
8404 +        workspaceRoot: this.options.identity.workspaceRoot,
8405 +        workspaceKey: this.options.identity.workspaceKey,
8406 +        stateKey: this.options.identity.stateKey,
8407 +        identityKey: this.options.identity.identityKey,
8408 +        instanceId: this.options.coordinates.instanceId,
8409 +        processToken: this.options.coordinates.processToken,
8410 +        endpoint: this.options.coordinates.endpoint,
8411 +        pid: process.pid,
8412 +        state: "ready",
8413 +        startedAt: startingRecord.startedAt,
8414 +        readyAt: this.clock.wallNowMs(),
8415 +        fileCount: response.fileCount,
8416 +        memoryCapBytes: this.resourcePolicy.hardProcessRssBytes,
8417 +      };
8418 +      if (!this.options.registry.writeIfStartupOwner(this.options.identity, readyRecord)) {
8419 +        throw new Error("Daemon startup ownership changed before readiness publication");
8420 +      }
8421 +      if (startupHeartbeat !== undefined) clearInterval(startupHeartbeat);
8422 +      startupHeartbeat = undefined;
8423 +      startupLease.release();

8427 +    } catch (error) {
8428 +      if (startupHeartbeat !== undefined) clearInterval(startupHeartbeat);
8429 +      await this.cleanupFailedStartup(startupLease);
8430 +      this.logger.record({
8431 +        kind: "failure",
8432 +        operation: "start",
8433 +        failureCode: "operation-failed",
8434 +        errorName: DaemonLogger.errorName(error),
8435 +      });
8436 +      await this.logger.flush();
8437 +      throw error;
8438 +    }
8439 +  }

8441 +  private async waitForStartupAuthorization(): Promise<{
8442 +    readonly lease: DaemonStartupLease;
8443 +    readonly record: DaemonRecord;
8444 +  }> {
8445 +    const deadline = this.clock.wallNowMs() + this.policy.values.startup.coordinationGraceMs;
8446 +    while (this.clock.wallNowMs() <= deadline) {
8447 +      const record = this.options.registry.readInstance(
8448 +        this.options.identity,
8449 +        this.options.coordinates.instanceId,
8450 +      );
8451 +      if (
8452 +        record?.state === "starting" &&
8453 +        (record.pid === 0 || record.pid === process.pid) &&
8454 +        record.processToken === this.options.coordinates.processToken
8455 +      ) {
8456 +        const lease = this.options.registry.claimStartupForDaemon(
8457 +          this.options.identity,
8458 +          this.options.coordinates.instanceId,
8459 +          this.options.coordinates.processToken,
8460 +          process.pid,
8461 +        );
8462 +        if (lease === undefined) {
8463 +          await this.pause();
8464 +          continue;
8465 +        }
8466 +        this.options.registry.writeStartingIfStartupOwner(this.options.identity, {
8467 +          ...record,
8468 +          pid: process.pid,
8469 +        });
8470 +        const adoptedRecord = this.options.registry.readInstance(
8471 +          this.options.identity,
8472 +          this.options.coordinates.instanceId,
8473 +        );
8474 +        if (adoptedRecord?.pid !== process.pid) {
8475 +          lease.release();
8476 +          await this.pause();
8477 +          continue;
8478 +        }
8479 +        if (
8480 +          this.options.registry.startupOwnerMatchesProcess(this.options.identity, adoptedRecord)
8481 +        ) {
8482 +          return { lease, record: adoptedRecord };
8483 +        }
8484 +        lease.release();
8485 +      }
8486 +      await this.pause();
8487 +    }
8488 +    throw new Error("Daemon process did not receive startup authorization");
8489 +  }

8491 +  private async cleanupFailedStartup(startupLease: DaemonStartupLease | undefined): Promise<void> {
8492 +    this.shutdownStarted = true;
8493 +    try {
8494 +      await this.workerManager.terminate();
8495 +    } catch {}
8496 +    try {
8497 +      await this.server?.close();
8498 +    } catch {}
8499 +    startupLease?.release();
8500 +    this.options.registry.removeIfProcess(
8501 +      this.options.identity,
8502 +      this.options.coordinates.instanceId,
8503 +      this.options.coordinates.processToken,
8504 +    );
8505 +  }

8507 +  private async handle(
8508 +    request: DaemonRequest,
8509 +    send: DaemonServerSend,
8510 +  ): Promise<DaemonResponse | void> {
8511 +    if (request.kind === "identify") return this.identify(request);
8512 +    if (request.kind === "terminate" || request.kind === "kill") {
8513 +      return this.terminate(request);
8514 +    }
8515 +    if (
8516 +      request.protocolVersion !== DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION ||
8517 +      request.instanceId !== this.options.coordinates.instanceId
8518 +    ) {
8519 +      throw new Error("Daemon request does not match protocol or instance");
8520 +    }
8521 +    if (request.kind === "ping") return this.pong();
8522 +    if (request.kind === "execute") return this.acceptExecution(request, send);
8523 +    if (
8524 +      request.kind === "execution-status" ||
8525 +      request.kind === "result-fetch" ||
8526 +      request.kind === "result-ack"
8527 +    ) {
8528 +      if (request.processToken !== this.options.coordinates.processToken) {
8529 +        throw new Error("Daemon execution request does not match process instance");
8530 +      }
8531 +    }
8532 +    if (request.kind === "result-fetch") {
8533 +      await this.deliverySession.fetch(request, send);
8534 +      return;
8535 +    }
8536 +    if (request.kind === "result-ack") {
8537 +      return this.deliverySession.acknowledge(request);
8538 +    }
8539 +    if (request.kind === "execution-status") {
8540 +      return {
8541 +        kind: "execution-status",
8542 +        instanceId: this.options.coordinates.instanceId,
8543 +        processToken: this.options.coordinates.processToken,
8544 +        requestId: request.requestId,
8545 +        status: this.acceptedExecutionSession.status(request.requestId),
8546 +      };
8547 +    }
8548 +    this.beginGracefulShutdown();
8549 +    await this.acceptedExecutionSession.drain();
8550 +    await this.deliverySession.waitForCompletionAcknowledgements();
8551 +    setTimeout(() => void this.shutdown("graceful"), 0);
8552 +    return { kind: "stopped", instanceId: this.options.coordinates.instanceId };
8553 +  }
8554 +
8555 +  private identify(request: Extract<DaemonRequest, { kind: "identify" }>): DaemonResponse {
8556 +    if (
8557 +      request.instanceId !== this.options.coordinates.instanceId ||
8558 +      request.processToken !== this.options.coordinates.processToken
8559 +    ) {
8560 +      throw new Error("Daemon identity request does not match process instance");
8561 +    }
8562 +    return {
8563 +      kind: "identity",
8564 +      instanceId: this.options.coordinates.instanceId,
8565 +      processToken: this.options.coordinates.processToken,
8566 +      pid: process.pid,
8567 +      startedAt: this.startedAt,
8568 +    };
8569 +  }
8570 +
8571 +  private async terminate(
8572 +    request: Extract<DaemonRequest, { kind: "terminate" | "kill" }>,
8573 +  ): Promise<DaemonResponse> {
8574 +    if (
8575 +      request.instanceId !== this.options.coordinates.instanceId ||
8576 +      request.processToken !== this.options.coordinates.processToken
8577 +    ) {
8578 +      throw new Error("Daemon termination does not match process instance");
8579 +    }
8580 +    this.beginGracefulShutdown();
8581 +    if (request.kind === "terminate") {
8582 +      await this.acceptedExecutionSession.drain();
8583 +      await this.deliverySession.waitForCompletionAcknowledgements();
8584 +      setTimeout(() => void this.shutdown("graceful"), 0);
8585 +    } else {
8586 +      setTimeout(() => void this.shutdown("graceful", true), 0);
8587 +    }
8588 +    return {
8589 +      kind: request.kind === "terminate" ? "terminating" : "killing",
8590 +      instanceId: this.options.coordinates.instanceId,
8591 +      processToken: this.options.coordinates.processToken,
8592 +    };
8593 +  }

8595 +  private pong(): DaemonResponse {
8596 +    const execution = this.acceptedExecutionSession.snapshot;
8597 +    const resources = this.resourceSupervisor.snapshot;
8598 +    const worker = this.workerManager.snapshot;
8599 +    return DaemonActivityProjector.project({
8600 +      nowMonotonicMs: this.clock.monotonicNowMs(),
8601 +      pid: process.pid,
8602 +      processRssBytes: process.memoryUsage().rss,
8603 +      startedAt: this.startedAt,
8604 +      startedMonotonicAt: this.startedMonotonicAt,
8605 +      ...(execution.lastNavigationAt === undefined
8606 +        ? {}
8607 +        : { lastNavigationAt: execution.lastNavigationAt }),
8608 +      ...(execution.lastCompletedMonotonicAt === undefined
8609 +        ? {}
8610 +        : { lastCompletedMonotonicAt: execution.lastCompletedMonotonicAt }),
8611 +      productVersion: this.options.productVersion,
8612 +      instanceId: this.options.coordinates.instanceId,
8613 +      hardProcessRssBytes: this.resourcePolicy.hardProcessRssBytes,
8614 +      queue: execution.queue,
8615 +      resources,
8616 +      worker: {
8617 +        generation: worker.generation,
8618 +        ready: worker.ready,
8619 +        fileCount: worker.fileCount ?? 0,
8620 +      },
8621 +    }).pong;
8622 +  }

8624 +  private async acceptExecution(
8625 +    request: Extract<DaemonRequest, { kind: "execute" }>,
8626 +    send: DaemonServerSend,
8627 +  ): Promise<DaemonResponse | void> {
8628 +    const decision = this.decideAdmission(request);
8629 +    if (decision.kind === "disconnect") {
8630 +      throw new Error("Daemon execution request does not match process instance");
8631 +    }
8632 +    if (decision.kind === "reject") return this.rejection(request, decision.code);
8633 +    const admission = this.acceptedExecutionSession.accept(request);
8634 +    await this.deliverySession.attach(
8635 +      {
8636 +        ...admission.acceptance,
8637 +      },
8638 +      send,
8639 +    );
8640 +  }
8641 +
8642 +  private decideAdmission(
8643 +    request: Extract<DaemonRequest, { kind: "execute" }>,
8644 +  ): DaemonAdmissionDecision {
8645 +    const authenticated = request.processToken === this.options.coordinates.processToken;
8646 +    if (!authenticated) {
8647 +      return this.admissionPolicy.decide({
8648 +        request,
8649 +        authenticated,
8650 +        workerReady: true,
8651 +        resourceAdmissionPaused: false,
8652 +        queueState: "accepting",
8653 +        compatibility: "unseen",
8654 +      });
8655 +    }
8656 +    void this.resourceSupervisor.sample("admission").catch((error) => {
8657 +      this.logger.record({
8658 +        kind: "failure",
8659 +        operation: "resource-sample",
8660 +        failureCode: "operation-failed",
8661 +        errorName: DaemonLogger.errorName(error),
8662 +      });
8663 +    });
8664 +    return this.admissionPolicy.decide({
8665 +      request,
8666 +      authenticated,
8667 +      workerReady: this.workerManager.snapshot.ready,
8668 +      resourceAdmissionPaused: this.resourceSupervisor.snapshot.admissionPaused,
8669 +      queueState: this.acceptedExecutionSession.snapshot.queue.state,
8670 +      compatibility: this.acceptedExecutionSession.compatibilityFor(request),
8671 +    });
8672 +  }
8673 +
8674 +  private workspaceExists(): Promise<boolean> {
8675 +    return (
8676 +      this.options.workspaceExists?.(this.options.identity.workspaceRoot) ??
8677 +      DaemonProcessCoordinator.pathExists(this.options.identity.workspaceRoot)
8678 +    );
8679 +  }
8680 +
8681 +  private async workspaceDeletedAfterDelivery(): Promise<void> {

8683 +    setTimeout(() => void this.shutdown("workspace-deleted", true), 0);
8684 +  }

8686 +  private static async pathExists(path: string): Promise<boolean> {

8688 +      await access(path);

8690 +    } catch {
8691 +      return false;

8695 +  private static validateCoordinates(
8696 +    identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity,
8697 +    coordinates: DaemonIdentityCoordinates,
8698 +  ): void {
8699 +    if (
8700 +      coordinates.workspaceRoot !== identity.workspaceRoot ||
8701 +      coordinates.workspaceKey !== identity.workspaceKey ||
8702 +      coordinates.stateKey !== identity.stateKey ||
8703 +      coordinates.identityKey !== identity.identityKey ||
8704 +      coordinates.endpoint !== identity.endpoint(coordinates.instanceId)
8705 +    ) {
8706 +      throw new Error("Daemon process identity does not match configuration");
8707 +    }
8708 +  }
8709 +
8710 +  private rejection(
8711 +    request: Extract<DaemonRequest, { kind: "execute" }>,
8712 +    code: DaemonExecuteRejectionCode,
8713 +  ): DaemonExecutionServerFrame {
8714 +    return DaemonAdmissionRejections.frame(code, {
8715 +      instanceId: this.options.coordinates.instanceId,
8716 +      processToken: this.options.coordinates.processToken,
8717 +      requestId: request.requestId,
8718 +    });
8719 +  }
8720 +
8721 +  private async drainAndShutdown(reason: "idle"): Promise<void> {
8722 +    await this.acceptedExecutionSession.drain();
8723 +    await this.shutdown(reason);
8724 +  }

8726 +  private beginGracefulShutdown(): void {

8731 +  private async initiateResourceDrain(): Promise<void> {

8734 +      this.logger.record({
8735 +        kind: "failure",

8738 +        errorName: DaemonLogger.errorName(error),
8739 +      });
8740 +    });

8742 +
8743 +  private async shutdown(
8744 +    reason: "graceful" | "idle" | "resource" | "workspace-deleted",
8745 +    force = false,
8746 +  ): Promise<void> {
8747 +    this.shutdownFailureCode ??= reason === "resource" ? "controlled-resource" : "stopping";
8748 +    if (force) this.forceWorkerShutdown();
8749 +    if (this.shutdownOperation !== undefined) return this.shutdownOperation;
8750 +    this.shutdownStarted = true;
8751 +    this.shutdownOperation = this.completeShutdown(reason, force);
8752 +    return this.shutdownOperation;
8753 +  }
8754 +
8755 +  private async completeShutdown(
8756 +    reason: "graceful" | "idle" | "resource" | "workspace-deleted",
8757 +    force: boolean,
8758 +  ): Promise<void> {
8759 +    this.lifetime.stop();
8760 +    this.resourceSupervisor.stop();
8761 +    if (force) await this.forceWorkerShutdown();
8762 +    else await this.gracefullyShutdownWorker();

8764 +    this.logger.record({ kind: "stop", reason });
8765 +    try {
8766 +      await this.server?.close();
8767 +    } catch (error) {
8768 +      this.logger.record({
8769 +        kind: "failure",
8770 +        operation: "transport-close",
8771 +        failureCode: "operation-failed",
8772 +        errorName: DaemonLogger.errorName(error),
8773 +      });
8774 +    }
8775 +    await this.deliverySession.cleanupInstance();
8776 +    this.deliverySession.completeRetainedTraces();

8778 +    this.exit(0);
8779 +  }

8782 +    await this.acceptedExecutionSession.drain();

8786 +
8787 +  private forceWorkerShutdown(): Promise<void> {
8788 +    if (this.forcedWorkerShutdown !== undefined) return this.forcedWorkerShutdown;
8789 +    this.acceptedExecutionSession.close();
8790 +    this.forcedWorkerShutdown = this.workerManager
8791 +      .terminate()
8792 +      .then(() => this.acceptedExecutionSession.drain());
8793 +    this.resolveForceEscalated();
8794 +    return this.forcedWorkerShutdown;
8795 +  }
8796 +
8797 +  private pause(): Promise<void> {
8798 +    return new Promise((resolve) =>
8799 +      setTimeout(resolve, this.policy.values.startup.authorizationPollIntervalMs),
8800 +    );
8801 +  }

8803 +  private async recoverWorkerExit(

8805 +  ): Promise<void> {
8806 +    if (this.shutdownStarted) return;
8807 +    this.logger.record({
8808 +      kind: "failure",
8809 +      operation: "worker-exit",
8810 +      failureCode: "worker-exit",
8811 +      errorName: DaemonLogger.errorName(
8812 +        workerExit.errorName === undefined ? undefined : { name: workerExit.errorName },
8813 +      ),
8814 +    });
8815 +    try {
8816 +      await this.resourceSupervisor.recover(workerExit);
8817 +    } catch (error) {
8818 +      this.logger.record({
8819 +        kind: "failure",
8820 +        operation: "worker-replacement",
8821 +        failureCode: "controlled-resource",
8822 +        errorName: DaemonLogger.errorName(error),
8823 +      });
8824 +      throw error;
8825 +    }
8826 +  }
8827 +}

8948 +export class NodeDaemonProcessTerminator implements DaemonProcessTerminator {
8949 +  private readonly gracefulTimeoutMs: number;
8950 +  private readonly pollIntervalMs: number;
8951 +
8952 +  constructor(
8953 +    policy: DaemonPolicyValues["shutdown"],
8954 +    private readonly clock: Pick<DaemonClock, "wallNowMs"> = new NodeDaemonClock(),
8955 +  ) {
8956 +    this.gracefulTimeoutMs = policy.processSignalExitTimeoutMs;
8957 +    this.pollIntervalMs = policy.processExitPollIntervalMs;
8958 +  }
8959 +
8960 +  isAlive(pid: number): boolean {
8961 +    if (!Number.isInteger(pid) || pid <= 0) return false;
8962 +    try {
8963 +      process.kill(pid, 0);
8964 +      return true;
8965 +    } catch (error) {
8966 +      return NodeDaemonProcessTerminator.errorCode(error) === "EPERM";
8967 +    }
8968 +  }
8969 +
8970 +  async terminate(pid: number): Promise<void> {
8971 +    if (!this.isAlive(pid)) return;
8972 +    if (pid === process.pid) throw new Error("Refusing to terminate current process");
8973 +    this.signal(pid, "SIGTERM");
8974 +    if (await this.waitForExit(pid)) return;
8975 +    this.signal(pid, "SIGKILL");
8976 +    if (await this.waitForExit(pid)) return;
8977 +    throw new DaemonProcessTerminationError(`Daemon process ${pid} did not terminate`);
8978 +  }
8979 +
8980 +  private signal(pid: number, signal: NodeJS.Signals): void {
8981 +    try {
8982 +      process.kill(pid, signal);
8983 +    } catch (error) {
8984 +      if (NodeDaemonProcessTerminator.errorCode(error) !== "ESRCH") throw error;
8985 +    }
8986 +  }
8987 +
8988 +  private async waitForExit(pid: number): Promise<boolean> {
8989 +    const deadline = this.clock.wallNowMs() + this.gracefulTimeoutMs;
8990 +    while (this.clock.wallNowMs() <= deadline) {
8991 +      if (!this.isAlive(pid)) return true;
8992 +      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, this.pollIntervalMs));
8993 +    }
8994 +    return !this.isAlive(pid);
8995 +  }
8996 +
8997 +  private static errorCode(error: unknown): string | undefined {
8998 +    if (typeof error !== "object" || error === null) return undefined;
8999 +    return (error as { readonly code?: string }).code;
9000 +  }
9001 +}

9003 +export class NodeDaemonProcessLauncher implements DaemonProcessLauncher {
9004 +  private readonly terminator: DaemonProcessTerminator;
9005 +
9006 +  constructor(
9007 +    readonly symnavVersion: string,
9008 +    readonly executorModuleUrl: DaemonExecutorModuleUrl,
9009 +    readonly policy: DaemonPolicy,
9010 +    terminator: DaemonProcessTerminator = new NodeDaemonProcessTerminator(policy.values.shutdown),
9011 +  ) {
9012 +    this.terminator = terminator;
9013 +  }
9014 +
9015 +  get memoryCapBytes(): number {
9016 +    return this.policy.values.resources.hardProcessRssBytes;
9017 +  }
9018 +
9019 +  launch(
9020 +    identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity,
9021 +    instanceId: string,
9022 +    processToken: string,
9023 +  ): Promise<DaemonProcess> {
9024 +    const stateDirectory = identity.stateDirectory;
9025 +    const configuration: DaemonProcessConfiguration = {
9026 +      workspaceRoot: identity.workspaceRoot,
9027 +      stateDirectory,
9028 +      workspaceKey: identity.workspaceKey,
9029 +      stateKey: identity.stateKey,
9030 +      identityKey: identity.identityKey,
9031 +      instanceId,
9032 +      processToken,
9033 +      endpoint: identity.endpoint(instanceId),
9034 +      symnavVersion: this.symnavVersion,
9035 +      executorModuleUrl: this.executorModuleUrl,
9036 +      policy: this.policy.toSerialized(),
9037 +      startupOwnerKind: "daemon",
9038 +    };
9039 +    const encodedConfiguration = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(configuration)).toString("base64url");
9040 +    const daemonEntryPath = fileURLToPath(new URL("../process-entry.js", import.meta.url));
9041 +    mkdirSync(identity.identityDirectory, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 });
9042 +
9043 +    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
9044 +      let processSpawned = false;
9045 +      let exitResolved = false;
9046 +      let resolveExit: (exit: DaemonProcessExit) => void = () => undefined;
9047 +      const exited = new Promise<DaemonProcessExit>((exitResolve) => {
9048 +        resolveExit = exitResolve;
9049 +      });
9050 +      const settleExit = (exit: DaemonProcessExit): void => {
9051 +        if (exitResolved) return;
9052 +        exitResolved = true;
9053 +        resolveExit(exit);
9054 +      };
9055 +      const child = spawn(process.execPath, [daemonEntryPath, encodedConfiguration], {
9056 +        cwd: tmpdir(),
9057 +        detached: true,
9058 +        stdio: ["ignore", "ignore", "ignore"],
9059 +        env: { ...process.env, SYMNAV_STATE_DIR: stateDirectory },
9060 +      });
9061 +      child.once("error", (error) => {
9062 +        settleExit({
9063 +          code: null,
9064 +          signal: null,
9065 +          cause: "spawn-error",
9066 +          errorName: error.name,
9067 +        });
9068 +        if (!processSpawned) reject(error);
9069 +      });
9070 +      child.once("spawn", () => {
9071 +        processSpawned = true;
9072 +        child.unref();
9073 +        resolve(new SpawnedDaemonProcess(child.pid!, exited, this.terminator));
9074 +      });
9075 +      child.once("exit", (code, signal) => {
9076 +        settleExit({ code, signal, cause: "exit" });
9077 +      });
9078 +    });
9079 +  }
9080 +}

9082 +export class DaemonProcessConfigurationParser {
9083 +  static parse(encoded: string | undefined): DaemonProcessConfiguration {
9084 +    if (encoded === undefined) throw new Error("Missing daemon process configuration");
9085 +    const value: unknown = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(encoded, "base64url").toString("utf8"));
9086 +    if (!DaemonProcessConfigurationParser.isConfiguration(value)) {
9087 +      throw new Error("Invalid daemon process configuration");
9088 +    }
9089 +    return value;
9090 +  }
9091 +
9092 +  private static isConfiguration(value: unknown): value is DaemonProcessConfiguration {
9093 +    if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null) return false;
9094 +    const configuration = value as Record<string, unknown>;
9095 +    return (
9096 +      DaemonProcessConfigurationParser.hasExactKeys(configuration, [
9097 +        "workspaceRoot",
9098 +        "stateDirectory",
9099 +        "workspaceKey",
9100 +        "stateKey",
9101 +        "identityKey",
9102 +        "instanceId",
9103 +        "processToken",
9104 +        "endpoint",
9105 +        "symnavVersion",
9106 +        "executorModuleUrl",
9107 +        "policy",
9108 +        "startupOwnerKind",
9109 +      ]) &&
9110 +      typeof configuration.workspaceRoot === "string" &&
9111 +      typeof configuration.stateDirectory === "string" &&
9112 +      typeof configuration.workspaceKey === "string" &&
9113 +      typeof configuration.stateKey === "string" &&
9114 +      typeof configuration.identityKey === "string" &&
9115 +      typeof configuration.instanceId === "string" &&
9116 +      typeof configuration.processToken === "string" &&
9117 +      typeof configuration.endpoint === "string" &&
9118 +      typeof configuration.symnavVersion === "string" &&
9119 +      DaemonProcessConfigurationParser.isModuleUrl(configuration.executorModuleUrl) &&
9120 +      DaemonProcessConfigurationParser.isPolicy(configuration.policy) &&
9121 +      configuration.startupOwnerKind === "daemon"
9122 +    );
9123 +  }
9124 +
9125 +  private static hasExactKeys(value: Record<string, unknown>, keys: readonly string[]): boolean {
9126 +    const actual = Object.keys(value).sort();
9127 +    const expected = [...keys].sort();
9128 +    return (
9129 +      actual.length === expected.length && actual.every((key, index) => key === expected[index])
9130 +    );
9131 +  }
9132 +
9133 +  private static isModuleUrl(value: unknown): value is DaemonExecutorModuleUrl {
9134 +    if (typeof value !== "string") return false;
9135 +    try {
9136 +      return new URL(value).href === value;
9137 +    } catch {
9138 +      return false;
9139 +    }
9140 +  }
9141 +
9142 +  private static isPolicy(value: unknown): value is ReturnType<DaemonPolicy["toSerialized"]> {
9143 +    try {
9144 +      DaemonPolicy.fromSerialized(value);
9145 +      return true;
9146 +    } catch {
9147 +      return false;
9148 +    }
9149 +  }
9150 +}

9179 +interface DaemonTerminationRecorder {

9183 +
9184 +export class DaemonProcessTerminationObserver {
9185 +  private terminationOperation: Promise<void> | undefined;
9186 +
9187 +  constructor(
9188 +    private readonly recorder: DaemonTerminationRecorder,
9189 +    private readonly cleanup: () => void,
9190 +    private readonly exit: (code: number) => never = (code) => process.exit(code),
9191 +  ) {}
9192 +
9193 +  install(): void {
9194 +    process.on("uncaughtException", (error, origin) => {
9195 +      void this.uncaughtException(error, origin);
9196 +    });
9197 +    process.on("unhandledRejection", (reason) => {
9198 +      void this.unhandledRejection(reason);
9199 +    });
9200 +    for (const signal of ["SIGTERM", "SIGINT", "SIGHUP"] as const) {
9201 +      process.on(signal, () => void this.signal(signal));
9202 +    }
9203 +  }
9204 +
9205 +  uncaughtException(error: unknown, origin: string): Promise<void> {
9206 +    return this.terminate({
9207 +      kind: "process-termination",
9208 +      terminationReason:
9209 +        origin === "unhandledRejection" ? "unhandled-rejection" : "uncaught-exception",
9210 +      errorName: DaemonLogger.errorName(error),
9211 +    });
9212 +  }
9213 +
9214 +  unhandledRejection(reason: unknown): Promise<void> {
9215 +    return this.terminate({
9216 +      kind: "process-termination",
9217 +      terminationReason: "unhandled-rejection",
9218 +      errorName: DaemonLogger.errorName(reason),
9219 +    });
9220 +  }
9221 +
9222 +  signal(signal: DaemonProcessTerminationSignal): Promise<void> {
9223 +    return this.terminate({ kind: "process-termination", terminationReason: "signal", signal });
9224 +  }
9225 +
9226 +  private terminate(event: DaemonDiagnosticEvent): Promise<void> {
9227 +    if (this.terminationOperation !== undefined) return this.terminationOperation;
9228 +    this.terminationOperation = this.recordAndExit(event);
9229 +    return this.terminationOperation;
9230 +  }
9231 +
9232 +  private async recordAndExit(event: DaemonDiagnosticEvent): Promise<void> {
9233 +    try {
9234 +      this.recorder.record(event);
9235 +      await this.recorder.flush();
9236 +    } finally {
9237 +      try {
9238 +        this.cleanup();
9239 +      } finally {
9240 +        this.exit(1);
9241 +      }
9242 +    }
9243 +  }
9244 +}

9355 +    if (!this.processTerminator.isAlive(record.pid)) return { kind: "exited", record };

9361 +  async observe(record: DaemonRecord): Promise<DaemonObservation> {
9362 +    if (record.state === "starting" && record.pid <= 0) return { kind: "starting", record };
9363 +    if (!this.processTerminator.isAlive(record.pid)) return { kind: "exited", record };
9364 +
9365 +    const [authenticated, ping] = await Promise.all([
9366 +      this.authenticate(record),
9367 +      this.transport
9368 +        .request(record.endpoint, {
9369 +          kind: "ping",
9370 +          protocolVersion: DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
9371 +          instanceId: record.instanceId,

9377 +    ]);

9380 +      if (record.state === "starting") return { kind: "starting", record };
9381 +      return { kind: "unresponsive", record, failureCode: "authentication" };
9382 +    }
9383 +
9384 +    if (ping.kind === "response") {
9385 +      const response = ping.response;
9386 +      if (response.kind !== "pong") {
9387 +        return { kind: "corrupt", record, evidence: DaemonRecordObserver.evidence(record) };
9388 +      }
9389 +      if (response.symnavVersion !== record.symnavVersion) {
9390 +        return { kind: "incompatible", record, evidence: DaemonRecordObserver.evidence(record) };
9391 +      }
9392 +      if (response.startedAt !== undefined && response.startedAt !== record.startedAt) {

9394 +      }
9395 +      if (

9400 +      }

9403 +

9406 +      error instanceof DaemonTransportError &&

9409 +      if (error.code === "incompatible") {
9410 +        return {
9411 +          kind: "incompatible",
9412 +          record,
9413 +          evidence: DaemonRecordObserver.evidence(record),
9414 +        };
9415 +      }
9416 +      if (error.code === "corrupt") {
9417 +        return { kind: "corrupt", record, evidence: DaemonRecordObserver.evidence(record) };
9418 +      }
9419 +    }
9420 +    if (record.state === "starting") return { kind: "starting", record };
9421 +    return {
9422 +      kind: "unresponsive",
9423 +      record,
9424 +      failureCode: error instanceof DaemonTransportError ? error.code : "unknown",
9425 +    };
9426 +  }

9428 +  private async authenticate(record: DaemonRecord): Promise<boolean> {

9433 +        processToken: record.processToken,

9442 +    }
9443 +  }

9451 +    };
9452 +  }

10693 +  private replaceStartupOwner(temporaryPath: string, ownerPath: string): void {
10694 +    if (this.platform !== "win32") {
10695 +      this.renamePath(temporaryPath, ownerPath);
10696 +      return;
10697 +    }
10698 +    const previousPath = `${ownerPath}.${process.pid}.${randomUUID()}.previous`;
10699 +    this.renamePath(ownerPath, previousPath);
10700 +    try {
10701 +      this.renamePath(temporaryPath, ownerPath);
10702 +    } catch (error) {
10703 +      try {
10704 +        this.renamePath(previousPath, ownerPath);
10705 +      } catch {}
10706 +      throw error;
10707 +    }
10708 +    try {
10709 +      rmSync(previousPath, { force: true });
10710 +    } catch {}
10711 +  }

10713 +  private replaceStartupOwnerIfOwner(

10715 +    observedOwner: StartupOwner,

10718 +    const mutation = this.beginStartupMutation(identity);
10719 +    if (mutation === undefined) return undefined;
10720 +    const ownerPath = identity.startupOwnerPath(identity.lockPath);
10721 +    const temporaryPath = `${identity.lockPath}.${process.pid}.${randomUUID()}.owner.tmp`;
10722 +    try {
10723 +      writeFileSync(temporaryPath, JSON.stringify(replacementOwner), {
10724 +        encoding: "utf8",
10725 +        mode: 0o600,
10726 +      });
10727 +      if (
10728 +        !mutation.isOwned() ||
10729 +        this.startupOwnershipMatches(identity, observedOwner) === undefined
10730 +      ) {
10731 +        rmSync(temporaryPath, { force: true });
10732 +        return undefined;
10733 +      }
10734 +      try {
10735 +        this.replaceStartupOwner(temporaryPath, ownerPath);
10736 +      } catch (error) {
10737 +        rmSync(temporaryPath, { force: true });
10738 +        if (DaemonRegistry.errorCode(error) === "ENOENT") return undefined;
10739 +        throw error;
10740 +      }
10741 +      return this.startupOwnershipMatches(identity, replacementOwner) !== undefined
10742 +        ? replacementOwner
10743 +        : undefined;
10744 +    } finally {
10745 +      mutation.release();
10746 +    }
10747 +  }
10748 +
10749 +  private static errorCode(error: unknown): string | undefined {
10750 +    if (typeof error !== "object" || error === null) return undefined;
10751 +    return (error as { readonly code?: string }).code;
10752 +  }
10753 +}

10908 +export class DaemonStartupCoordinator {

10945 +  async ensureRunning(identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity): Promise<DaemonStartResult> {

10948 +      try {
10949 +        return await this.triggerAndWait(identity);
10950 +      } catch (error) {

10953 +          failureCount >= this.childFailureRetryLimit

10967 +  async trigger(identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity): Promise<DaemonWarmupTriggerResult> {

10997 +      }

11001 +    } catch (error) {

11090 +  private async launch(
11091 +    identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity,
11092 +    instanceId: string,
11093 +    processToken: string,
11094 +    lease: NonNullable<ReturnType<DaemonRegistry["acquireStartup"]>>,
11095 +  ): Promise<DaemonWarmupTriggerResult> {
11096 +    const startedAt = this.clock.wallNowMs();
11097 +    const startingRecord: DaemonRecord = {
11098 +      schemaVersion: DAEMON_RECORD_SCHEMA_VERSION,
11099 +      protocolVersion: DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
11100 +      symnavVersion: this.launcher.symnavVersion,
11101 +      workspaceRoot: identity.workspaceRoot,
11102 +      workspaceKey: identity.workspaceKey,
11103 +      stateKey: identity.stateKey,
11104 +      identityKey: identity.identityKey,
11105 +      instanceId,
11106 +      processToken,
11107 +      endpoint: identity.endpoint(instanceId),
11108 +      pid: 0,
11109 +      state: "starting",
11110 +      startedAt,
11111 +      memoryCapBytes: this.launcher.memoryCapBytes,
11112 +    };
11113 +    if (!this.registry.writeStartingIfStartupOwner(identity, startingRecord)) {
11114 +      throw new Error("Daemon startup ownership changed before process launch");
11115 +    }
11116 +    let daemonProcess: DaemonProcess | undefined;
11117 +    try {
11118 +      daemonProcess = await this.launcher.launch(identity, instanceId, processToken);
11119 +      const transferred = lease.transferToDaemon(daemonProcess.pid, processToken);
11120 +      if (
11121 +        !transferred &&
11122 +        !this.registry.daemonOwnsStartupProcess(
11123 +          identity,
11124 +          instanceId,
11125 +          processToken,
11126 +          daemonProcess.pid,
11127 +        )
11128 +      ) {
11129 +        throw new Error("Daemon startup ownership changed after process launch");
11130 +      }
11131 +      if (
11132 +        !this.registry.writeStartingIfStartupOwner(identity, {
11133 +          ...startingRecord,
11134 +          pid: daemonProcess.pid,
11135 +        })
11136 +      ) {
11137 +        throw new Error("Daemon startup ownership changed after process launch");
11138 +      }
11139 +      this.launchedInstances.add(instanceId);
11140 +      this.launchedProcesses.set(instanceId, daemonProcess);
11141 +      this.launchedInstanceIdsByIdentity.set(identity.identityKey, instanceId);
11142 +      this.observeLaunchedProcess(identity, instanceId, processToken, daemonProcess);
11143 +      return {
11144 +        status: "launched",
11145 +        instanceId,
11146 +        pid: daemonProcess.pid,
11147 +      };
11148 +    } catch (error) {
11149 +      if (error instanceof DaemonChildExitError) {
11150 +        this.cleanupLaunchedProcess(identity, instanceId, processToken);
11151 +        throw error;
11152 +      }
11153 +      if (daemonProcess !== undefined) {
11154 +        try {
11155 +          await daemonProcess.terminate();
11156 +        } catch (terminationError) {
11157 +          if (terminationError instanceof DaemonProcessTerminationError) throw terminationError;
11158 +          throw new DaemonProcessTerminationError(String(terminationError));
11159 +        }
11160 +      }
11161 +      this.cleanupLaunchedProcess(identity, instanceId, processToken);
11162 +      throw error;
11163 +    }
11164 +  }
11165 +
11166 +  private observeLaunchedProcess(
11167 +    identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity,
11168 +    instanceId: string,
11169 +    processToken: string,
11170 +    daemonProcess: DaemonProcess,
11171 +  ): void {
11172 +    void daemonProcess.exited.then((exit) => {
11173 +      this.launchedExits.set(instanceId, exit);
11174 +      if (
11175 +        this.registry.startingRecordForProcess(identity, instanceId, processToken) !== undefined
11176 +      ) {
11177 +        this.cleanupLaunchedProcess(identity, instanceId, processToken);
11178 +      }
11179 +    });
11180 +  }
11181 +
11182 +  private cleanupLaunchedProcess(
11183 +    identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity,
11184 +    instanceId: string,
11185 +    processToken: string,
11186 +  ): void {
11187 +    const record = this.registry.recordForProcess(identity, instanceId, processToken);
11188 +    if (record !== undefined) {
11189 +      if (record.pid > 0) {
11190 +        this.registry.removeStartupLockIfProcess(identity, record);
11191 +      } else {
11192 +        this.registry.removeStartupLockIfLauncher(identity, instanceId, processToken);
11193 +      }
11194 +    }
11195 +    this.registry.removeIfProcess(identity, instanceId, processToken);
11196 +  }
11197 +
11198 +  private async observeElectedWarmup(
11199 +    identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity,
11200 +  ): Promise<DaemonWarmupTriggerResult> {
11201 +    while (true) {
11202 +      const record = await this.validatedReadyRecord(identity);
11203 +      if (record?.symnavVersion === this.launcher.symnavVersion) {
11204 +        return { status: "ready", instanceId: record.instanceId, pid: record.pid };
11205 +      }
11206 +      const owner = this.registry.startupOwner(identity);
11207 +      if (owner === undefined) return this.trigger(identity);
11208 +      if (this.startupOwnerIsAbandoned(identity, owner)) {

11210 +      }
11211 +      const startingRecord = this.registry.readStoredInstance(identity, owner.instanceId);
11212 +      if (
11213 +        startingRecord?.state === "starting" &&
11214 +        startingRecord.pid > 0 &&
11215 +        owner.ownerKind === "daemon"
11216 +      ) {
11217 +        return {
11218 +          status: "starting",
11219 +          instanceId: owner.instanceId,
11220 +          pid: startingRecord.pid,
11221 +        };
11222 +      }
11223 +      await this.pause();
11224 +    }
11225 +  }
11226 +
11227 +  private cleanupAbandonedStartup(identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity, owner: StartupOwner): boolean {
11228 +    return this.registry.removeAbandonedStartupOwner(identity, owner);
11229 +  }
11230 +
11231 +  private startupOwnerIsAbandoned(identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity, owner: StartupOwner): boolean {
11232 +    const record = this.registry.readStoredInstance(identity, owner.instanceId);
11233 +    if (record !== undefined && record.pid > 0) {
11234 +      return !this.processTerminator.isAlive(record.pid);
11235 +    }
11236 +    if (owner.ownerKind === "daemon") return !this.processTerminator.isAlive(owner.ownerPid);
11237 +    return (
11238 +      !this.processTerminator.isAlive(owner.ownerPid) ||
11239 +      !this.registry.startupOwnerIsWithinGrace(owner)
11240 +    );
11241 +  }
11242 +
11243 +  private async validatedChildRecord(
11244 +    identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity,
11245 +  ): Promise<DaemonRecord | undefined> {
11246 +    try {
11247 +      return await this.validatedReadyRecord(identity);
11248 +    } catch (error) {
11249 +      if (error instanceof DaemonOwnedButUnresponsiveError) return undefined;
11250 +      throw error;
11251 +    }
11252 +  }
11253 +
11254 +  private async validatedReadyRecord(
11255 +    identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity,
11256 +  ): Promise<DaemonRecord | undefined> {
11257 +    const record = this.registry.read(identity);
11258 +    if (record?.state !== "ready") return undefined;
11259 +    const observation = await this.observer.observe(record);
11260 +    if (observation.kind === "responsive") {
11261 +      this.registry.removeStartupLockIfProcess(identity, record);
11262 +      return record;
11263 +    }
11264 +    if (observation.kind === "exited") {
11265 +      this.registry.removeIfProcess(identity, record.instanceId, record.processToken);
11266 +      return undefined;
11267 +    }
11268 +    if (observation.kind === "incompatible" || observation.kind === "corrupt") return undefined;
11269 +    throw new DaemonOwnedButUnresponsiveError(
11270 +      `Daemon process ${record.pid} is live but unresponsive; ownership was retained`,
11271 +    );
11272 +  }
11273 +
11274 +  private async replaceStoredRecord(
11275 +    identity: DaemonWorkspaceIdentity,
11276 +    record: DaemonRecord,
11277 +  ): Promise<void> {
11278 +    const observation = await this.observer.observe(record);
11279 +    if (observation.kind === "exited") {
11280 +      this.registry.removeIfProcess(identity, record.instanceId, record.processToken);
11281 +      return;
11282 +    }
11283 +    if (observation.kind === "starting" || observation.kind === "unresponsive") {
11284 +      throw new DaemonOwnedButUnresponsiveError(
11285 +        `Daemon process ${record.pid} is live but unresponsive; ownership was retained`,
11286 +      );
11287 +    }
11288 +    await this.transport.request(record.endpoint, {
11289 +      kind: "terminate",
11290 +      instanceId: record.instanceId,
11291 +      processToken: record.processToken,
11292 +    });
11293 +    await this.waitForProcessExitAndEndpointRelease(record);
11294 +    this.registry.removeIfProcess(identity, record.instanceId, record.processToken);
11295 +  }
11296 +
11297 +  private async waitForProcessExitAndEndpointRelease(record: DaemonRecord): Promise<void> {
11298 +    const waitStartedAt = this.clock.wallNowMs();
11299 +    while (this.clock.wallNowMs() - waitStartedAt <= this.terminationTimeoutMs) {
11300 +      const endpointReleased = !(await this.identifiesRecordedProcess(record));
11301 +      const processExited = !this.processTerminator.isAlive(record.pid);
11302 +      if (endpointReleased && processExited) return;
11303 +      await this.pause();
11304 +    }
11305 +    throw new DaemonProcessTerminationError(
11306 +      `Daemon process ${record.pid} did not exit and release its endpoint`,
11307 +    );
11308 +  }
11309 +
11310 +  private async identifiesRecordedProcess(record: DaemonRecord): Promise<boolean> {
11311 +    try {
11312 +      const response = await this.transport.request(record.endpoint, {
11313 +        kind: "identify",
11314 +        instanceId: record.instanceId,
11315 +        processToken: record.processToken,
11316 +      });
11317 +      return (
11318 +        response.kind === "identity" &&
11319 +        response.pid === record.pid &&
11320 +        response.startedAt === record.startedAt
11321 +      );
11322 +    } catch {
11323 +      return false;
11324 +    }
11325 +  }
11326 +
11327 +  private async probeExecution(record: DaemonRecord): Promise<void> {
11328 +    const receipt = await this.transport.execute(record.endpoint, {
11329 +      kind: "execute",
11330 +      protocolVersion: DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
11331 +      instanceId: record.instanceId,
11332 +      processToken: record.processToken,
11333 +      requestId: randomUUID(),
11334 +      commandName: this.readinessProbe.commandName,
11335 +      request: {
11336 +        argv: this.readinessProbe.argv,
11337 +        cwd: record.workspaceRoot,
11338 +        telemetryEnabled: false,
11339 +        executionMode: "cold",
11340 +      },
11341 +    });
11342 +    const completion = await receipt.completion;
11343 +    if (completion.status !== "completed" || completion.result.exitCode !== 0) {
11344 +      throw new Error("Daemon execution readiness probe failed");
11345 +    }
11346 +  }
11347 +
11348 +  private alreadyRunning(record: DaemonRecord): DaemonStartResult {
11349 +    return {
11350 +      status: "already-running",
11351 +      workspaceRoot: record.workspaceRoot,
11352 +      pid: record.pid,
11353 +      uptimeMs: Math.max(0, this.clock.wallNowMs() - record.startedAt),
11354 +    };
11355 +  }
11356 +
11357 +  private pause(): Promise<void> {
11358 +    return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, this.pollIntervalMs));
11359 +  }
11360 +}

11437 +export class DaemonWorkspaceIdentity {

11440 +  }
11441 +
11442 +  static from(workspaceRoot: string, stateDirectory: string): DaemonWorkspaceIdentity {
11443 +    return new DaemonWorkspaceIdentity(workspaceRoot, stateDirectory);
11444 +  }
11445 +
11446 +  readonly workspaceKey: string;

11457 +  private constructor(
11458 +    readonly workspaceRoot: string,
11459 +    readonly stateDirectory: string,
11460 +  ) {
11461 +    this.workspaceKey = DaemonWorkspaceIdentity.hash(workspaceRoot);
11462 +    this.stateKey = DaemonWorkspaceIdentity.hash(stateDirectory);
11463 +    this.identityKey = DaemonWorkspaceIdentity.hash(`${this.workspaceKey}:${this.stateKey}`);
11464 +    this.registryDirectory = DaemonWorkspaceIdentity.registryDirectory(stateDirectory);
11465 +    this.identityDirectory = join(this.registryDirectory, this.identityKey);
11466 +    this.lockPath = join(this.identityDirectory, "startup.lock");
11467 +    this.startupMutationPath = join(this.identityDirectory, "startup.mutation");
11468 +    this.logPath = join(this.identityDirectory, "daemon.log");

11470 +    this.userKey = DaemonWorkspaceIdentity.userIdentityKey();

11472 +
11473 +  endpoint(instanceId: string): string {
11474 +    const instanceKey = DaemonWorkspaceIdentity.hash(instanceId).slice(0, 12);
11475 +    const endpointName = `${this.identityKey.slice(0, 20)}-${instanceKey}`;
11476 +    if (process.platform === "win32") {
11477 +      return `\\\\.\\pipe\\symnav-${this.userKey}-${endpointName}`;
11478 +    }
11479 +    return join(tmpdir(), `symnav-${this.userKey}`, `${endpointName}.sock`);

11491 +    return `${this.startupMutationPath}.${token}.claim`;
11492 +  }
11493 +
11494 +  releasedStartupMutationPath(token: string): string {
11495 +    return `${this.startupMutationPath}.${token}.released`;
11496 +  }
11497 +
11498 +  releasedStartupLockPath(instanceId: string): string {
11499 +    return `${this.lockPath}.${instanceId}.released`;
11500 +  }
11501 +
11502 +  startupOwnerPath(containerPath: string): string {
11503 +    return join(containerPath, "owner.json");
11504 +  }
11505 +

11707 +
11708 +  private captureUsage(): void {

11712 +  }
11713 +
11714 +  private replace(cause: DaemonWorkerReplacementCause): Promise<void> {

11749 +  }
11750 +
11751 +  private async shed(

11997 +        await DaemonStoredExecutorOutput.readExact(handle, bytes, position);
11998 +        position += length;
11999 +        expectedSequence += 1;
12000 +        yield { sequence, stream: streamByte === 0 ? "stdout" : "stderr", bytes };

12002 +    } finally {

12004 +    }

12007 +  private static async readExact(

12016 +        readBytes,

12022 +    }
