12730 +  ): Promise<DaemonExecutionStatusResponse>;
12731 +  private async singleResponse(
12732 +    endpoint: string,
12733 +    request: DaemonLifecycleRequest | DaemonExecutionStatusRequest,
12734 +  ): Promise<DaemonLifecycleResponse | DaemonExecutionStatusResponse> {
12735 +    this.options.validator.request(request);
12736 +    const decoder = this.options.codec.controlDecoder();
12737 +    let connection: Awaited<ReturnType<DaemonSocketClient["connect"]>>;
12738 +    let delivery: DaemonDeliveryState = "not-submitted";
12739 +    try {
12740 +      connection = await this.options.sockets.connect(endpoint, this.options.responseTimeoutMs);
12741 +    } catch (error) {
12742 +      if (DaemonLifecycleClient.isSocketTimeout(error)) {
12743 +        throw new DaemonTransportError("timeout", delivery, "Daemon request timed out");
12744 +      }
12745 +      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
12746 +      throw new DaemonTransportError("unreachable", delivery, message);
12747 +    }
12748 +    try {
12749 +      connection.write(this.options.codec.encodeControl(request));
12750 +      delivery = "submitted-unconfirmed";
12751 +    } catch (error) {
12752 +      connection.destroy();
12753 +      throw DaemonLifecycleClient.transportError(error, delivery);
12754 +    }
12755 +    try {
12756 +      for await (const bytes of connection.incoming) {
12757 +        try {
12758 +          const values = decoder.append(bytes);
12759 +          if (values.length > 1) throw new Error("Daemon returned multiple responses");
12760 +          const value = values[0];
12761 +          if (value === undefined) continue;
12762 +          const response =
12763 +            request.kind === "execution-status"
12764 +              ? this.options.validator.executionStatusResponse(request, value)
12765 +              : this.options.validator.lifecycleResponse(request, value);
12766 +          delivery = "accepted";
12767 +          connection.end();
12768 +          return response;
12769 +        } catch (error) {
12770 +          throw DaemonLifecycleClient.transportError(error, delivery);
12771 +        }
12772 +      }
12773 +      try {
12774 +        decoder.assertComplete();
12775 +      } catch (error) {
12776 +        throw DaemonLifecycleClient.transportError(error, delivery);
12777 +      }
12778 +      throw new DaemonTransportError(
12779 +        "closed",
12780 +        delivery,
12781 +        "Daemon connection ended before a response",
12782 +      );
12783 +    } catch (error) {
12784 +      connection.destroy();
12785 +      if (DaemonLifecycleClient.isSocketTimeout(error)) {
12786 +        throw new DaemonTransportError("timeout", delivery, "Daemon request timed out");
12787 +      }
12788 +      if (!(error instanceof DaemonTransportError) && !(error instanceof DaemonProtocolError)) {
12789 +        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
12790 +        throw new DaemonTransportError("closed", delivery, message);
12791 +      }
12792 +      throw DaemonLifecycleClient.transportError(error, delivery);
12793 +    }
12794 +  }
12795 +
12796 +  private static transportError(
12797 +    error: unknown,
12798 +    delivery: DaemonDeliveryState,
12799 +  ): DaemonTransportError {
12800 +    if (error instanceof DaemonTransportError) return error;
12801 +    if (error instanceof DaemonProtocolError) {
12802 +      return new DaemonTransportError(
12803 +        error.code,
12804 +        "accepted",
12805 +        error.message,
12806 +        error.authenticatedInstanceId,
12807 +      );
12808 +    }
12809 +    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
12810 +    return new DaemonTransportError("corrupt", delivery, message);
12811 +  }
12812 +
12813 +  private static isSocketTimeout(error: unknown): boolean {
12814 +    return (
12815 +      error instanceof Error &&
12816 +      "code" in error &&
12817 +      (error as Error & { code?: string }).code === "ETIMEDOUT"
12818 +    );
12819 +  }
12820 +}

13829 +  }
13830 +
13831 +  private static isProtocolVersion(value: unknown): boolean {
13832 +    return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && Number(value) >= 0;
13833 +  }
13834 +
13835 +  private static isCount(value: unknown): boolean {
13836 +    return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && Number(value) >= 0;
13837 +  }
13838 +
13839 +  private static isPositiveInteger(value: unknown): boolean {
13840 +    return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && Number(value) > 0;
13841 +  }
13842 +
13843 +  private static isMetric(value: unknown): boolean {
13844 +    return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0;
13845 +  }
13846 +
13847 +  private static isRuntimeString(value: unknown): value is string {
13848 +    return typeof value === "string" && value.length > 0;
13849 +  }
13850 +
13851 +  private static isDigest(value: unknown): value is string {
13852 +    return typeof value === "string" && /^[a-f\d]{64}$/.test(value);
13853 +  }
13854 +
13855 +  private static isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
13856 +    return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
13857 +  }
13858 +
13859 +  private static hasExactKeys(value: Record<string, unknown>, keys: readonly string[]): boolean {
13860 +    const actual = Object.keys(value).sort();
13861 +    const expected = [...keys].sort();
13862 +    return (
13863 +      actual.length === expected.length && actual.every((key, index) => key === expected[index])
13864 +    );
13865 +  }
13866 +}

14570 +class LocalDaemonSocketConnection implements DaemonSocketConnection, AsyncIterable<Uint8Array> {
14571 +  readonly incoming: AsyncIterable<Uint8Array> = this;
14572 +  private readonly queuedBytes: Uint8Array[] = [];
14573 +  private pendingRead:
14574 +    | {
14575 +        readonly resolve: (result: IteratorResult<Uint8Array>) => void;
14576 +        readonly reject: (error: unknown) => void;
14577 +      }
14578 +    | undefined;
14579 +  private ended = false;
14580 +  private error: unknown;
14581 +  private readonly queuedWrites: Uint8Array[] = [];
14582 +  private waitingForDrain = false;
14583 +  private timeoutDisabled = false;
14584 +  private endRequested = false;
14585 +  private destroyRequested = false;
14586 +
14587 +  constructor(
14588 +    private readonly socket: Socket,
14589 +    private readonly writeChunkSize: number | undefined,
14590 +  ) {
14591 +    socket.pause();
14592 +    socket.on("data", (bytes) => this.receive(Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) ? bytes : Buffer.from(bytes)));
14593 +    socket.once("end", () => this.finish());
14594 +    socket.once("close", () => this.finish());
14595 +    socket.once("error", (error) => this.fail(error));
14596 +  }
14597 +
14598 +  [Symbol.asyncIterator](): AsyncIterator<Uint8Array> {
14599 +    return this;
14600 +  }
14601 +
14602 +  next(): Promise<IteratorResult<Uint8Array>> {
14603 +    const bytes = this.queuedBytes.shift();
14604 +    if (bytes !== undefined) return Promise.resolve({ done: false, value: bytes });
14605 +    if (this.error !== undefined) return Promise.reject(this.error);
14606 +    if (this.ended) return Promise.resolve({ done: true, value: undefined });
14607 +    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
14608 +      this.pendingRead = { resolve, reject };
14609 +      this.socket.resume();
14610 +    });
14611 +  }
14612 +
14613 +  write(frame: Uint8Array): void {
14614 +    const chunkSize = this.writeChunkSize ?? frame.length;
14615 +    for (let offset = 0; offset < frame.length; offset += chunkSize) {
14616 +      this.queuedWrites.push(frame.subarray(offset, offset + chunkSize));
14617 +    }
14618 +    try {
14619 +      this.flushWrites();
14620 +    } catch (error) {
14621 +      this.fail(error);
14622 +      throw error;
14623 +    }
14624 +  }
14625 +
14626 +  disableTimeout(): void {
14627 +    if (this.timeoutDisabled) return;
14628 +    this.timeoutDisabled = true;
14629 +    this.socket.setTimeout(0);
14630 +  }
14631 +
14632 +  end(): void {
14633 +    if (this.endRequested) return;
14634 +    this.endRequested = true;
14635 +    this.socket.end();
14636 +  }
14637 +
14638 +  destroy(): void {
14639 +    if (this.destroyRequested) return;
14640 +    this.destroyRequested = true;
14641 +    this.socket.destroy();
14642 +  }
14643 +
14644 +  timeout(error: Error): void {
14645 +    this.fail(error);
14646 +    this.destroy();
14647 +  }
14648 +
14649 +  private receive(bytes: Uint8Array): void {
14650 +    this.socket.pause();
14651 +    const pendingRead = this.pendingRead;
14652 +    if (pendingRead === undefined) {
14653 +      this.queuedBytes.push(bytes);
14654 +      return;
14655 +    }
14656 +    this.pendingRead = undefined;
14657 +    pendingRead.resolve({ done: false, value: bytes });
14658 +  }
14659 +
14660 +  private finish(): void {
14661 +    if (this.ended || this.error !== undefined) return;
14662 +    this.ended = true;
14663 +    const pendingRead = this.pendingRead;
14664 +    this.pendingRead = undefined;
14665 +    pendingRead?.resolve({ done: true, value: undefined });
14666 +  }
14667 +
14668 +  private fail(error: unknown): void {
14669 +    if (this.ended || this.error !== undefined) return;
14670 +    this.error = error;
14671 +    const pendingRead = this.pendingRead;
14672 +    this.pendingRead = undefined;
14673 +    pendingRead?.reject(error);
14674 +  }
14675 +
14676 +  private flushWrites(): void {
14677 +    if (this.waitingForDrain || this.ended || this.error !== undefined) return;
14678 +    while (this.queuedWrites.length > 0) {
14679 +      const frame = this.queuedWrites.shift();
14680 +      if (frame === undefined) return;
14681 +      if (this.socket.write(frame)) continue;
14682 +      this.waitingForDrain = true;
14683 +      this.socket.once("drain", () => {
14684 +        this.waitingForDrain = false;
14685 +        try {
14686 +          this.flushWrites();
14687 +        } catch (error) {
14688 +          this.fail(error);
14689 +          this.socket.destroy();
14690 +        }
14691 +      });
14692 +      return;
14693 +    }
14694 +  }
14695 +}

14697 +export class LocalDaemonSocketClient implements DaemonSocketClient {
14698 +  constructor(private readonly options: LocalDaemonSocketClientOptions = {}) {}
14699 +
14700 +  connect(endpoint: string, timeoutMs?: number): Promise<DaemonSocketConnection> {
14701 +    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
14702 +      const socket = createConnection(endpoint);
14703 +      let connection: LocalDaemonSocketConnection | undefined;
14704 +      let settled = false;
14705 +      const fail = (error: Error): void => {
14706 +        if (settled) return;
14707 +        settled = true;
14708 +        socket.destroy();
14709 +        reject(error);
14710 +      };
14711 +      if (timeoutMs !== undefined) {
14712 +        socket.setTimeout(timeoutMs, () => {
14713 +          const error = Object.assign(new Error("Daemon socket timed out"), {
14714 +            code: "ETIMEDOUT" as const,
14715 +          });
14716 +          if (connection === undefined) {
14717 +            fail(error);
14718 +            return;
14719 +          }
14720 +          connection.timeout(error);
14721 +        });
14722 +      }
14723 +      socket.once("error", fail);
14724 +      socket.once("connect", () => {
14725 +        if (settled) return;
14726 +        settled = true;
14727 +        socket.off("error", fail);
14728 +        connection = new LocalDaemonSocketConnection(socket, this.options.writeChunkSize);
14729 +        resolve(connection);
14730 +      });
14731 +    });
14732 +  }
14733 +}

14812 +export class LocalDaemonSocketServer implements DaemonRequestServer {

14815 +  async listen(endpoint: string, handler: DaemonRequestHandler): Promise<DaemonServer> {
14816 +    if (process.platform !== "win32") {

14831 +    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {

14834 +    });

14843 +  private async endpointIsReachable(endpoint: string): Promise<boolean> {
14844 +    try {

14848 +      );
14849 +      connection.destroy();

14851 +    } catch {

14853 +    }

14862 +      (message: DaemonServerMessage) => {
14863 +        const write = writes.then(() => this.writeServerMessage(socket, message));
14864 +        writes = write;
14865 +        return write;
14866 +      },
14867 +      {
14868 +        onClose: (listener: () => void): (() => void) => {
14869 +          closeListeners.add(listener);
14870 +          return () => closeListeners.delete(listener);
14871 +        },
14872 +      },
14873 +    );

14875 +      try {
14876 +        for (const value of decoder.append(Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) ? bytes : Buffer.from(bytes))) {
14877 +          const request = this.options.validator.request(value);
14878 +          responses = responses
14879 +            .then(async () => {
14880 +              const response = await handler(request, send);
14881 +              if (response !== undefined) await send(response);
14882 +            })
14883 +            .catch(() => {
14884 +              socket.destroy();
14885 +            });
14886 +        }
14887 +      } catch {
14888 +        socket.destroy();
14889 +      }
14890 +    });
14891 +    socket.once("end", () => {
14892 +      try {
14893 +        decoder.assertComplete();
14894 +      } catch {
14895 +        socket.destroy();
14896 +      }
14897 +    });

14899 +      for (const listener of closeListeners) {
14900 +        try {
14901 +          listener();

14903 +      }

14905 +    });

14907 +  }

14911 +  }
14912 +
14913 +  private async writeEncodedServerFrame(socket: Socket, frame: Uint8Array): Promise<void> {

14916 +      if (socket.destroyed) throw new Error("Daemon socket closed during response delivery");

14920 +  }
14921 +
14922 +  private static waitForDrain(socket: Socket): Promise<void> {

14927 +        socket.off("close", closed);
14928 +      };

14931 +        resolve();
14932 +      };
14933 +      const failed = (error: Error): void => {

14935 +        reject(error);
14936 +      };
14937 +      const closed = (): void => {

14941 +      socket.once("drain", drained);
14942 +      socket.once("error", failed);
14943 +      socket.once("close", closed);
14944 +    });
14945 +  }
14946 +}

15064 +    return new DaemonTransferFrameDecoder(this.limits);

15066 +
15067 +  private encodeJson(value: unknown, maximumPayloadBytes: number): Uint8Array {
15068 +    const payload = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(value), "utf8");
15069 +    if (payload.byteLength > maximumPayloadBytes) {
15070 +      throw new Error(`Daemon frame exceeds ${maximumPayloadBytes} bytes`);
15071 +    }
15072 +    const prefix = Buffer.alloc(FRAME_PREFIX_BYTES);
15073 +    prefix.writeUInt32BE(payload.byteLength);
15074 +    return Buffer.concat([prefix, payload]);
15075 +  }
15076 +
15077 +  private static isExecutionControl(kind: string): boolean {
15078 +    return (
15079 +      kind === "accepted" ||
15080 +      kind === "rejected" ||
15081 +      kind === "result-manifest" ||
15082 +      kind === "result-end" ||
15083 +      kind === "execution-failed" ||
15084 +      kind === "execution-status" ||
15085 +      kind === "result-acknowledged"

15087 +  }
15088 +}

15090 +class DaemonControlFrameDecoder implements DaemonFrameDecoder<unknown> {
15091 +  private buffered = Buffer.alloc(0);
15092 +
15093 +  constructor(private readonly maximumPayloadBytes: number) {}
15094 +
15095 +  append(bytes: Uint8Array): readonly unknown[] {
15096 +    this.buffered = Buffer.concat([this.buffered, bytes]);
15097 +    const values: unknown[] = [];
15098 +    while (this.buffered.byteLength >= FRAME_PREFIX_BYTES) {
15099 +      const payloadLength = this.buffered.readUInt32BE(0);
15100 +      if (payloadLength > this.maximumPayloadBytes) {
15101 +        throw new Error(`Daemon frame exceeds ${this.maximumPayloadBytes} bytes`);
15102 +      }
15103 +      if (this.buffered.byteLength < payloadLength + FRAME_PREFIX_BYTES) break;
15104 +      const payload = this.buffered.subarray(
15105 +        FRAME_PREFIX_BYTES,
15106 +        payloadLength + FRAME_PREFIX_BYTES,
15107 +      );
15108 +      this.buffered = this.buffered.subarray(payloadLength + FRAME_PREFIX_BYTES);
15109 +      try {
15110 +        values.push(JSON.parse(payload.toString("utf8")));
15111 +      } catch {
15112 +        throw new Error("Daemon frame contains malformed JSON");
15113 +      }
15114 +    }
15115 +    return values;
15116 +  }
15117 +
15118 +  assertComplete(): void {
15119 +    if (this.buffered.byteLength !== 0) {
15120 +      throw new Error("Daemon connection ended with a truncated frame");
15121 +    }
15122 +  }
15123 +}

15125 +class DaemonTransferFrameDecoder implements DaemonFrameDecoder<unknown | DaemonResultChunk> {
15126 +  private buffered = Buffer.alloc(0);
15127 +
15128 +  constructor(private readonly limits: DaemonWireLimits) {}
15129 +
15130 +  append(bytes: Uint8Array): readonly (unknown | DaemonResultChunk)[] {
15131 +    this.buffered = Buffer.concat([this.buffered, bytes]);
15132 +    const values: (unknown | DaemonResultChunk)[] = [];
15133 +    while (this.buffered.byteLength >= FRAME_PREFIX_BYTES) {
15134 +      const encodedLength = this.buffered.readUInt32BE(0);
15135 +      const binary = (encodedLength & BINARY_FRAME_FLAG) !== 0;
15136 +      const payloadLength = encodedLength & FRAME_LENGTH_MASK;
15137 +      const maximumPayloadBytes = binary
15138 +        ? this.limits.maximumExecutionControlPayloadBytes + this.limits.maximumChunkRawBytes
15139 +        : this.limits.maximumExecutionControlPayloadBytes;
15140 +      if (payloadLength > maximumPayloadBytes) {
15141 +        throw new Error("Daemon result frame exceeds capacity");
15142 +      }
15143 +      if (this.buffered.byteLength < payloadLength + FRAME_PREFIX_BYTES) break;
15144 +      const payload = this.buffered.subarray(
15145 +        FRAME_PREFIX_BYTES,
15146 +        payloadLength + FRAME_PREFIX_BYTES,
15147 +      );
15148 +      this.buffered = this.buffered.subarray(payloadLength + FRAME_PREFIX_BYTES);
15149 +      if (binary) {
15150 +        values.push(DaemonResultChunkCodec.decode(payload, this.limits));
15151 +        continue;
15152 +      }
15153 +      try {
15154 +        values.push(JSON.parse(payload.toString("utf8")));
15155 +      } catch {
15156 +        throw new Error("Daemon control frame contains malformed JSON");
15157 +      }
15158 +    }
15159 +    return values;
15160 +  }
15161 +
15162 +  assertComplete(): void {
15163 +    if (this.buffered.byteLength !== 0) {
15164 +      throw new Error("Daemon result transfer ended with a truncated frame");
15165 +    }
15166 +  }
15167 +}

15169 +class DaemonResultChunkCodec {
15170 +  static encode(chunk: DaemonResultChunk, limits: DaemonWireLimits): Uint8Array {
15171 +    DaemonResultChunkCodec.assertChunk(chunk, limits.maximumChunkRawBytes);
15172 +    const header: DaemonResultChunkHeader = {
15173 +      transferId: chunk.transferId,
15174 +      requestId: chunk.requestId,
15175 +      offset: chunk.offset,
15176 +      sequence: chunk.sequence,
15177 +      stream: chunk.stream,
15178 +      payloadLength: chunk.bytes.byteLength,
15179 +      sha256: createHash("sha256").update(chunk.bytes).digest("hex"),
15180 +    };
15181 +    const headerBytes = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(header));
15182 +    if (
15183 +      BINARY_HEADER_LENGTH_BYTES + headerBytes.byteLength >
15184 +      limits.maximumExecutionControlPayloadBytes
15185 +    ) {
15186 +      throw new Error("Daemon result frame exceeds capacity");
15187 +    }
15188 +    const payloadLength =
15189 +      BINARY_HEADER_LENGTH_BYTES + headerBytes.byteLength + chunk.bytes.byteLength;
15190 +    const encoded = Buffer.alloc(FRAME_PREFIX_BYTES + payloadLength);
15191 +    encoded.writeUInt32BE((BINARY_FRAME_FLAG | payloadLength) >>> 0, 0);
15192 +    encoded.writeUInt32BE(headerBytes.byteLength, FRAME_PREFIX_BYTES);
15193 +    headerBytes.copy(encoded, FRAME_PREFIX_BYTES + BINARY_HEADER_LENGTH_BYTES);
15194 +    Buffer.from(chunk.bytes).copy(
15195 +      encoded,
15196 +      FRAME_PREFIX_BYTES + BINARY_HEADER_LENGTH_BYTES + headerBytes.byteLength,
15197 +    );
15198 +    return encoded;
15199 +  }
15200 +
15201 +  static decode(payload: Buffer, limits: DaemonWireLimits): DaemonResultChunk {
15202 +    if (payload.byteLength < BINARY_HEADER_LENGTH_BYTES) {
15203 +      throw new Error("Truncated daemon result chunk header");
15204 +    }
15205 +    const headerLength = payload.readUInt32BE(0);
15206 +    if (headerLength === 0 || headerLength > payload.byteLength - BINARY_HEADER_LENGTH_BYTES) {
15207 +      throw new Error("Invalid daemon result chunk header length");
15208 +    }
15209 +    if (BINARY_HEADER_LENGTH_BYTES + headerLength > limits.maximumExecutionControlPayloadBytes) {
15210 +      throw new Error("Daemon result frame exceeds capacity");
15211 +    }
15212 +    let parsed: unknown;
15213 +    try {
15214 +      parsed = JSON.parse(
15215 +        payload
15216 +          .subarray(BINARY_HEADER_LENGTH_BYTES, BINARY_HEADER_LENGTH_BYTES + headerLength)
15217 +          .toString("utf8"),
15218 +      );
15219 +    } catch {
15220 +      throw new Error("Malformed daemon result chunk header");
15221 +    }
15222 +    const bytes = payload.subarray(BINARY_HEADER_LENGTH_BYTES + headerLength);
15223 +    if (
15224 +      !DaemonResultChunkCodec.isHeader(parsed, limits.maximumChunkRawBytes) ||
15225 +      parsed.payloadLength !== bytes.byteLength
15226 +    ) {
15227 +      throw new Error("Invalid daemon result chunk header");
15228 +    }
15229 +    if (createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex") !== parsed.sha256) {
15230 +      throw new Error("Corrupt daemon result chunk payload");
15231 +    }
15232 +    const chunk: DaemonResultChunk = {
15233 +      transferId: parsed.transferId,
15234 +      requestId: parsed.requestId,
15235 +      offset: parsed.offset,
15236 +      sequence: parsed.sequence,
15237 +      stream: parsed.stream,
15238 +      bytes: Uint8Array.from(bytes),
15239 +    };
15240 +    DaemonResultChunkCodec.assertChunk(chunk, limits.maximumChunkRawBytes);
15241 +    return chunk;
15242 +  }
15243 +
15244 +  private static assertChunk(chunk: DaemonResultChunk, maximumChunkRawBytes: number): void {
15245 +    if (
15246 +      chunk.transferId.length === 0 ||
15247 +      chunk.requestId.length === 0 ||
15248 +      !Number.isSafeInteger(chunk.offset) ||
15249 +      chunk.offset < 0 ||
15250 +      !Number.isSafeInteger(chunk.sequence) ||
15251 +      chunk.sequence < 0 ||
15252 +      (chunk.stream !== "stdout" && chunk.stream !== "stderr") ||
15253 +      !(chunk.bytes instanceof Uint8Array) ||
15254 +      chunk.bytes.byteLength > maximumChunkRawBytes
15255 +    ) {
15256 +      throw new Error("Invalid daemon result chunk");
15257 +    }
15258 +  }
15259 +
15260 +  private static isHeader(
15261 +    value: unknown,
15262 +    maximumChunkRawBytes: number,
15263 +  ): value is DaemonResultChunkHeader {
15264 +    if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
15265 +    const header = value as Record<string, unknown>;
15266 +    const expectedKeys = [
15267 +      "offset",
15268 +      "payloadLength",
15269 +      "requestId",
15270 +      "sequence",
15271 +      "sha256",
15272 +      "stream",
15273 +      "transferId",
15274 +    ];
15275 +    return (
15276 +      DaemonResultChunkCodec.hasExactKeys(header, expectedKeys) &&
15277 +      typeof header.transferId === "string" &&
15278 +      header.transferId.length > 0 &&
15279 +      typeof header.requestId === "string" &&
15280 +      header.requestId.length > 0 &&
15281 +      Number.isSafeInteger(header.offset) &&
15282 +      Number(header.offset) >= 0 &&
15283 +      Number.isSafeInteger(header.sequence) &&
15284 +      Number(header.sequence) >= 0 &&
15285 +      (header.stream === "stdout" || header.stream === "stderr") &&
15286 +      Number.isSafeInteger(header.payloadLength) &&
15287 +      Number(header.payloadLength) >= 0 &&
15288 +      Number(header.payloadLength) <= maximumChunkRawBytes &&
15289 +      typeof header.sha256 === "string" &&
15290 +      /^[a-f\d]{64}$/.test(header.sha256)
15291 +    );
15292 +  }
15293 +
15294 +  private static hasExactKeys(value: Record<string, unknown>, keys: readonly string[]): boolean {
15295 +    const actual = Object.keys(value).sort();
15296 +    const expected = [...keys].sort();
15297 +    return (
15298 +      actual.length === expected.length && actual.every((key, index) => key === expected[index])
15299 +    );
15300 +  }
15301 +}

15343 +class DaemonNavigationWorkerEntry {
15344 +  private executor: DaemonExecutor | undefined;
15345 +  private activeHeapMonitor: WorkerHeapHighWater | undefined;
15346 +  private tail: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();

15348 +  private readonly policy: DaemonPolicy;

15351 +  constructor(

15353 +    private readonly data: DaemonWorkerData,
15354 +  ) {
15355 +    this.policy = DaemonPolicy.fromSerialized(data.policy);
15356 +  }
15357 +
15358 +  run(): void {
15359 +    this.port.on("message", (value: unknown) => {
15360 +      if (
15361 +        typeof value === "object" &&
15362 +        value !== null &&
15363 +        "kind" in value &&
15364 +        value.kind === "output-ack"

15366 +        try {
15367 +          const request = DaemonNavigationWorkerProtocol.request(value);

15371 +        } catch (error) {

15380 +  private async handle(value: unknown): Promise<void> {
15381 +    let request: DaemonNavigationWorkerRequest;
15382 +    try {
15383 +      request = DaemonNavigationWorkerProtocol.request(value);
15384 +    } catch (error) {
15385 +      this.fail("protocol", error);

15387 +    }
15388 +    if (request.generation !== this.data.generation) return;
15389 +    if (request.kind === "initialize") {

15393 +    if (request.kind === "execute") {

15404 +  private async initialize(workspaceRoot: string): Promise<void> {

15491 +  private fail(

15508 +  private send(response: DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse): void {

15511 +      this.policy.values.output.maximumChunkRawBytes,
15512 +    );

15520 +  private sendOutput(
15521 +    requestId: string,
15522 +    initialSequence: number,
15523 +    record: DaemonOutputRecord,
15524 +  ): Promise<number> {
15525 +    return this.sendOutputChunks(requestId, initialSequence, record);
15526 +  }
15527 +
15528 +  private async sendOutputChunks(
15529 +    requestId: string,
15530 +    initialSequence: number,
15531 +    record: DaemonOutputRecord,
15532 +  ): Promise<number> {
15533 +    let sequence = initialSequence;
15534 +    if (record.bytes.byteLength === 0) {
15535 +      await this.sendOutputChunk(requestId, sequence, record.stream, new Uint8Array());
15536 +      return sequence + 1;
15537 +    }
15538 +    for (
15539 +      let offset = 0;
15540 +      offset < record.bytes.byteLength;
15541 +      offset += this.policy.values.output.maximumChunkRawBytes
15542 +    ) {
15543 +      const bytes = Uint8Array.from(
15544 +        record.bytes.subarray(offset, offset + this.policy.values.output.maximumChunkRawBytes),
15545 +      );
15546 +      await this.sendOutputChunk(requestId, sequence, record.stream, bytes);
15547 +      sequence += 1;
15548 +    }
15549 +    return sequence;
15550 +  }
15551 +
15552 +  private sendOutputChunk(
15553 +    requestId: string,
15554 +    sequence: number,
15555 +    stream: DaemonOutputRecord["stream"],
15556 +    bytes: Uint8Array,
15557 +  ): Promise<void> {
15558 +    const key = `${requestId}:${sequence}`;
15559 +    if (this.outputAcknowledgements.has(key)) {
15560 +      return Promise.reject(new Error("Duplicate worker output sequence"));
15561 +    }
15562 +    const acknowledgement = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
15563 +      this.outputAcknowledgements.set(key, resolve);
15564 +    });
15565 +    this.send({
15566 +      kind: "output-chunk",
15567 +      generation: this.data.generation,
15568 +      requestId,
15569 +      sequence,
15570 +      stream,
15571 +      bytes,
15572 +    });
15573 +    return acknowledgement;
15574 +  }
15575 +
15576 +  private acknowledgeOutput(requestId: string, sequence: number): void {
15577 +    const key = `${requestId}:${sequence}`;
15578 +    const resolve = this.outputAcknowledgements.get(key);
15579 +    if (resolve === undefined) throw new Error("Unexpected worker output acknowledgement");
15580 +    this.outputAcknowledgements.delete(key);
15581 +    resolve();
15582 +  }
15583 +}

15585 +class DaemonWorkerDiagnosticProjection {
15586 +  private static readonly emptyRefresh: DaemonRefreshSummary = {
15587 +    added: 0,
15588 +    changed: 0,
15589 +    removed: 0,
15590 +    unchanged: 0,
15591 +  };
15592 +
15593 +  static refresh(diagnostics: DaemonDiagnostics | undefined): DaemonRefreshSummary {
15594 +    const refresh = this.record(diagnostics?.refresh);
15595 +    if (refresh === undefined) return this.emptyRefresh;
15596 +    return {
15597 +      added: this.count(refresh.added),
15598 +      changed: this.count(refresh.changed),
15599 +      removed: this.count(refresh.removed),
15600 +      unchanged: this.count(refresh.unchanged),
15601 +    };
15602 +  }
15603 +
15604 +  static startupDurations(diagnostics: DaemonDiagnostics | undefined): {
15605 +    readonly discoveryMs: number;
15606 +    readonly indexingMs: number;
15607 +  } {
15608 +    const durations = this.record(diagnostics?.durations);
15609 +    return {
15610 +      discoveryMs: this.duration(durations?.discoveryMs),
15611 +      indexingMs: this.duration(durations?.indexingMs),
15612 +    };
15613 +  }
15614 +
15615 +  static commandDurations(
15616 +    diagnostics: DaemonDiagnostics | undefined,
15617 +  ): Omit<WorkerCommandDurations, "outputMs"> {
15618 +    const durations = this.record(diagnostics?.durations);
15619 +    return {
15620 +      freshnessMs: this.duration(durations?.freshnessMs),
15621 +      navigationMs: this.duration(durations?.navigationMs),
15622 +      renderMs: this.duration(durations?.renderMs),
15623 +    };
15624 +  }
15625 +
15626 +  private static record(value: unknown): Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined {
15627 +    return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value)
15628 +      ? (value as Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>)
15629 +      : undefined;
15630 +  }
15631 +
15632 +  private static count(value: unknown): number {
15633 +    return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && Number(value) >= 0 ? Number(value) : 0;
15634 +  }
15635 +
15636 +  private static duration(value: unknown): number {
15637 +    return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 ? value : 0;
15638 +  }
15639 +}

15641 +class WorkerHeapHighWater {
15642 +  private currentUsedBytes = 0;
15643 +  private peakUsedBytes = 0;
15644 +  private heapLimitBytes = 0;
15645 +  private readonly timer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
15646 +
15647 +  constructor(sampleIntervalMs: number) {
15648 +    this.sample();
15649 +    this.timer = setInterval(() => this.sample(), sampleIntervalMs);
15650 +    this.timer.unref?.();
15651 +  }
15652 +
15653 +  sample(): void {
15654 +    const heap = getHeapStatistics();
15655 +    this.currentUsedBytes = heap.used_heap_size;

15813 +  }
15814 +}
15815 +
15816 +export interface DaemonNavigationWorker {
15817 +  readonly generation: number;
15818 +  readonly exited: Promise<DaemonNavigationWorkerExit>;

15843 +  };

15845 +  readonly workerData?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
15846 +}

15848 +interface PendingWorkerResponse {
15849 +  readonly resolve: (response: DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse) => void;
15850 +  readonly reject: (error: Error) => void;

15856 +export class NodeDaemonNavigationWorker implements DaemonNavigationWorker {
15857 +  readonly generation: number;
15858 +  readonly exited: Promise<DaemonNavigationWorkerExit>;
15859 +  private readonly worker: Worker;
15860 +  private readonly pending = new Map<string, PendingWorkerResponse>();
15861 +  private readonly completed = new Set<string>();
15862 +  private resolveExited!: (exit: DaemonNavigationWorkerExit) => void;
15863 +  private exit: DaemonNavigationWorkerExit | undefined;
15864 +  private terminating = false;
15865 +  private closeAcknowledged = false;
15866 +  private communicationFailure: Error | undefined;
15867 +  private communicationFailureCode: string | undefined;
15868 +  private releaseSequence = 0;
15869 +  private readonly maximumChunkRawBytes: number;
15870 +
15871 +  constructor(options: NodeDaemonNavigationWorkerOptions) {
15872 +    this.generation = options.generation;
15873 +    this.maximumChunkRawBytes = DaemonPolicy.fromSerialized(
15874 +      options.configuration.policy,
15875 +    ).values.output.maximumChunkRawBytes;
15876 +    this.exited = new Promise((resolve) => {
15877 +      this.resolveExited = resolve;
15878 +    });

15880 +      workerData: {
15881 +        ...options.workerData,
15882 +        stateDirectory: options.configuration.stateDirectory,
15883 +        generation: options.generation,
15884 +        productVersion: options.configuration.productVersion,
15885 +        executorModuleUrl: options.configuration.executorModuleUrl,
15886 +        policy: options.configuration.policy,
15887 +      },
15888 +      resourceLimits: options.resourceLimits,
15889 +    });
15890 +    this.worker.on("message", (value: unknown) => void this.receive(value));
15891 +    this.worker.once("error", (error) => this.failCommunication(error));
15892 +    this.worker.once("exit", () => this.finishExit());
15893 +  }
15894 +
15895 +  start(workspaceRoot: string): Promise<DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse> {
15896 +    return this.send("initialize", {
15897 +      kind: "initialize",
15898 +      generation: this.generation,
15899 +      workspaceRoot,
15900 +    });
15901 +  }
15902 +
15903 +  execute(
15904 +    requestId: string,
15905 +    commandName: DaemonCommandName,
15906 +    request: DaemonExecutorRequest,
15907 +    output: DaemonOutputSink,
15908 +  ): Promise<DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse> {
15909 +    return this.send(
15910 +      `execute:${requestId}`,
15911 +      {
15912 +        kind: "execute",
15913 +        generation: this.generation,
15914 +        requestId,
15915 +        commandName,
15916 +        request,
15917 +      },
15918 +      output.append.bind(output),
15919 +    );
15920 +  }
15921 +
15922 +  releaseTransientResources(): Promise<DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse> {

15924 +    this.releaseSequence += 1;
15925 +    return this.send(`release-transient:${operationId}`, {

15927 +      generation: this.generation,
15928 +      operationId,
15929 +    });
15930 +  }
15931 +
15932 +  async drainAndClose(): Promise<void> {

15937 +

15939 +    if (this.exit !== undefined) return;

15944 +
15945 +  private send(
15946 +    key: string,
15947 +    request: DaemonNavigationWorkerRequest,
15948 +    appendOutput: ((record: DaemonSequencedOutputRecord) => Promise<void>) | undefined = undefined,
15949 +  ): Promise<DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse> {
15950 +    if (this.exit !== undefined)

15953 +      return Promise.reject(new Error(`Duplicate daemon navigation worker request: ${key}`));

15956 +      this.pending.set(key, {
15957 +        resolve,
15958 +        reject,
15959 +        appendOutput:
15960 +          appendOutput ?? (() => Promise.reject(new Error("Worker output sink is unavailable"))),

15962 +        chunkInFlight: false,
15963 +      });
15964 +    });
15965 +    this.worker.postMessage(DaemonNavigationWorkerProtocol.request(request));
15966 +    return response;
15967 +  }
15968 +
15969 +  private async receive(value: unknown): Promise<void> {
15970 +    let response: DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse;
15971 +    try {
15972 +      response = DaemonNavigationWorkerProtocol.response(value, this.maximumChunkRawBytes);
15973 +    } catch (error) {
15974 +      this.failCommunication(error);
15975 +      return;
15976 +    }

15978 +    if (response.kind === "output-chunk") {

15980 +      return;
15981 +    }
15982 +    const key = NodeDaemonNavigationWorker.responseKey(response);
15983 +    if (this.completed.has(key)) {
15984 +      this.failCommunication(new Error(`Duplicate daemon navigation worker response: ${key}`));
15985 +      return;
15986 +    }
15987 +    const pending = this.pending.get(key);
15988 +    if (pending === undefined) {
15989 +      this.failCommunication(new Error(`Uncorrelated daemon navigation worker response: ${key}`));
15990 +      return;
15991 +    }
15992 +    this.pending.delete(key);
15993 +    this.completed.add(key);
15994 +    if (response.kind === "failed") {
15995 +      pending.reject(new Error(`Daemon navigation worker ${response.failureCode} failure`));
15996 +      return;
15997 +    }
15998 +    if (response.kind === "closed") this.closeAcknowledged = true;
15999 +    pending.resolve(response);
16000 +  }
16001 +
16002 +  private async receiveOutputChunk(
16003 +    response: Extract<DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse, { kind: "output-chunk" }>,
16004 +  ): Promise<void> {
16005 +    const key = `execute:${response.requestId}`;
16006 +    const pending = this.pending.get(key);
16007 +    if (
16008 +      pending === undefined ||
16009 +      pending.chunkInFlight ||
16010 +      response.sequence !== pending.nextSequence
16011 +    ) {
16012 +      this.failCommunication(new Error(`Unexpected daemon navigation worker output: ${key}`));
16013 +      return;
16014 +    }
16015 +    pending.chunkInFlight = true;
16016 +    try {
16017 +      const record: DaemonSequencedOutputRecord = {
16018 +        sequence: response.sequence,
16019 +        stream: response.stream,
16020 +        bytes: response.bytes,
16021 +      };
16022 +      await pending.appendOutput(record);
16023 +      pending.nextSequence += 1;
16024 +      pending.chunkInFlight = false;
16025 +      const acknowledgement: DaemonNavigationWorkerRequest = {
16026 +        kind: "output-ack",
16027 +        generation: this.generation,
16028 +        requestId: response.requestId,
16029 +        sequence: response.sequence,
16030 +      };
16031 +      this.worker.postMessage(DaemonNavigationWorkerProtocol.request(acknowledgement));
16032 +    } catch (error) {
16033 +      this.failCommunication(error);
16034 +    }
16035 +  }
16036 +
16037 +  private failCommunication(error: unknown): void {
16038 +    if (this.exit !== undefined) return;
16039 +    const failure = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
16040 +    this.communicationFailure = failure;
16041 +    this.communicationFailureCode =
16042 +      typeof error === "object" &&
16043 +      error !== null &&
16044 +      "code" in error &&
16045 +      typeof error.code === "string"
16046 +        ? error.code
16047 +        : undefined;
16048 +    void this.worker.terminate();
16049 +  }
16050 +
16051 +  private finishExit(): void {
16052 +    if (this.exit !== undefined) return;
16053 +    const communicationErrorName = this.communicationFailure?.name;
16054 +    const communicationFailureIdentity = this.communicationFailureCode ?? communicationErrorName;
16055 +    const cause = communicationFailureIdentity
16056 +      ? communicationFailureIdentity === "ERR_WORKER_OUT_OF_MEMORY"
16057 +        ? "out-of-memory"
16058 +        : "error"
16059 +      : this.terminating
16060 +        ? "terminated"
16061 +        : this.closeAcknowledged
16062 +          ? "closed"
16063 +          : "error";
16064 +    this.exit = {
16065 +      generation: this.generation,
16066 +      cause,
16067 +      ...(communicationFailureIdentity === undefined
16068 +        ? {}
16069 +        : { errorName: communicationFailureIdentity }),
16070 +    };
16071 +    const failure = new DaemonNavigationWorkerExitedError(
16072 +      this.exit,
16073 +      this.communicationFailure?.message,
16074 +    );
16075 +    for (const pending of this.pending.values()) pending.reject(failure);
16076 +    this.pending.clear();
16077 +    this.resolveExited(this.exit);
16078 +  }
16079 +
16080 +  private static responseKey(response: DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse): string {
16081 +    if (response.kind === "ready") return "initialize";
16082 +    if (response.kind === "result") return `execute:${response.requestId}`;
16083 +    if (response.kind === "heap") return `release-transient:${response.operationId}`;
16084 +    if (response.kind === "closed") return "close";
16085 +    if (response.kind === "failed" && response.operationId !== undefined) {
16086 +      return `release-transient:${response.operationId}`;
16087 +    }
16088 +    return response.requestId === undefined ? "initialize" : `execute:${response.requestId}`;
16089 +  }
16090 +}

16182 +export class DaemonWorkerGenerationManager {
16183 +  private currentGeneration: DaemonWorkerGeneration;

16186 +  private recoveryOperation: Promise<void> | undefined;

16196 +    const worker = options.initialWorker ?? options.createWorker(1);

16212 +    this.startOperation = this.waitForReadyGeneration(generation).then((report) => {

16239 +        if (
16240 +          response.kind !== "result" ||
16241 +          response.requestId !== requestId ||
16242 +          response.generation !== generation.worker.generation

16244 +          throw new Error("Navigation worker returned an uncorrelated result");
16245 +        }
16246 +        return response;
16247 +      });
16248 +  }
16249 +
16250 +  replace(cause: DaemonWorkerReplacementCause): Promise<DaemonWorkerReadyReport> {
16251 +    if (this.replacementOperation !== undefined) return this.replacementOperation;
16252 +    const operation = this.replaceGeneration(cause);
16253 +    this.replacementOperation = operation;
16254 +    void operation.then(

16256 +      () => this.clearReplacement(operation),

16258 +    return operation;
16259 +  }
16260 +
16261 +  async releaseTransientResources(): Promise<DaemonWorkerResourceReport> {

16270 +      workerHeapLimitBytes: response.heapLimitBytes,

16274 +
16275 +  close(): Promise<void> {

16278 +    this.workerReady = false;
16279 +    this.closeOperation = this.currentGeneration.worker.drainAndClose();
16280 +    return this.closeOperation;
16281 +  }
16282 +
16283 +  terminate(): Promise<void> {

16285 +    this.stopping = true;
16286 +    this.workerReady = false;
16287 +    this.terminationOperation = this.currentGeneration.worker.terminate();
16288 +    return this.terminationOperation;
16289 +  }
16290 +
16291 +  private async replaceGeneration(
16292 +    cause: DaemonWorkerReplacementCause,
16293 +  ): Promise<DaemonWorkerReadyReport> {
16294 +    const previous = this.currentGeneration;
16295 +    if (cause !== "worker-exit") this.options.onActiveResourceInterruption(cause);
16296 +    this.workerReady = false;
16297 +    this.protocolReadyGeneration = undefined;
16298 +    const nextWorker = this.options.createWorker(previous.worker.generation + 1);
16299 +    if (nextWorker.generation !== previous.worker.generation + 1) {
16300 +      throw new Error("Navigation worker factory returned the wrong generation");
16301 +    }
16302 +    const next = this.createGeneration(nextWorker);
16303 +    this.currentGeneration = next;
16304 +    next.ready = this.startGeneration(next);
16305 +    await previous.worker.terminate().catch(() => undefined);
16306 +    const report = await next.ready;
16307 +    this.publishProtocolReady(next, report);
16308 +    this.options.onDiagnostic({
16309 +      kind: "worker-replaced",
16310 +      cause,
16311 +      previousWorkerGeneration: previous.worker.generation,
16312 +      workerGeneration: next.worker.generation,
16313 +      fileCount: report.fileCount,
16314 +      ...report.startupDurations,
16315 +    });
16316 +    return report;
16317 +  }
16318 +
16319 +  private startGeneration(generation: DaemonWorkerGeneration): Promise<DaemonWorkerReadyReport> {
16320 +    return generation.worker
16321 +      .start(this.options.workspaceRoot)
16322 +      .then((response): DaemonWorkerReadyReport => {
16323 +        if (response.kind !== "ready" || response.generation !== generation.worker.generation) {
16324 +          throw new Error("Navigation worker did not become ready");
16325 +        }

16327 +      });
16328 +  }
16329 +
16330 +  private async waitForReadyGeneration(
16331 +    generation: DaemonWorkerGeneration,
16332 +  ): Promise<DaemonWorkerReadyReport> {
16333 +    try {
16334 +      if (generation.ready === undefined) throw new Error("Navigation worker is not starting");
16335 +      return await generation.ready;
16336 +    } catch (error) {
16337 +      if (!(error instanceof DaemonNavigationWorkerExitedError)) throw error;
16338 +      await generation.worker.exited;
16339 +      const recovery = this.recoveryOperation;
16340 +      if (recovery === undefined) throw error;
16341 +      await recovery;
16342 +      const replacement = this.currentGeneration;
16343 +      if (replacement === generation || replacement.ready === undefined) throw error;
16344 +      return replacement.ready;
16345 +    }
16346 +  }
16347 +
16348 +  private createGeneration(worker: DaemonNavigationWorker): DaemonWorkerGeneration {
16349 +    const generation: DaemonWorkerGeneration = { worker, ready: undefined };
16350 +    void worker.exited.then((exit) => this.observeExit(generation, exit));
16351 +    return generation;
16352 +  }
16353 +
16354 +  private observeExit(generation: DaemonWorkerGeneration, exit: DaemonNavigationWorkerExit): void {
16355 +    if (this.stopping || generation !== this.currentGeneration) return;
16356 +    const recovery = this.options.exitRecovery.recover(exit);
16357 +    this.recoveryOperation = recovery;
16358 +    void recovery.catch(() => undefined);
16359 +  }
16360 +
16361 +  private publishProtocolReady(
16362 +    generation: DaemonWorkerGeneration,
16363 +    report: DaemonWorkerReadyReport,
16364 +  ): void {
16365 +    if (generation !== this.currentGeneration) return;
16366 +    this.protocolReadyGeneration = generation;
16367 +    this.fileCount = report.fileCount;
16368 +    if (this.readinessActivated) this.workerReady = true;
16369 +  }
16370 +
16371 +  private clearReplacement(operation: Promise<DaemonWorkerReadyReport>): void {
16372 +    if (this.replacementOperation === operation) this.replacementOperation = undefined;
16373 +  }
16374 +}

16411 +  readonly totalMs: number;
16412 +}
16413 +
16414 +export interface WorkerCommandDurations {

16416 +  readonly navigationMs: number;
16417 +  readonly renderMs: number;

16419 +}
16420 +
16421 +export type DaemonNavigationWorkerRequest =
16422 +  | { readonly kind: "initialize"; readonly generation: number; readonly workspaceRoot: string }
16423 +  | {
16424 +      readonly kind: "execute";
16425 +      readonly generation: number;
16426 +      readonly requestId: string;
16427 +      readonly commandName: DaemonCommandName;
16428 +      readonly request: DaemonExecutorRequest;
16429 +    }
16430 +  | {

16432 +      readonly generation: number;
16433 +      readonly requestId: string;

16435 +    }
16436 +  | {
16437 +      readonly kind: "release-transient";
16438 +      readonly generation: number;
16439 +      readonly operationId: string;
16440 +    }
16441 +  | { readonly kind: "close"; readonly generation: number };
16442 +
16443 +export type DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse =
16444 +  | {
16445 +      readonly kind: "output-chunk";
16446 +      readonly generation: number;
16447 +      readonly requestId: string;
16448 +      readonly sequence: number;
16449 +      readonly stream: DaemonOutputStream;
16450 +      readonly bytes: Uint8Array;
16451 +    }
16452 +  | {
16453 +      readonly kind: "ready";
16454 +      readonly generation: number;
16455 +      readonly fileCount: number;
16456 +      readonly refresh: DaemonRefreshSummary;
16457 +      readonly startupDurations: WorkerStartupDurations;
16458 +      readonly diagnostics?: DaemonDiagnostics;
16459 +    }
16460 +  | {
16461 +      readonly kind: "result";
16462 +      readonly generation: number;
16463 +      readonly requestId: string;
16464 +      readonly result: { readonly exitCode: number };
16465 +      readonly refresh: DaemonRefreshSummary;
16466 +      readonly durations: WorkerCommandDurations;
16467 +      readonly diagnostics?: DaemonDiagnostics;

16470 +        readonly peakWorkerHeapUsedBytes: number;

16491 +export class DaemonNavigationWorkerProtocol {
16492 +  static request(value: unknown): DaemonNavigationWorkerRequest {
16493 +    if (!this.isRecord(value) || !this.isGeneration(value.generation)) {
16494 +      throw new Error("Invalid daemon navigation worker request");
16495 +    }
16496 +    if (
16497 +      value.kind === "initialize" &&
16498 +      this.hasKeys(value, ["kind", "generation", "workspaceRoot"]) &&
16499 +      this.isNonEmptyString(value.workspaceRoot)
16500 +    ) {
16501 +      return value as unknown as DaemonNavigationWorkerRequest;
16502 +    }
16503 +    if (
16504 +      value.kind === "execute" &&
16505 +      this.hasKeys(value, ["kind", "generation", "requestId", "commandName", "request"]) &&
16506 +      this.isNonEmptyString(value.requestId) &&
16507 +      DaemonRuntimeValues.isCommandName(value.commandName) &&
16508 +      this.isExecutionRequest(value.request)
16509 +    ) {
16510 +      return value as unknown as DaemonNavigationWorkerRequest;
16511 +    }
16512 +    if (
16513 +      value.kind === "output-ack" &&
16514 +      this.hasKeys(value, ["kind", "generation", "requestId", "sequence"]) &&
16515 +      this.isNonEmptyString(value.requestId) &&
16516 +      this.isCount(value.sequence)
16517 +    ) {
16518 +      return value as unknown as DaemonNavigationWorkerRequest;
16519 +    }
16520 +    if (
16521 +      value.kind === "release-transient" &&
16522 +      this.hasKeys(value, ["kind", "generation", "operationId"]) &&
16523 +      this.isNonEmptyString(value.operationId)
16524 +    ) {
16525 +      return value as unknown as DaemonNavigationWorkerRequest;
16526 +    }
16527 +    if (value.kind === "close" && this.hasKeys(value, ["kind", "generation"])) {
16528 +      return value as unknown as DaemonNavigationWorkerRequest;
16529 +    }
16530 +    throw new Error("Invalid daemon navigation worker request");
16531 +  }
16532 +
16533 +  static response(value: unknown, maximumChunkRawBytes: number): DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse {
16534 +    if (!this.isRecord(value) || !this.isGeneration(value.generation)) {
16535 +      throw new Error("Invalid daemon navigation worker response");
16536 +    }
16537 +    if (
16538 +      value.kind === "ready" &&
16539 +      this.hasKeys(
16540 +        value,
16541 +        this.keysWithDiagnostics(
16542 +          ["kind", "generation", "fileCount", "refresh", "startupDurations"],
16543 +          value,
16544 +        ),
16545 +      ) &&
16546 +      this.isCount(value.fileCount) &&
16547 +      this.isRefresh(value.refresh) &&
16548 +      this.isDurations(value.startupDurations, ["discoveryMs", "indexingMs", "totalMs"]) &&
16549 +      this.isDiagnostics(value.diagnostics)
16550 +    ) {
16551 +      return value as unknown as DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse;
16552 +    }
16553 +    if (
16554 +      value.kind === "output-chunk" &&
16555 +      this.hasKeys(value, ["kind", "generation", "requestId", "sequence", "stream", "bytes"]) &&
16556 +      this.isNonEmptyString(value.requestId) &&
16557 +      this.isCount(value.sequence) &&
16558 +      (value.stream === "stdout" || value.stream === "stderr") &&
16559 +      value.bytes instanceof Uint8Array &&
16560 +      value.bytes.byteLength <= maximumChunkRawBytes
16561 +    ) {
16562 +      return value as unknown as DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse;
16563 +    }
16564 +    if (
16565 +      value.kind === "result" &&
16566 +      this.hasKeys(
16567 +        value,
16568 +        this.keysWithDiagnostics(
16569 +          ["kind", "generation", "requestId", "result", "refresh", "durations", "resources"],
16570 +          value,
16571 +        ),
16572 +      ) &&
16573 +      this.isNonEmptyString(value.requestId) &&
16574 +      this.isExecutionResult(value.result) &&
16575 +      this.isRefresh(value.refresh) &&
16576 +      this.isDurations(value.durations, ["freshnessMs", "navigationMs", "renderMs", "outputMs"]) &&
16577 +      this.isDiagnostics(value.diagnostics) &&
16578 +      this.isWorkerResources(value.resources)
16579 +    ) {
16580 +      return value as unknown as DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse;
16581 +    }
16582 +    if (value.kind === "failed" && this.isFailed(value)) {
16583 +      return value as unknown as DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse;
16584 +    }
16585 +    if (
16586 +      value.kind === "heap" &&
16587 +      this.hasKeys(value, [
16588 +        "kind",
16589 +        "generation",
16590 +        "operationId",
16591 +        "usedHeapBytes",
16592 +        "heapLimitBytes",
16593 +      ]) &&
16594 +      this.isNonEmptyString(value.operationId) &&
16595 +      this.isCount(value.usedHeapBytes) &&
16596 +      this.isCount(value.heapLimitBytes)
16597 +    ) {
16598 +      return value as unknown as DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse;
16599 +    }
16600 +    if (value.kind === "closed" && this.hasKeys(value, ["kind", "generation"])) {
16601 +      return value as unknown as DaemonNavigationWorkerResponse;
16602 +    }
16603 +    throw new Error("Invalid daemon navigation worker response");
16604 +  }
16605 +
16606 +  private static isWorkerResources(value: unknown): boolean {
16607 +    return (
16608 +      this.isRecord(value) &&
16609 +      this.hasKeys(value, [
16610 +        "workerHeapUsedBytes",
16611 +        "peakWorkerHeapUsedBytes",
16612 +        "workerHeapLimitBytes",
16613 +      ]) &&
16614 +      this.isCount(value.workerHeapUsedBytes) &&
16615 +      this.isCount(value.peakWorkerHeapUsedBytes) &&
16616 +      this.isCount(value.workerHeapLimitBytes) &&
16617 +      value.peakWorkerHeapUsedBytes >= value.workerHeapUsedBytes
16618 +    );
16619 +  }
16620 +
16621 +  private static isExecutionRequest(value: unknown): value is DaemonExecutorRequest {
16622 +    if (!this.isRecord(value)) return false;
16623 +    return (
16624 +      this.hasKeys(value, ["argv", "cwd", "telemetryEnabled", "executionMode"]) &&
16625 +      Array.isArray(value.argv) &&
16626 +      value.argv.every((argument) => typeof argument === "string") &&
16627 +      typeof value.cwd === "string" &&
16628 +      typeof value.telemetryEnabled === "boolean" &&
16629 +      (value.executionMode === "cold" ||
16630 +        value.executionMode === "warm" ||
16631 +        value.executionMode === "fallback")
16632 +    );
16633 +  }
16634 +
16635 +  private static isDiagnostics(value: unknown): value is DaemonDiagnostics | undefined {
16636 +    return value === undefined || DaemonDiagnosticValues.isDiagnostics(value);
16637 +  }
16638 +
16639 +  private static keysWithDiagnostics(
16640 +    keys: readonly string[],
16641 +    value: Record<string, unknown>,
16642 +  ): readonly string[] {
16643 +    return value.diagnostics === undefined ? keys : [...keys, "diagnostics"];
16644 +  }
16645 +
16646 +  private static isExecutionResult(value: unknown): value is { readonly exitCode: number } {
16647 +    return (
16648 +      this.isRecord(value) && this.hasKeys(value, ["exitCode"]) && this.isCount(value.exitCode)
16649 +    );
16650 +  }
16651 +
16652 +  private static isRefresh(value: unknown): value is DaemonRefreshSummary {
16653 +    return (
16654 +      this.isRecord(value) &&
16655 +      this.hasKeys(value, ["added", "changed", "removed", "unchanged"]) &&
16656 +      this.isCount(value.added) &&
16657 +      this.isCount(value.changed) &&
16658 +      this.isCount(value.removed) &&
16659 +      this.isCount(value.unchanged)
16660 +    );
16661 +  }
16662 +
16663 +  private static isFailed(value: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
16664 +    const keys = ["kind", "generation", "failureCode"];
16665 +    if (value.requestId !== undefined) keys.push("requestId");
16666 +    if (value.operationId !== undefined) keys.push("operationId");
16667 +    if (value.errorName !== undefined) keys.push("errorName");
16668 +    return (
16669 +      this.hasKeys(value, keys) &&
16670 +      (value.requestId === undefined || this.isNonEmptyString(value.requestId)) &&
16671 +      (value.operationId === undefined || this.isNonEmptyString(value.operationId)) &&
16672 +      !(value.requestId !== undefined && value.operationId !== undefined) &&
16673 +      (value.failureCode === "initialization" ||
16674 +        value.failureCode === "execution" ||
16675 +        value.failureCode === "protocol" ||
16676 +        value.failureCode === "resource") &&
16677 +      (value.errorName === undefined || this.isNonEmptyString(value.errorName))
16678 +    );
16679 +  }
16680 +
16681 +  private static isDurations(value: unknown, keys: readonly string[]): boolean {
16682 +    return (
16683 +      this.isRecord(value) &&
16684 +      this.hasKeys(value, keys) &&
16685 +      keys.every((key) => this.isMetric(value[key]))
16686 +    );
16687 +  }
16688 +
16689 +  private static hasKeys(value: Record<string, unknown>, keys: readonly string[]): boolean {
16690 +    const actual = Object.keys(value).sort();
16691 +    return (
16692 +      actual.length === keys.length && actual.every((key, index) => key === [...keys].sort()[index])
16693 +    );
16694 +  }
16695 +
16696 +  private static isGeneration(value: unknown): value is number {
16697 +    return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && Number(value) >= 0;
16698 +  }
16699 +
16700 +  private static isCount(value: unknown): value is number {
16701 +    return Number.isSafeInteger(value) && Number(value) >= 0;
16702 +  }
16703 +
16704 +  private static isMetric(value: unknown): value is number {
16705 +    return typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0;
16706 +  }
16707 +
16708 +  private static isNonEmptyString(value: unknown): value is string {
16709 +    return typeof value === "string" && value.length > 0;
16710 +  }
16711 +
16712 +  private static isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
16713 +    return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
16714 +  }
16715 +}

16722 +class FixtureOutput {
16723 +  constructor(records) {
16724 +    this.outputRecords = records;
16725 +  }
16726 +
16727 +  async *records() {
16728 +    yield* this.outputRecords;
16729 +  }
16730 +
16731 +  dispose() {
16732 +    return Promise.resolve();
16733 +  }
16734 +}
16735 +
16736 +class FixtureExecutor {
16737 +  constructor(options) {
16738 +    this.options = options;
16739 +  }
16740 +
16741 +  async initialize(workspaceRoot) {
16742 +    if (workspaceRoot === "fail:initialize") throw new Error("fixture initialize failure");
16743 +    return {
16744 +      fileCount: workspaceRoot.startsWith("files:")
16745 +        ? Number.parseInt(workspaceRoot.slice("files:".length), 10)
16746 +        : 1,
16747 +    };
16748 +  }
16749 +
16750 +  async execute(request) {
16751 +    if (request.argv[0] === "fail:execute") throw new Error("fixture execute failure");
16752 +    const records = request.argv.flatMap((instruction) => {
16753 +      const separator = instruction.indexOf(":");
16754 +      const kind = instruction.slice(0, separator);
16755 +      const value = instruction.slice(separator + 1);
16756 +      if (kind !== "stdout" && kind !== "stderr") return [];
16757 +      return [{ stream: kind, bytes: Buffer.from(value) }];
16758 +    });
16759 +    const exitInstruction = request.argv.find((instruction) => instruction.startsWith("exit:"));
16760 +    return {
16761 +      exitCode:
16762 +        exitInstruction === undefined
16763 +          ? 0
16764 +          : Number.parseInt(exitInstruction.slice("exit:".length), 10),
16765 +      output: new FixtureOutput(records),
16766 +    };
16767 +  }
16768 +
16769 +  async releaseTransientResources() {
16770 +    if (this.options.productVersion === "fail:release") {
16771 +      throw new Error("fixture release failure");
16772 +    }
16773 +    this.options.sampleResources();
16774 +  }
16775 +}
16776 +
16777 +export function createDaemonExecutor(options) {
16778 +  return new FixtureExecutor(options);
16779 +}

17019 @@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
17020 +import { existsSync, realpathSync } from "node:fs";
17021 +import { basename, dirname, join, resolve } from "node:path";
17022 +
17023 +export class CanonicalTestPath {
17024 +  static resolve(path: string): string {
17025 +    const absolutePath = resolve(path);
17026 +    const missingSegments: string[] = [];
17027 +    let existingAncestor = absolutePath;
17028 +    while (!existsSync(existingAncestor)) {
17029 +      const parent = dirname(existingAncestor);
17030 +      if (parent === existingAncestor) return absolutePath;
17031 +      missingSegments.unshift(basename(existingAncestor));
17032 +      existingAncestor = parent;
17033 +    }
17034 +    return join(realpathSync(existingAncestor), ...missingSegments);
17035 +  }
17036 +}

17098 +import { parentPort, workerData } from "node:worker_threads";
17099 +import { existsSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
17100 +import { getHeapStatistics } from "node:v8";
17101 +
17102 +const generation = workerData.generation;
17103 +let executionCount = 0;
17104 +let releaseCount = 0;
17105 +let externalMemory;
17106 +const pendingResults = new Map();
17107 +
17108 +parentPort.on("message", (message) => {
17109 +  if (message.kind === "initialize") {
17110 +    if (workerData.policyPath !== undefined) {
17111 +      writeFileSync(
17112 +        workerData.policyPath,
17113 +        JSON.stringify({
17114 +          policy: workerData.policy,
17115 +          productVersion: workerData.productVersion,
17116 +          executorModuleUrl: workerData.executorModuleUrl,
17117 +        }),
17118 +      );
17119 +    }
17120 +    if (workerData.mode === "initialize-heap-oom") exhaustOldGeneration();
17121 +    if (workerData.mode === "malformed") {
17122 +      parentPort.postMessage({ kind: "ready", generation, fileCount: "wrong" });
17123 +      return;
17124 +    }
17125 +    if (workerData.mode === "late-generation") {
17126 +      parentPort.postMessage({ kind: "closed", generation: generation - 1 });
17127 +    }
17128 +    if (workerData.mode === "block")
17129 +      Atomics.wait(new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(4)), 0, 0, 150);
17130 +    parentPort.postMessage({
17131 +      kind: "ready",
17132 +      generation,
17133 +      fileCount: 1,
17134 +      refresh: { added: 1, changed: 0, removed: 0, unchanged: 0 },
17135 +      startupDurations: { discoveryMs: 50, indexingMs: 100, totalMs: 150 },
17136 +    });
17137 +    return;
17138 +  }
17139 +  if (message.kind === "execute") {
17140 +    executionCount += 1;
17141 +    if (workerData.requestPayloadPath !== undefined) {
17142 +      writeFileSync(workerData.requestPayloadPath, JSON.stringify(message.request));
17143 +    }
17144 +    if (workerData.requestStartedPath !== undefined) {
17145 +      writeFileSync(workerData.requestStartedPath, "started");
17146 +      writeFileSync(`${workerData.requestStartedPath}.${executionCount}`, "started");
17147 +      writeFileSync(`${workerData.requestStartedPath}.request-id`, message.requestId);
17148 +    }
17149 +    if (workerData.mode === "heap-oom") {
17150 +      exhaustOldGeneration();
17151 +    }
17152 +    if (workerData.mode === "external-pressure") {
17153 +      externalMemory = Buffer.alloc(192 * 1024 * 1024, 1);
17154 +      while (true) Atomics.wait(new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(4)), 0, 0, 1_000);
17155 +    }
17156 +    if (workerData.mode === "block" || workerData.mode === "block-execution") {
17157 +      Atomics.wait(new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(4)), 0, 0, workerData.blockMs ?? 150);
17158 +    }
17159 +    if (workerData.mode === "exit-on-release") {
17160 +      while (!existsSync(workerData.releasePath)) {
17161 +        Atomics.wait(new Int32Array(new SharedArrayBuffer(4)), 0, 0, 10);
17162 +      }
17163 +      throw new Error("intentional daemon navigation worker exit");
17164 +    }
17165 +    const result = {
17166 +      kind: "result",
17167 +      generation,
17168 +      requestId: message.requestId,
17169 +      result: { exitCode: 0 },
17170 +      refresh: { added: 0, changed: 0, removed: 0, unchanged: 1 },
17171 +      durations: { freshnessMs: 1, navigationMs: 149, renderMs: 0, outputMs: 0 },
17172 +      resources: {
17173 +        workerHeapUsedBytes: 1,
17174 +        peakWorkerHeapUsedBytes: 1,
17175 +        workerHeapLimitBytes: 2,
17176 +      },
17177 +    };
17178 +    pendingResults.set(message.requestId, result);
17179 +    const bytes = Uint8Array.from(Buffer.from("worker output\n"));
17180 +    parentPort.postMessage(
17181 +      {
17182 +        kind: "output-chunk",
17183 +        generation,
17184 +        requestId: message.requestId,
17185 +        sequence: 0,
17186 +        stream: "stdout",
17187 +        bytes,
17188 +      },
17189 +      [bytes.buffer],
17190 +    );
17191 +    return;
17192 +  }
17193 +  if (message.kind === "output-ack") {
17194 +    const result = pendingResults.get(message.requestId);
17195 +    if (result === undefined || message.sequence !== 0) throw new Error("unexpected output ack");
17196 +    pendingResults.delete(message.requestId);
17197 +    parentPort.postMessage(result);
17198 +    if (workerData.mode === "duplicate") parentPort.postMessage(result);
17199 +    return;
17200 +  }
17201 +  if (message.kind === "release-transient") {
17202 +    releaseCount += 1;
17203 +    if (workerData.mode === "release-failure-once" && releaseCount === 1) {
17204 +      parentPort.postMessage({
17205 +        kind: "failed",
17206 +        generation,
17207 +        operationId: message.operationId,
17208 +        failureCode: "resource",
17209 +        errorName: "ReleaseFailure",
17210 +      });
17211 +      return;
17212 +    }
17213 +    const heap = getHeapStatistics();
17214 +    parentPort.postMessage({
17215 +      kind: "heap",
17216 +      generation,
17217 +      operationId: message.operationId,
17218 +      usedHeapBytes: heap.used_heap_size,
17219 +      heapLimitBytes: heap.heap_size_limit,
17220 +    });
17221 +    return;
17222 +  }
17223 +  if (message.kind === "close") {
17224 +    parentPort.postMessage({ kind: "closed", generation });
17225 +    parentPort.close();
17226 +  }
17227 +});
17228 +
17229 +function exhaustOldGeneration() {
17230 +  const retained = [];
17231 +  while (true) {
17232 +    retained.push(
17233 +      Array.from({ length: 50_000 }, (_, index) => ({
17234 +        index,
17235 +        value: `${retained.length}:${index}`,
17236 +      })),
17237 +    );
17238 +  }
17239 +}

17419 +    const resourceRecord = options.resourcePolicy?.record;

17435 +      base.values.output.maximumChunkRawBytes,
17436 +      inlineBytes ?? base.values.output.inlineRawBytes,
17437 +      resultBytes ?? base.values.output.maximumResultRawBytes,
17438 +    );

17444 +      },

17447 +      },
17448 +      output: {
17449 +        maximumChunkRawBytes: chunkBytes,
17450 +        ...(inlineBytes === undefined ? {} : { inlineRawBytes: inlineBytes }),
17451 +        ...(resultBytes === undefined ? {} : { maximumResultRawBytes: resultBytes }),
17452 +        ...(aggregateBytes === undefined ? {} : { maximumAggregateSpoolRawBytes: aggregateBytes }),
17453 +      },
17454 +      resources: {

17456 +          ? {}
17457 +          : {
17458 +              effectiveMemoryBytes: resourceRecord.effectiveMemoryBytes,
17459 +              hardProcessRssBytes: resourceRecord.hardProcessRssBytes,
17460 +              softProcessRssBytes: resourceRecord.softProcessRssBytes,
17461 +              resumeProcessRssBytes: resourceRecord.resumeProcessRssBytes,
17462 +              workerMaxOldGenerationSizeMiB: resourceRecord.workerMaxOldGenerationSizeMb,
17463 +              replacementWindowMs: resourceRecord.replacementWindowMs,
17464 +              replacementLimit: resourceRecord.replacementLimit,

17466 +        ...(hardProcessRssBytes === undefined ? {} : { hardProcessRssBytes }),

17478 +          ? {}
17479 +          : { maximumDisconnectedTraces: options.maximumRetainedOperationTraces }),
17480 +      },
17481 +    });
17482 +    super({
17483 +      ...options,
17484 +      coordinates: {
17485 +        workspaceRoot: options.identity.workspaceRoot,
17486 +        workspaceKey: options.identity.workspaceKey,

17497 +      clock:

17499 +        new NodeDaemonClock({

17687 +import { mkdirSync, renameSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
17688 +import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
17689 +import { CanonicalTestPath } from "./canonical-path.js";
17690 +import {
17691 +  DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
17692 +  DAEMON_RECORD_SCHEMA_VERSION,
17693 +} from "../../src/transport/protocol.js";
17694 +import { TestDaemonRegistry as DaemonRegistry } from "./daemon-registry.js";
17695 +import { DaemonWorkspaceIdentity } from "../../src/registry/workspace-identity.js";
17696 +
17697 +const [workspaceRoot, stateDirectory, startupDelayMsText] = process.argv.slice(2);
17698 +if (
17699 +  workspaceRoot === undefined ||
17700 +  stateDirectory === undefined ||
17701 +  startupDelayMsText === undefined
17702 +) {
17703 +  process.exit(2);
17704 +}
17705 +
17706 +await new Promise<void>((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, Number(startupDelayMsText)));
17707 +
17708 +const identity = DaemonWorkspaceIdentity.from(
17709 +  workspaceRoot,
17710 +  CanonicalTestPath.resolve(stateDirectory),
17711 +);
17712 +const registry = new DaemonRegistry(identity.registryDirectory);
17713 +const instanceId = "orphaned-mutation";
17714 +const lease = registry.acquireStartup(identity, instanceId);
17715 +if (lease === undefined) process.exit(3);
17716 +if (
17717 +  !registry.writeStartingIfStartupOwner(identity, {
17718 +    schemaVersion: DAEMON_RECORD_SCHEMA_VERSION,
17719 +    protocolVersion: DAEMON_PROTOCOL_VERSION,
17720 +    symnavVersion: "0.1.0",
17721 +    workspaceRoot,
17722 +    workspaceKey: identity.workspaceKey,
17723 +    stateKey: identity.stateKey,
17724 +    identityKey: identity.identityKey,
17725 +    instanceId,
17726 +    processToken: "orphaned-mutation-token",
17727 +    endpoint: identity.endpoint(instanceId),
17728 +    pid: 0,
17729 +    state: "starting",
17730 +    startedAt: Date.now(),
17731 +    memoryCapBytes: 256 * 1024 * 1024,
17732 +  })
17733 +) {
17734 +  process.exit(4);
17735 +}
17736 +
17737 +const token = randomUUID();
17738 +const claimPath = identity.startupMutationClaimPath(token);
17739 +mkdirSync(claimPath, { mode: 0o700 });
17740 +writeFileSync(
17741 +  identity.startupOwnerPath(claimPath),
17742 +  JSON.stringify({ ownerPid: process.pid, acquiredAt: Date.now(), token }),
17743 +  { encoding: "utf8", flag: "wx", mode: 0o600 },
17744 +);
17745 +renameSync(claimPath, identity.startupMutationPath);
17746 +if (process.send === undefined) process.exit(5);
17747 +process.send(process.pid, (error) => {
17748 +  if (error !== null) process.exit(5);
17749 +  process.disconnect?.();
17750 +});
17751 +setInterval(() => undefined, 1_000);

17885 +
17886 +describe("built daemon entry artifacts", () => {
17887 +  const packageDirectory = dirname(dirname(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))));
17888 +  const executorModuleUrl = pathToFileURL(
17889 +    join(packageDirectory, "test", "fixtures", "executor-module.mjs"),
17890 +  ).href;
17891 +  const policy = DaemonPolicy.fromSystemMemory({ totalBytes: 512 * 1024 * 1024 });
17892 +
17893 +  it("runs the package-relative worker entry with an absolute executor file URL", async () => {
17894 +    const worker = new NodeDaemonNavigationWorker({
17895 +      generation: 1,
17896 +      configuration: {
17897 +        stateDirectory: join(packageDirectory, "test"),
17898 +        productVersion: "test",
17899 +        executorModuleUrl,
17900 +        policy: policy.toSerialized(),
17901 +      },
17902 +      resourceLimits: { maxOldGenerationSizeMb: 128 },
17903 +    });
17904 +    try {
17905 +      await expect(worker.start("files:3")).resolves.toMatchObject({
17906 +        kind: "ready",
17907 +        fileCount: 3,
17908 +      });
17909 +      const output: string[] = [];
17910 +      await expect(
17911 +        worker.execute(
17912 +          "request",
17913 +          "version",
17914 +          {
17915 +            argv: ["stdout:one", "stderr:two", "exit:7"],
17916 +            cwd: packageDirectory,
17917 +            telemetryEnabled: false,
17918 +            executionMode: "warm",
17919 +          },
17920 +          {
17921 +            append: async (record) => {
17922 +              output.push(`${record.stream}:${Buffer.from(record.bytes).toString()}`);
17923 +            },
17924 +          },
17925 +        ),
17926 +      ).resolves.toMatchObject({ kind: "result", result: { exitCode: 7 } });
17927 +      expect(output).toEqual(["stdout:one", "stderr:two"]);
17928 +      await worker.releaseTransientResources();
17929 +      await worker.drainAndClose();
17930 +    } finally {
17931 +      await worker.terminate();
17932 +    }

17936 +    [
17937 +      "missing module",

17999 +class BuiltProcessEntryHarness {

18420 +## Readiness-Armed Idle Lifetime
18421 +
18422 +**Purpose.** Give every ready daemon the full idle interval before automatic shutdown.
18423 +
18424 +**Produces.** Idle accounting starts when worker initialization, warm resource sampling, and ready-record publication finish. Startup time does not consume the ready daemon's idle interval.
18425 +
18426 +**Does not produce.** A change to the idle interval or any earlier readiness publication.
18427 +
18428 +**Example.** A daemon that spends longer than the idle interval warming remains available for the full idle interval after it publishes ready instead of shutting down immediately.
18429 +
18430 +## Completion-Based Idle Lifetime
18431 +
18432 +**Purpose.** Measure idle time from the end of the latest navigation turn.
18433 +
18434 +**Produces.** Completing a navigation turn starts a fresh idle interval. A request that runs longer than the idle interval does not trigger immediate idle shutdown when its queue becomes idle.
18435 +
18436 +**Does not produce.** A reset for control-plane requests or non-navigation activity.
18437 +
18438 +**Example.** A navigation accepted just before its deadline and running for ten minutes remains ready for the full idle interval after completion.
18439 +

18441  
18442 -| Change                        | One line                                                                    |
18443 -| ----------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
18444 -| Ledger eviction               | Acknowledged entries removed at once; unacknowledged expire with their trace |
18445 -| Startup silence bound         | A starting daemon silent for `6 hours` is abandoned and replaced             |
18446 -| Control-plane readiness       | `daemon start` returns when admission opens, not after queued navigation     |
18447 -| Endpoints under state dir     | Removing a state directory removes its endpoints                             |
18448 -| Selection-aware source cache  | Selection refreshes retain unchanged omitted bytes without eager sibling reads |
18449 -| Election by socket bind       | Evaluate OS-enforced single owner in place of file lease; adopt only if suites pass |
